paras.en: Oaken opened his mouth to chide the animal, but before he could get the words out, Sven dropped to the ground.
paras.zh: 奥肯张嘴要训这动物，话还没出口，斯文就倒在了地上。

paras.en: Oofta!
paras.zh: 哎呀！

paras.en: Just as Granduncle Hugo predicted—his concoctions had finally killed someone! “Sven?
paras.zh: 正如雨果叔祖父预言——他的秘方终于害死人了！“斯文？

paras.en: Hoo-hoo!” To his immense relief, the reindeer’s tail began to wag.
paras.zh: 呼——嗬！”让他大松一口气的是，驯鹿的尾巴开始摇了。

paras.en: Rolling onto his back, the massive creature wriggled euphorically back and forth in the snow.
paras.zh: 它翻过身，这庞然大物在雪里乐不可支地来回扭动。

paras.en: Like a little cat with an olive, the reindeer began to make mewling noises. “Oaken, have you seen Sve—” Kristoff ran up the lane, his typically carefree face puckered in concern. “What did you do to my reindeer?” “What did I do to him?” Oaken’s hands fisted on his hips. “You should be asking, what did he do to me?” With a bout of sudden remorse, the reindeer stopped rolling in the snow.
paras.zh: 像叼着橄榄的小猫，驯鹿开始发出喵喵声。“奥肯，你看到斯文——”克里斯托夫顺着小路跑来，平日无忧的脸皱成担忧。“你对我的驯鹿做了什么？”“我对他做了什么？”奥肯双手叉腰，“你该问的是，他对我做了什么？”驯鹿忽然害起羞来，停止在雪里打滚。

paras.en: But he couldn’t quite keep his dopey smile in check. “Sven?” Kristoff glared at the reindeer, waiting as the creature got to his feet.
paras.zh: 可它那傻笑憋也憋不住。“斯文？”克里斯托夫瞪着驯鹿，等它站起来。

paras.en: Kristoff stepped closer until they were big nose to big nose and sniffed. “Open up!” The creature’s eyes rolled up toward the sky before he reluctantly parted his mouth.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫凑近，直到大鼻子对大鼻子，嗅了嗅。“张嘴！”那家伙眼睛朝天翻了翻，才不情愿地张开嘴。

paras.en: Kristoff inhaled deeply, declaring, “Huh?
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫深吸一口气，宣布：“嗯？

paras.en: Carrots and walnuts.” Unable to conceal his pleasure, Sven’s tail commenced wagging as he brayed and bobbed his head up and down. “Ja.
paras.zh: 胡萝卜和核桃。”斯文藏不住得意，尾巴摇起来，边叫边上下点头。“对。

paras.en: Sven ate most of my signature cookies and all of my carrot-balm face mask, for the fresh sweat-glow.” Still leaning toward the animal, but turning to face Oaken, Kristoff said in his deeper Sven voice, “I’m so sorry, Mr.
paras.zh: 斯文吃了我大部分招牌饼干，还有我全部胡萝卜香膏面膜，就为了那新鲜出汗的光彩。”克里斯托夫仍俯向驯鹿，却转脸对着奥肯，用他那低沉的“斯文腔”说：“真抱歉，奥肯先生。

paras.en: Wandering Oaken.
paras.zh: 漫游奥肯。

paras.en: I just couldn’t help myself.
paras.zh: 我就是忍不住。

paras.en: Walnuts and carrots are my favorite.” The reindeer brayed again to emphasize his agreement.
paras.zh: 核桃和胡萝卜是我的最爱。”驯鹿又叫一声以示赞同。

paras.en: In his regular tone, Kristoff said, “Now, Sven, we talked about this.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫用平常语气说：“好了，斯文，咱们说过这事。

paras.en: You can’t devour things that don’t belong to you without permission.” “I know.
paras.zh: 没经同意你不能吞别人的东西。”“我知道。

paras.en: I really am sorry.” Why did the blond fellow insist on speaking for a creature that could clearly speak for itself?
paras.zh: 我真的很抱歉。”这金发家伙干嘛非要替一个明明能自己开口的动物说话？

paras.en: Oaken found the peculiar habit unnecessary—but was quick to overlook others’ oddities.
paras.zh: 奥肯觉得这怪习惯多此一举——但对别人的怪癖向来不计较。

paras.en: His customers came in all shapes, sizes, and species.
paras.zh: 他的顾客形形色色，各有体型与物种。

paras.en: The contrite expression on Sven’s face, still slightly rapturous from his latest pilfered snack, spoke volumes.
paras.zh: 斯文脸上那愧疚的神情——还因刚偷吃而略带陶醉——说明了一切。

paras.en: The creature did feel remorse.
paras.zh: 这动物确实知错了。

paras.en: And Oaken had gained some valuable test information in the process. “No worries.
paras.zh: 而奥肯也从中得到了宝贵的测试信息。“别担心。

paras.en: I can replace what was eaten.” If Hugo and Lars hadn’t demolished all the walnuts… Kristoff chuckled. “Maybe you should consider repackaging the carrot stuff as a reindeer treat?” Sven brayed enthusiastically.
paras.zh: 被吃的我能补上。”要是雨果和拉尔斯没把核桃吃光……克里斯托夫轻笑。“也许你该考虑把胡萝卜膏重新包装成驯鹿零食？”斯文热情地叫了一声。

paras.en: The shaggy companion had provided valuable cross-species consumption testing on more than one occasion.
paras.zh: 这毛茸茸的伙伴不止一次提供了宝贵的跨物种食用测试。

paras.en: Oaken was already ahead of them in calculating the potential to delight more than just his two-legged guests. “Ja.
paras.zh: 奥肯早就在盘算，这东西能取悦的恐怕不止两条腿的客人。“对。

paras.en: I will give it a good think.” “While I’m here, can I get a bottle of your 3-in-1 Reindeer Wash?” Although originally intended for reindeer, Kristoff and his troll family also used the product—thus the 3-in-1. “Right this way.” Oaken led him through the recently reorganized Hygge for Home section. “North Mountain Ice or Fresh Fjord?” “Better give me both.
paras.zh: 我会好好琢磨。”既然来了，能给我一瓶你的『三合一驯鹿洗护液』吗？”虽说本为驯鹿设计，克里斯托夫和他的地精家人也用这产品——所以叫三合一。“这边请。”奥肯领他穿过刚整理好的『居家Hygge专区』。“北山冰爽味，还是清新峡湾味？”“两样都给我吧。

paras.en: Bulda prefers Mountain Ice, but Sven and I like the Fjord better.” It did have a most pleasing woodsy aroma. “Do you require anything else?
paras.zh: 布尔达偏爱山冰味，可我和斯文更喜欢峡湾味。”那味确实有一股好闻的林木香。“还需要别的吗？

paras.en: In addition to colorful traditional towels for the sauna, we have expanded our line to include smaller, happy-drying-of-the-hands towels.” “Why would I need that when I have trousers?” “How about a colorful cloth for washing?” He waved the patterned square under Kristoff’s nose. “Makes bathing more fun, ja?” “If you say so.” Kristoff was a tough sell.
paras.zh: 除了桑拿用的彩色传统毛巾，我们又拓展了产品线，加了小号的『开心擦手巾』。”“我有裤子要那干啥？”“那彩色洗脸巾呢？”他在克里斯托夫鼻尖下晃着那块花纹方巾，“洗澡更有趣，对吧？”“随你便。”克里斯托夫是个难搞的客人。

paras.en: However, there were other ways he could be useful. “Did you see our upcoming sauna events?
paras.zh: 不过，他还有别的用处。“你看到我们即将推出的桑拿活动了吗？

paras.en: You and Queen Anna would especially like Oaken’s Jokens Night of Comedy.
paras.zh: 你和安娜女王一定特别喜欢『奥肯笑话喜剧之夜』。

paras.en: A hilarious evening of family anecdotes, Papa Peder’s puns, and Hoo-hoo! jokes.” He also hoped to get some of Arendelle’s best storytellers to come and regale guests on a semi-regular basis once the events gained notoriety. “I’ve been working on a Hoo-hoo! joke that you will enjoy, ja?” “Uh, sure.
paras.zh: 那是一晚的家庭趣事、佩德尔爸爸的双关语，还有呼——嗬！段子。”他还希望等这些活动出了名，能请些阿伦黛尔最好的说书人定期来给客人助兴。“我正琢磨一个呼——嗬！段子，你准喜欢，对吧？”“呃，行吧。

paras.en: I guess.” Kristoff frowned.
paras.zh: 我想是。”克里斯托夫皱了皱眉。

paras.en: At least Oaken presumed that was the case, but since the fellow had a limited range of expressions, one could never be sure with him.
paras.zh: 至少奥肯是这么以为，可这人表情匮乏，谁也拿不准他到底啥意思。

paras.en: But an audience was an audience.… “Hoo-hoo!” After a moment of uncomfortable silence, he added, “Now you say, ‘Who could it be that is knocking at my door?’” “Do I have to?” Kristoff shrugged. “Can’t I just say, ‘Come in?’” “Do you want to hear the joke or not?” “Actually, I really don’t care—” “Hoo-hoo!” “Fine,” Kristoff grumbled, before unenthusiastically doing his part. “Who could it be that is knocking at my door?” “It is I, ELLL-SA.” Again, Kristoff hesitated.
paras.zh: 但听众就是听众……“呼——嗬！”尴尬沉默片刻后，他补了一句，“现在你接：『会是谁在敲我的门？』”“非接不可吗？”克里斯托夫耸肩，“我就说『进来』不行吗？”“你到底想不想听段子？”“其实我真不在乎——”“呼——嗬！”“行吧，”克里斯托夫嘟囔着，不情不愿地接了词，“会是谁在敲我的门？”“是我，艾——莎——。”克里斯托夫又犹豫了。

paras.en: Oaken lifted his brows in encouragement, eliciting a very lackluster, “Elsa who?” “Let me in.
paras.zh: 奥肯挑眉鼓励，换来一句有气无力的“艾莎谁？”“让我进。

paras.en: ELLL-SA I turn your sauna into an icehouse.” Without a change to his expression or voice, Kristoff replied, “Good one.” THUMP!
paras.zh: 艾——莎——把你桑拿变成冰窖。”克里斯托夫面无表情、声不变色地答：“不错。”咚！

paras.en: Oaken and Kristoff hurried toward the sound.
paras.zh: 奥肯和克里斯托夫急忙朝声音赶去。

paras.en: Curled into a ball on the porch, Sven proceeded to take a nap.
paras.zh: 斯文在门廊上蜷成球，接着睡起了午觉。

paras.en: Kristoff took hold of the creature’s collar. “Come on, buddy.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫抓住驯鹿的项圈。“起来啦，兄弟。

paras.en: You can’t sleep here.” The reindeer rolled on his back, legs in the air, and proceeded to snore.
paras.zh: 你不能睡这儿。”驯鹿翻过身，四脚朝天，接着打起鼾。

paras.en: After a couple more unsuccessful attempts to wake him, Kristoff turned to Oaken. “Sorry.
paras.zh: 又试了几次都没叫醒，克里斯托夫转向奥肯。“抱歉。

paras.en: I’ve never seen him like this.
paras.zh: 我从没见他这样过。

paras.en: Are you sure Sven is going to be okay?” “Ja.
paras.zh: 你确定斯文会没事吗？”“对。

paras.en: I will keep an eye on him.” Kristoff was a good customer.
paras.zh: 我会盯着他。”克里斯托夫是个好顾客。

paras.en: Their relationship had come a long way since the misunderstanding during the Big Summer Blowout.
paras.zh: 自打“盛夏大促销”那场误会后，他俩关系进步不小。

paras.en: And as sorry as Sven felt for his behavior, Oaken felt worse for breaking him. “I’ll add a quart of lutefisk so we have good feelings.” While he rushed to get the jar, Kristoff fiddled with the sign on the door.
paras.zh: 斯文为自己的行为愧疚，奥肯却更愧疚——把他给“搞垮”了。“我再添一夸脱碱渍鱼，让咱俩都舒坦。”他匆忙去取罐子时，克里斯托夫摆弄起门上的牌子。

paras.en: Holding a small Oaken’s bag for the toting of goods and the jar of lutefisk that Oaken had just brought him, Kristoff cast a final glance at his reindeer. “Just send him home when he wakes up, I guess.” “Sure thing.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫拎着一只装货的小奥肯袋和刚到手的碱渍鱼罐，最后瞥了眼驯鹿。“等他醒了让他自己回家就行，我想。”“没问题。

paras.en: Bye-bye.” Oaken waved reassuringly until Queen Anna’s beau disappeared from sight.
paras.zh: 再见啦。”奥肯宽慰地挥手，直到安娜女王的如意郎君消失在视线外。

paras.en: He’d meant what he said about keeping an eye on Sven while he righted what had gone off course during the day.
paras.zh: 他说话算话，要一边盯着斯文，一边把这天跑偏的事扶正。

paras.en: He needed to heat the sauna, prepare ingredients for another batch of carrot balm, expel Hugo and Lars from the store, tidy up, and shell any walnut he could salvage.
paras.zh: 他得烧热桑拿、备好下一批胡萝卜香膏的原料、把雨果和拉尔斯赶出店、收拾干净，还要剥能抢救的核桃。

paras.en: Oofta!
paras.zh: 哎呀！

paras.en: If he hurried, he could still manage a quick sweat before family dinner.
paras.zh: 要是动作快，家庭晚饭前还能匆匆蒸上一把。

paras.en: He started a fire in the sauna.
paras.zh: 他在桑拿房点起火。

paras.en: He would need to replenish the basket with fresh towels after he ousted the squirrels from the reception area.
paras.zh: 把松鼠赶出接待区后，他得给篮子补上干净毛巾。

paras.en: Scouring the shelves of merchandise for two sets of beady eyes, he could not find any signs of the furry bandits except for the carnage left behind.
paras.zh: 他搜遍商品货架找那两对芝麻眼，除了一片狼藉，没见那俩毛贼的踪影。

paras.en: They’d vanished into thin air along with the nuts.
paras.zh: 它们连同坚果一起凭空消失了。

paras.en: Perhaps they’d exited the same way they’d entered.
paras.zh: 也许它们从进来的原路溜了。

paras.en: And perhaps he could use raisins instead of walnuts in the cookies.
paras.zh: 也许饼干里他可以用葡萄干代替核桃。

paras.en: He would have a good think on that while he straightened up.
paras.zh: 收拾时他会好好琢磨这事。

paras.en: He righted various tokens, brushing fragments of walnut shells onto the floor.
paras.zh: 他把各类纪念品摆正，把核桃碎壳扫到地上。

paras.en: Next he swept up the debris and uncluttered the reception desk.
paras.zh: 接着扫掉碎屑，把接待台收拾清爽。

paras.en: In the cold-storage room, he set aside the necessary ingredients for carrot balm (carrots, ginger, mushrooms, and the like), which he would prepare in the morning while Oaken’s Family-Friendly Cozy Cottages and Sauna signature warm raisin cookies were baking.
paras.zh: 在冷库里，他备好做胡萝卜香膏所需的原料（胡萝卜、姜、蘑菇之类），明早『奥肯家庭温馨小屋与桑拿房』烤招牌温葡萄干饼干时一并处理。

paras.en: Finally free of reindeer, snowgies, and squirrels, Oaken intended to salvage the remaining sliver of afternoon for himself.
paras.zh: 终于摆脱了驯鹿、小雪宝和松鼠，奥肯打算把午后剩下的一点时光留给自己。

paras.en: He added water to the sauna’s hot stones to create steam.
paras.zh: 他往桑拿热石上加水，腾起蒸汽。

paras.en: He rewarmed the two remaining cookies to the perfect temperature, set the single jar of carrot-balm face mask—slash possible reindeer treat—on the reception desk, and changed into a fresh towel.
paras.zh: 他把剩的两块饼干重新温热到完美温度，把那一小罐胡萝卜香膏面膜——也可当驯鹿零食——摆在接待台上，换上一条新毛巾。

paras.en: Time to enjoy the hygge! “Hey-ho!” Oaken looked up to see two strangers in unfamiliar garb approaching. “We are Ethan and Joseph of the Southern Isles.
paras.zh: 该享受hygge啦！“嘿嗬！”奥肯抬头，看见两个衣着陌生的陌生人走近。“我们是南方群岛的伊森和约瑟夫。

paras.en: We’re so happy to find you are open.
paras.zh: 真高兴发现你们还开着门。

paras.en: We heard about your legendary cottages and sauna and were wondering if we could book one for the night?” Although he hadn’t planned on opening until the next day, Oaken understood the date didn’t have to be set in stone.
paras.zh: 我们听说你这传奇的小屋和桑拿，想着今晚能不能订一间？”虽说原定明天才开业，奥肯明白日期不必一成不变。

paras.en: The cabins were ready, and having visitors this evening would allow him to softly work out any remaining knots before the big opening. “We do, ja.” “Ethan, look.” The other fellow pointed to the awkwardly revealing yet tastefully traditional towel around Oaken’s midsection. “We are always saying that proprietors should represent the feel of an establishment.
paras.zh: 小屋已就绪，今晚来客人正能让他在大开业前悄悄理顺剩余纰漏。“能订，对吧。”“伊森，看。”另一人指着奥肯腰间那条略显暴露却考究传统的毛巾。“我们总说，店主该体现店铺的气质。

paras.en: Isn’t the towel a nice touch?” “And the shelves of unique souvenirs and beauty products, Joseph.
paras.zh: 这毛巾是不是点睛之笔？”“还有那些独特纪念品和美容产品的货架，约瑟夫。

paras.en: They are simply herlig, yes?” Oaken beamed as the Southern Islanders complimented the meticulous details of his latest achievement. “May I ask how you heard about us?” Ethan, the smaller of the two fellows, replied using his hands to illustrate his explanation. “A delivery person we were stopping for directions told us Oaken’s Family-Friendly Cozy Cottages and Sauna are not to be missed.
paras.zh: 简直太herlig了，对吧？”南方群岛人夸赞他最新成果的每个细节，奥肯笑开了花。“能问问你们怎么听说我们的吗？”两人中较矮的伊森比划着回答：“我们向一位问路的送货员打听，他说『奥肯家庭温馨小屋与桑拿房』绝不可错过。

paras.en: So here we are.” Joseph pointed to the basket of towels next to the reception desk. “Look, Ethan.
paras.zh: 所以我们来了。”约瑟夫指着接待台旁的毛巾篮。“看，伊森。

paras.en: They have adorable little mascots.” “Like Wes-Lee’s,” Ethan replied with a broad smile. “Only these fellows are much cuter than the Weselton wolverine.
paras.zh: 他们还有可爱的小吉祥物。”“跟韦斯利之家一样，”伊森咧嘴笑道，“只不过这几位比韦塞尔顿的狼獾可爱多了。

paras.en: Yes?” Oaken peered into the basket that would have been restocked if he’d known about the early guests.
paras.zh: 对吧？”奥肯朝篮子里望去——若早知有提前来的客人，他本该补过货。

paras.en: Nestled among the colorful, cozy towels were Hugo and Lars, sound asleep.
paras.zh: 在五彩温馨的毛巾中间，雨果和拉尔斯正酣睡。

paras.en: One of the visitors stroked Hugo’s ears, causing him to purr.
paras.zh: 一位访客揉了揉雨果的耳朵，逗得它呼噜起来。

paras.en: Oaken decided on the spot to keep them.
paras.zh: 奥肯当场决定把它们留下来。

paras.en: As mascots went, two nut-crazy squirrels would be easier to wrangle than a gaggle of mischievous snowgies or even one voracious reindeer. “I like this place,” Ethan declared. “We are going to tell all our friends of the Southern Isles about Oaken’s when we get home.” “And that real-live reindeer curled up on the porch—it’s just so cozy.” Joseph grinned like a kiddie in a sweet shoppe. “I may never want to leave.” “We must buy as many of these cute souvenirs as our travel trunks will fit, yes?” “Agreed.” Switching into host mode, Oaken grabbed two sets of slippers and towels and set them on the counter next to the single jar of carrot balm. “Might I invite you to start your stay with a warm cookie, a stimulating face mask, and a family sweat while I take your things to our best cottage, ja?” “Ja!” As the first guests changed and then headed into the steaming sauna, Oaken couldn’t help feeling his own glow of optimism, like a carrot-balm mask for the soul.
paras.zh: 论吉祥物，两只坚果狂松鼠可比一群调皮小雪宝、甚至一头贪吃驯鹿好管教多了。“我喜欢这地方，”伊森宣称，“回家后我们要把奥肯这地儿告诉南方群岛所有朋友。”“还有门廊上蜷着的那头真驯鹿——太惬意了。”约瑟夫笑得像糖果店里的孩子。“我可能永远不想走。”“咱得把这些可爱纪念品能塞进旅行箱多少买多少，对吧？”“同意。”奥肯切回主人模式，抓起两副拖鞋和毛巾，摆在柜台那小罐胡萝卜香膏旁。“可否请二位先以温饼干、提神面膜和家庭蒸汗开始这趟住留，我去把行李送进最好的小屋，对吧？”“对！”首批客人换好衣走进热气腾腾的桑拿时，奥肯不禁心头涌起一阵乐观的光彩，宛如给灵魂敷了层胡萝卜香膏面膜。

paras.en: While his day hadn’t gone exactly as planned, it had been successful.
paras.zh: 虽说这一天没完全按计划走，却算成功了。

paras.en: He’d gained memorable mascots, expanded his product line, and secured a trivia host for his first annual winterfest.
paras.zh: 他得到了难忘的吉祥物，拓展了产品线，还为首届年度冬庆敲定了问答主持。

paras.en: He’d also reaped the benefits of word-of-mouth advertising and satisfied his repeat customers.
paras.zh: 他还收获了口碑广告的红利，也满足了回头客。

paras.en: It reminded him of something that his granduncle Hugo was fond of quoting from his favorite storyteller: All’s good that ends good, ja?
paras.zh: 这让他想起叔祖父雨果爱引用他最爱的说书人的一句话：结局好，一切都好，对吧？

paras.en: No matter if the day turned out as planned or not, regardless of whether new ventures succeeded or failed, at the end of the day he would return home to a place of comfort and warmth, where his family would be waiting to embrace him with ample hugs.
paras.zh: 不管这一天是否按计划收场，不管新事业成败与否，到一天尽头，他总会回到那舒适温暖的家，家人正等着用满满的拥抱迎接他。

paras.en: If he happened to share even a fraction of that feeling with the guests at Oaken’s Family-Friendly Cozy Cottages and Sauna—what could be more hygge than that?
paras.zh: 若能和『奥肯家庭温馨小屋与桑拿房』的客人分享哪怕一丝这种感觉——还有什么比这更hygge的呢？

paras.en: “Nooooooooo!” Elsa screamed in horror as frost exploded from her bare fingertips and spread out over the throne room, freezing anything in its path and turning it into ice.
paras.zh: “不——！”艾莎惊恐地尖叫，冰霜从她裸露的指尖爆开，蔓延过整个王座厅，所经之处一切都被冻结、化作坚冰。

paras.en: Despite her protests, the floors, the vaulted ceiling, and the walls studded with columns and thick draperies all succumbed to the terrible bite of this swirling wintry blast.
paras.zh: 尽管她拼命抗拒，地板、拱形穹顶，还有布满了立柱和厚重帷幔的墙壁，全都在那股盘旋的寒冬狂暴之气中败下阵来。

paras.en: She’d only meant to play around and make ice sculptures, but it had gotten out of control.
paras.zh: 她只是想玩一玩，做个冰雕，可事情却失控了。

paras.en: She tried to stop it, but— to her horror —the magic kept flowing and grew stronger.
paras.zh: 她想停下，可——令她恐惧的是——魔力仍在不断涌出，而且越来越强。

paras.en: And wilder, too. “Elsa… please…” Anna whimpered, her white hair swirling around her angelic face.
paras.zh: 而且越来越狂野。“艾莎……求你了……”安娜呜咽着，洁白的发丝在她天使般的脸庞旁飘动。

paras.en: She ran toward Elsa in desperation but slipped on the black ice, collapsing in a heap. “I’m sorry…” Elsa gasped from her throne, totally in the grip of the spell spewing from her hands and freezing everything. “I can’t make it stop.… I’m trying.…” “Stop, it’s not fun anymore,” Anna said in a terrified voice.
paras.zh: 她绝望地朝艾莎跑去，却滑倒在黑冰上，摔作一团。“对不起……”艾莎从王座上喘息着，完全被双手喷涌而出、冻结一切的咒语攫住，“我停不下来……我在努力……”“停下，一点都不好玩了，”安娜用惊恐的声音说。

paras.en: Soon she’d get hit by the wintry blast enveloping the throne room. “Can’t you see?
paras.zh: 很快，她也会被笼罩王座厅的寒冬狂暴之气击中。“你难道看不出来吗？

paras.en: This is getting out of hand.” Elsa struggled harder to stem the magic flowing from her fingertips—but it backfired.
paras.zh: 这已经失控了。”艾莎更用力地想要遏制从指尖流出的魔力——却适得其反。

paras.en: Sharp icicles sprang out like daggers at Anna in a circle around her.
paras.zh: 锋利的冰柱像匕首一样从艾莎四周朝安娜射出，将她团团围住。

paras.en: One shard sliced her sister’s arm, while others shot out like knives aiming at her throat.
paras.zh: 一片碎冰划破了她妹妹的手臂，另一些则如利刃般射向她的喉咙。

paras.en: Still Elsa couldn’t stem the magic.
paras.zh: 艾莎依旧无法遏制魔力。

paras.en: She gritted her teeth and fought back, but then— Something worse happened.
paras.zh: 她咬紧牙关奋力抵抗，可接着——更可怕的事发生了。

paras.en: The frost spewing from her fingertips took on solid form, sprouting arms, spindly legs, and a mouth studded with razor-sharp icicle teeth.
paras.zh: 从她指尖喷涌的冰霜凝成了实体，长出手臂、细长的腿，还有一张布满锋利冰牙的嘴。

paras.en: The monstrous creation landed with a thud on the ice.
paras.zh: 这个怪物“咚”的一声落在冰面上。

paras.en: The snow monster whipped around and fixed on the only thing in its line of sight— Anna .
paras.zh: 雪怪猛地转过身，盯住了视野里唯一的目标——安娜。

paras.en: The creature cracked open its jagged mouth and roared, emitting a wintry gale from its throat that froze anything in its immediate path.
paras.zh: 怪物张开参差不齐的大嘴怒吼，喉咙里喷出一团寒冬狂风，所到之处瞬间冻结。

paras.en: Then it leapt at her sister. “Anna, watch out,” Elsa cried. “I’m sorry… I didn’t mean to do it—” That was when Elsa woke up with a scream on her lips, but it came out as only a sharp whisper.
paras.zh: 接着它扑向她妹妹。“安娜，小心！”艾莎喊道。“对不起……我不是故意的——”就在这时，艾莎尖叫着惊醒，可那声尖叫只化作一声急促的低语。

paras.en: She thrashed around in her bedroom in a panic.
paras.zh: 她在卧室里惊慌地翻来覆去。

paras.en: Her heart thumped with icy terror, while a deep chill shot through her body.
paras.zh: 她的心因冰冷的恐惧而狂跳，一阵寒意穿透全身。

paras.en: She blinked in the dim light of her room.
paras.zh: 她在昏暗的房间里眨了眨眼。

paras.en: She yanked her hands up, but no frost sprang from her bare fingertips.
paras.zh: 她猛地抬起双手，可裸露的指尖没有迸出冰霜。

paras.en: She was lying in bed—not in the throne room—ensconced under a tumble of silken covers.
paras.zh: 她躺在床上——而不是在王座厅——裹在一堆丝绸被褥里。

paras.en: And she wasn’t alone.
paras.zh: 而且她并不孤单。

paras.en: Anna slept soundly next to her, a thin ribbon of drool falling adorably from her rosy lips, while her messy strawberry hair exploded like a wild crown around her head.
paras.zh: 安娜在她身旁睡得正香，一缕口水从她粉嫩的嘴唇边可爱地垂下，乱蓬蓬的草莓色头发像一顶狂野的王冠般炸开在脑袋周围。

paras.en: She sighed and rolled over.
paras.zh: 她叹了口气，翻了个身。

paras.en: Elsa relaxed at the sight of her sister safe and sound— and unfrozen —though her heart still beat faster than normal from the terror of the dream.
paras.zh: 看到妹妹平安无恙——而且没有被冻住——艾莎放松下来，尽管梦中的恐惧仍让她的心跳快于平常。

paras.en: With a deep sigh, she sat up in bed.
paras.zh: 她深深叹了口气，从床上坐了起来。

paras.en: It was only a terrible nightmare.
paras.zh: 那只是一个可怕的噩梦。

paras.en: None of that was real.
paras.zh: 那些都不是真的。

paras.en: The shards and remnants were already fading, but not enough.
paras.zh: 那些碎片和残影正在消散，但还远远不够。

paras.en: She knew the reason for the dream.
paras.zh: 她知道这个梦的缘由。

paras.en: Clearly, it sprang from her darker memories, like the worst nightmares usually did.
paras.zh: 显然，它源自她那些阴暗的记忆，正如最可怕的噩梦通常那样。

paras.en: I can control it now, she reassured herself.
paras.zh: “我现在能控制它了，”她在心里安慰自己。

paras.en: It won’t get out of hand like that… ever again.
paras.zh: 它再也不会那样失控了……永远不会。

paras.en: This was also her solemn promise to Anna.
paras.zh: 这也是她对安娜郑重许下的诺言。

paras.en: She remembered how she’d accidentally frozen her sister’s heart.
paras.zh: 她想起自己曾怎样意外冻住了妹妹的心。

paras.en: The memory still haunted her.
paras.zh: 这段记忆仍在困扰着她。

paras.en: Time did not fade the horror or make it less painful.
paras.zh: 时间没能冲淡那份恐惧，也没能让痛楚减轻。

paras.en: Everything that had happened since she returned from her ice palace, unthawed the kingdom, and ascended the throne swirled through her head again like snowflakes.
paras.zh: 自从她离开冰宫归来、解冻王国、登上王座之后发生的一切，又如雪花般在她脑海里盘旋。

paras.en: For a moment she tensed up with worry and fear, but she reminded herself that it was all buried in the past.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，她因担忧和恐惧而绷紧了身体，但她提醒自己，那些都已埋葬在逝去的过去里。

paras.en: And just like her nightmare, it couldn’t hurt her now.
paras.zh: 就像她的噩梦一样，那些事现在已无法伤害她。

paras.en: But even so, she had to be careful and remain vigilant.
paras.zh: 但即便如此，她仍须小心谨慎，保持警惕。

paras.en: Elsa glanced down at her beloved Anna sleeping soundly on the pillow—a daily reminder of why Elsa had to stay in control. “You’re safe now,” she whispered to a still slumbering Anna.
paras.zh: 艾莎低头望着心爱的安娜在枕边酣睡——这是每天提醒她为何必须保持克制的理由。“你现在安全了，”她对着仍在熟睡的安娜轻声说。

paras.en: Her sister flipped over with a moan, wiped the drool, then murmured some nonsense. “Ice unicorn… you can’t fly off like that… don’t be silly… come back now… it’s time for supper.…” Elsa smiled.
paras.zh: 妹妹翻了个身，嘟囔一声，擦了擦口水，然后叽里咕噜地说着梦话：“冰霜独角兽……你不能那样飞走……别傻了……快回来……该吃晚饭了……”艾莎笑了。

paras.en: At least that sounded like a nice dream, even if the unicorn was trying to fly away.
paras.zh: 至少那听起来是个美梦，即便那只独角兽正想飞走。

paras.en: When they were kids, Anna would always beg Elsa to play with her and build a snowman.
paras.zh: 小时候，安娜总缠着艾莎陪她玩，一起堆雪人。

paras.en: She loved that her sister had this sweet, whimsical side.
paras.zh: 她喜欢妹妹身上这份甜美又异想天开的一面。

paras.en: She hoped Anna never lost it.
paras.zh: 她希望安娜永远不要失去它。

paras.en: Elsa patted her sister, pulling the covers up to let her keep sleeping.
paras.zh: 艾莎拍了拍妹妹，替她掖好被子，好让她继续睡。

paras.en: Then she rose from bed and padded over to the tall windows, thrusting the thick curtains open and letting bright sunlight spill into the large bedchamber.
paras.zh: 接着她起床，轻手轻脚走到高窗前，一把拉开厚厚的窗帘，让明亮的阳光洒进宽大的寝室。

paras.en: Dust— not snowflakes —swirled through the errant sunbeams, performing an intricate dance.
paras.zh: 尘埃——而非雪花——在斜射的阳光中打着旋，跳着一支繁复的舞。

paras.en: She marveled at the beauty of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 她惊叹于阿伦黛尔的美丽。

paras.en: It promised to be another warm day.
paras.zh: 看来又将是温暖的一天。

paras.en: And it was most welcome by everyone after the harsh, unnatural winter.
paras.zh: 在那场严酷而诡异的冬天之后，这一点最受大家欢迎。

paras.en: Across the room, Elsa caught sight of her own appearance in the dressing mirror.
paras.zh: 房间那头，艾莎从梳妆镜里瞥见了自己的模样。

paras.en: Her icy blue eyes and blond tresses gave her a captivating appearance, despite the untamed state of her hair.
paras.zh: 她冰蓝色的眼眸和金色长发令她美得摄人心魄，尽管头发还没来得及打理。

paras.en: She raised her hands and fluttered them.
paras.zh: 她举起双手，轻轻摆动。

paras.en: No unbidden magic burst from her bare fingertips.
paras.zh: 没有不受控制的魔力从裸露的指尖迸出。

paras.en: She didn’t even need to wear her protective gloves anymore.
paras.zh: 她甚至不再需要戴那副防护手套了。

paras.en: And she didn’t miss them.
paras.zh: 而且她也不怀念它们。

paras.en: Next to the mirror and dressing stand stood a mannequin fitted with a pale blue gown with a shimmering, translucent cape.
paras.zh: 镜子与梳妆台旁立着一个模特，身上穿着一件淡蓝色礼服，配着一条微微闪光、半透明的披风。

paras.en: Everything appeared in order; nothing seemed amiss.
paras.zh: 一切看来井然有序，似乎并无异样。

paras.en: Her nightmare was powerless in the warm sunlight, which melted the last shadowy tendrils away, taking the bad memories with it.
paras.zh: 她的噩梦在温暖阳光下毫无力量，阳光消融了最后几缕阴影，也带走了那些糟糕的记忆。

paras.en: Elsa relaxed and yawned, gazing through the window at her kingdom.
paras.zh: 艾莎放松下来，打了个哈欠，透过窗户凝望着自己的王国。

paras.en: Outside the castle walls the sun rose higher, warming everything that its radiant light touched.
paras.zh: 城堡之外，太阳越升越高，用它耀眼的光芒温暖着所触及的一切。

paras.en: Winter was a distant memory, and Arendelle was thriving again.
paras.zh: 冬天已是遥远的回忆，阿伦黛尔重新繁荣起来。

paras.en: She could see down to the castle gates, open ever since her return, when she’d thawed the lands from the extreme winter she had accidentally unleashed, brought back summer, and reclaimed her throne, inherited from her parents.
paras.zh: 她能望见城堡大门，自从她归来后便一直敞开着——那时她融化了由自己意外引发的极端寒冬，唤回夏天，重新坐上从父母那里继承的王座。

paras.en: Even though she had grown up in the castle with this view, it never grew old—and it never ceased to amaze her.
paras.zh: 尽管她在这座城堡里看着这样的景致长大，它却从不令她厌倦——也始终让她惊叹。

paras.en: Beyond the gates the village teemed with life.
paras.zh: 大门之外，村庄里生机勃勃。

paras.en: Folks meandered down the cobblestone streets, chatting with one another as they sold and purchased wares and supplies, while beyond the busy town streets, the luscious green farmland spread out and blossomed with crops that would sustain them and keep them fed whenever winter eventually did return—a natural winter.
paras.zh: 人们在鹅卵石街道上悠然漫步，边走边聊，买卖着货物与用品；而在繁忙的镇街之外，丰饶的绿色农田铺展开来，作物茁壮生长，无论将来冬天——一个自然的冬天——终究回归时，都能养活他们、让他们有饭吃。

paras.en: It had been scarcely a month since the great thaw, but life in Arendelle had been peaceful, sunlit, and carefree.
paras.zh: 大融雪至今才不过一个月，但阿伦黛尔的生活一直安宁、阳光明媚而无忧无虑。

paras.en: The frost had stayed away.
paras.zh: 冰霜一直未曾来袭。

paras.en: And Elsa knew the reason.
paras.zh: 艾莎知道原因。

paras.en: She had gained full control of her powers.
paras.zh: 她已完全掌控了自己的力量。

paras.en: They worked for her now, not the other way around.
paras.zh: 如今它们为她所用，而非反过来受制于它们。

paras.en: All had been quiet.… Almost too quiet.
paras.zh: 一切都很平静……平静得几乎过头了。

paras.en: Then last week, the whispers had started.
paras.zh: 然后，上周，窃窃私语开始了。

paras.en: The rumors spread to the castle gates.
paras.zh: 流言传到了城堡大门。

paras.en: The farmers spoke of a strange frost spreading from the North Mountain and chilling their crops, freezing them down to the roots, causing blight and endangering the summer harvest.
paras.zh: 农夫们说起一种奇怪的冰霜正从北山蔓延开来，侵冷他们的庄稼，一直冻到根部，造成枯萎，危及夏日的收成。

paras.en: Despite the sun’s warmth, everyone knew that fall would come eventually, and then, following on crisp heels would be winter’s natural return.
paras.zh: 尽管阳光温暖，但人人都知道秋天终会到来，紧接着，冬天便会自然而然地回归。

paras.en: For this was a land of many seasons.
paras.zh: 因为这本就是一个四季分明的国度。

paras.en: But the rumors spoke of something different and dangerous.
paras.zh: 但流言传说的却是另一回事，既异常又危险。

paras.en: Some gossip even blamed the queen for this unnatural frost, though Elsa knew it wasn’t her doing this time.
paras.zh: 有些闲言碎语甚至把这场反常的冰霜归咎于女王，尽管艾莎知道这次并非她所为。

paras.en: Her eyes darted to the North Mountain, capped with snow and looming over them, where she’d erected her ice palace.
paras.zh: 她的目光猛地投向那座白雪覆盖、巍然耸立的北山——她曾在那里建起自己的冰宫。

paras.en: She hadn’t been back since her return to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 自从回到阿伦黛尔，她再没回去过。

paras.en: No, this freeze wasn’t coming from her.
paras.zh: 不，这场冰冻并非来自她。

paras.en: Or was it?
paras.zh: 还是说，是她？

paras.en: Suddenly snowflakes burst from her fingertips, melting harmlessly in the bright sunlight, then falling like tiny droplets on the floor.
paras.zh: 突然，雪花从她指尖迸出，在明亮阳光下无害地融化，然后像细小的水珠般落在地上。

paras.en: Then the flurries stopped falling.
paras.zh: 接着，那阵飞雪停了。

paras.en: No, it wasn’t her.
paras.zh: 不，不是她。

paras.en: She was sure of it.
paras.zh: 她对此确信无疑。

paras.en: She still had control.
paras.zh: 她依然掌控着自己的力量。

paras.en: She could turn it on and off like a faucet.
paras.zh: 她能像开关水龙头一样随心收放。

paras.en: Could the frost be natural? she wondered for the hundredth time that week, gazing down at the sprawling farmlands.
paras.zh: “这冰霜会不会是自然的？”那一星期里，她第无数次这样思忖，目光落在广袤的农田上。

paras.en: But no, it was too early for that.
paras.zh: 可不，现在还太早了。

paras.en: Fall hadn’t even touched the leaves yet, tinting them into a blast of color, then making them wither, crackle, and fall like dry rain.
paras.zh: 秋天甚至还没染上树叶，让它们绽放绚烂色彩，再枯萎、脆裂，如干雨般飘落。

paras.en: Still, the rumors and gossip had a cause.
paras.zh: 不过，流言与闲话总有起因。

paras.en: Something had spooked the farmers.
paras.zh: 一定有是什么惊吓了农夫们。

paras.en: And it needed to be addressed sooner rather than later, before it infected the whole kingdom.
paras.zh: 而且必须尽早查个明白，在它波及整个王国之前。

paras.en: That was when she spotted Sven and Kristoff galloping down the road toward the village.
paras.zh: 就在这时，她瞥见斯文和克里斯托夫沿路奔驰而来，朝村庄而去。

paras.en: Their sled had wheels now, fitted for summer travel.
paras.zh: 他们的雪橇如今装上了轮子，好适应夏日出行。

paras.en: Her heart leapt at the promise of their return.
paras.zh: 想到他们即将归来，她的心雀跃起来。

paras.en: Last week she had asked Kristoff and Sven to investigate the rumors on their next ice delivery run.
paras.zh: 上周，她已请克里斯托夫和斯文在下次送冰的途中调查这些流言。

paras.en: She still hoped that it was merely superstition and gossip fueling the rumors, but she feared it was something more.
paras.zh: 她仍希望流言只是由迷信和闲话催生，却又担心另有隐情。

paras.en: With that ominous worry, Elsa got dressed in a hurry, rushing from the castle and leaving Anna to her slumber and sweet unicorn-filled dreams.
paras.zh: 带着这不详的忧虑，艾莎匆匆更衣，冲出城堡，留下安娜继续安睡，做着满是独角兽的甜梦。

paras.en: Elsa ventured into the village, her light blue cape trailing behind her.
paras.zh: 艾莎走进村庄，淡蓝色的披风在身后飘曳。

paras.en: She waved to passersby. “Your Majesty,” they answered her greeting, nodding respectfully to her.
paras.zh: 她向路人挥手致意。“陛下，”人们回应着她的问候，向她恭敬地点头。

paras.en: But something turned their lips downward into frowns.
paras.zh: 可有什么让他们的嘴角向下，皱起了眉头。

paras.en: Something made them wary.
paras.zh: 有什么让他们心存戒备。

paras.en: This unsettled her.
paras.zh: 这让她不安。

paras.en: Usually the villagers chattered in excitement whenever she ventured from the castle and joined their throngs in the bustling streets.
paras.zh: 往常，只要她走出城堡、汇入喧闹街头的众人之中，村民们总会兴奋地叽叽喳喳说个不停。

paras.en: But maybe she was just being paranoid and imagining it.
paras.zh: 但也许只是她自己多疑，凭空想像罢了。

paras.en: Still, it continued to bother her as she proceeded through the town.
paras.zh: 然而，穿行镇中时，这事仍让她耿耿于怀。

paras.en: At the hitching posts she spotted a familiar tall figure with floppy sandy-blond hair.
paras.zh: 在拴马桩旁，她瞥见一个熟悉的瘦高身影，顶着一头蓬乱的沙金色头发。

paras.en: She smiled at the sight of him.
paras.zh: 看到他，她笑了。

paras.en: He always seemed in dire need of a haircut, but that appeared to be part of his easy charm.
paras.zh: 他似乎总急需理个发，但那似乎也正是他随性魅力的一部分。

paras.en: It was Kristoff—and he was never far from Sven.
paras.zh: 是克里斯托夫——而他从不离斯文左右。

paras.en: The duo stood next to their lacquered sled, a gift from her sister.
paras.zh: 这二人站在他们的漆面雪橇旁，那是她妹妹送的礼物。

paras.en: The back was packed with fresh harvest from the local farms.
paras.zh: 雪橇后厢装满了当地农庄的新鲜收成。

paras.en: In addition to hauling ice, they ferried food and supplies from the local farms to the shops in the village.
paras.zh: 除了运送冰块，他们还把食物和物资从当地农庄运往村里的店铺。

paras.en: Sven especially loved his new job, since it came with one extra-big perk. “Carrot?” Elsa said as her way of greeting them, sauntering up and offering one to the reindeer from the sled.
paras.zh: 斯文尤其喜欢他的新工作，因为还附带一个超大好处。“胡萝卜？”艾莎这样向他们打招呼，慢悠悠走上前，从雪橇上拿了一根递给那头驯鹿。

paras.en: Kristoff always kept a burlap sack of them on hand.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫总在手边备着一袋胡萝卜。

paras.en: Sven chomped on it heartily, flashing one of his signature goofy grins, complete with his long, sloppy tongue licking at his lips.
paras.zh: 斯文欢快地大嚼起来，露出他招牌式的傻笑，长而邋遢的舌头还舔着嘴唇。

paras.en: He seemed to be thanking her without Kristoff’s voice actually giving words to it. “Oh, I see how it is,” Kristoff said, pretending to be offended. “Sven gets all the attention around here.
paras.zh: 他似乎在表达谢意，却不用克里斯托夫替他出声。“哦，我明白了，”克里斯托夫假装被冷落地说，“在这儿，所有的关注都给斯文了。

paras.en: And what about me?” “Well, he is the better-looking one,” Elsa said playfully.
paras.zh: “那我呢？”“嗯，他确实比较好看嘛，”艾莎俏皮地说。

paras.en: Sven basked in her attention and seemed to smile.
paras.zh: 斯文沐浴在她的关注中，似乎在微笑。

paras.en: They both laughed. “Plus, isn’t giving you attention Anna’s job?” Elsa teased, making Kristoff blush.
paras.zh: 两人都笑了。“再说，关注你不是安娜的活儿吗？”艾莎打趣道，惹得克里斯托夫红了脸。

paras.en: But then she turned serious. “Something’s got the villagers spooked today.
paras.zh: 可接着她神色一正。“今天有什么把村民们吓着了。

paras.en: Is it the rumors?” Kristoff frowned, matching her somber mood. “I’m sorry to report… it’s as you feared.” The words hit Elsa like an icy dagger. “The frost?
paras.zh: 是那些流言吗？”克里斯托夫皱起眉，与她同样凝重。“很遗憾地报告……正如你所担心的那样。”这话像一把冰刃刺中艾莎。“冰霜？

paras.en: Blighting the crops?” “Yes, I’ve been all over Arendelle to the farms and smaller villages on the outskirts of the lands.
paras.zh: “在糟蹋庄稼？”“是的，我跑遍了阿伦黛尔，去了领地边缘的农庄和更小的村落。

paras.en: They’re all afraid.
paras.zh: 它们都害怕了。

paras.en: Something’s freezing their crops.
paras.zh: 有什么在冻结他们的庄稼。

paras.en: It’s worse near the North Mountain.” Elsa felt another stab of worry.
paras.zh: 靠近北山的地方更厉害。”艾莎心头又是一阵担忧。

paras.en: Even Sven looked concerned with this news. “But what’s causing it?
paras.zh: 连斯文听到这消息也显得关切。“可这到底是什么原因？

paras.en: The sun shines nonstop since the great thaw.
paras.zh: 大融雪之后，太阳就没停过。

paras.en: It’s too warm for any frost.” “Right, that’s the real mystery,” Kristoff said with a sigh. “The only snow clings to the highest peak on the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 天气太暖，本不该有冰霜。”“对，这才是真正的谜团，”克里斯托夫叹了口气说，“唯一还留着雪的，只有北山最高的峰顶。

paras.en: The elevation keeps it frozen, even in summer.
paras.zh: 那是海拔高，才能终年不化，即便在夏天。

paras.en: But they say that this is afflicting the farmlands in the lower altitudes.
paras.zh: 可他们说，受灾的是低海拔的农田。

paras.en: It doesn’t make any sense.” They both turned to look at the towering mountain in the distance.
paras.zh: 这说不通啊。”两人都转头望向远处那座巍峨的山。

paras.en: That was where Elsa had built her ice palace when she ran away and let it all go.
paras.zh: 那里正是艾莎当年出走、放任自己时建起冰宫的地方。

paras.en: They didn’t often speak of that time in her life, when she’d found her true self but also inadvertently hurt those she loved the most.
paras.zh: 他们并不常提起她生命中的那段时光——那时她找到了真实的自我，却也不经意间伤害了最爱的人。

paras.en: But the unspoken memory hung in the silence between them.
paras.zh: 但那份未说出口的记忆，悬在他们之间的沉默里。

paras.en: She hadn’t been back to the North Mountain since that time.
paras.zh: 自那以后，她再没回过北山。

paras.en: She wasn’t sure that she wanted to go back, either.
paras.zh: 她也不确定自己想不想回去。

paras.en: She pulled her gaze away and turned toward Kristoff.
paras.zh: 她移开目光，转向克里斯托夫。

paras.en: His face looked pinched and worried.
paras.zh: 他的脸显得紧绷而忧心。

paras.en: She could tell that he wasn’t telling her something. “What is it?” she said, nudging his shoulder. “Spit it out already.
paras.zh: 她看得出来，他有事瞒着她。“是什么事？”她说着用肩轻轻碰了碰他，“快说出来嘛。

paras.en: You know, I’m your queen.
paras.zh: 你知道，我是你的女王。

paras.en: I can order you to speak,” she teased.
paras.zh: 我可以命令你开口，”她打趣道。

paras.en: Sven gave Kristoff a hard look.
paras.zh: 斯文狠狠瞪了克里斯托夫一眼。

paras.en: Another moment passed before he broached it. “I didn’t want to tell you,” he said, scratching his head awkwardly and not meeting her gaze. “But some folks… are blaming you.
paras.zh: 又过了一会儿，他才开口。“我不想告诉你，”他尴尬地挠着头，不敢看她的眼睛，“可有些人……在怪你。

paras.en: They speak of an old myth about a frost creature.
paras.zh: 他们说起一个关于霜之生物的古老传说。

paras.en: They think maybe the myths are talking about you.
paras.zh: 他们认为那些传说说的可能就是你。

paras.en: But it’s just superstitious nonsense.” “Me?” she said in surprise, feeling her heart plunge in her chest. “But I swear, this isn’t my doing.
paras.zh: 但这只是迷信的胡说八道。”“我？”她惊讶地说，感到心往下一沉，“可我发誓，这绝非我所为。

paras.en: I have control now.
paras.zh: 如今我能控制了。

paras.en: Look, the sun is shining.
paras.zh: 看，阳光正盛。

paras.en: The temperatures rise each day.
paras.zh: 气温一天天升高。

paras.en: Summer has returned and will stay for some time.” “Of course—you’re right.
paras.zh: 夏天已经回来，还会停留一阵。”“当然——你说得对。

paras.en: I know it’s not you,” Kristoff said, as Sven nodded in agreement. “But the villagers are superstitious.
paras.zh: 我知道不是你，”克里斯托夫说，斯文也点头附和，“可村民们很迷信。

paras.en: They still remember the great freeze—and how they almost lost everything to the frost.
paras.zh: 他们还记着那场大冰封——以及他们几乎因冰霜失去一切的情形。

paras.en: They fear it could be happening again.” Elsa remembered the frowns and suspicious looks cast her way as she wandered down the cobblestone streets today.
paras.zh: 他们害怕这一切重演。”艾莎想起今天自己走在鹅卵石街上时，人们投向她的皱眉与怀疑目光。

paras.en: So it hadn’t been her imagination.
paras.zh: 所以那并非她的幻觉。

paras.en: They still feared her— and more so , they feared the magic that lived within her.
paras.zh: 他们仍惧怕她——更确切地说，他们惧怕的是她体内潜藏的魔力。

paras.en: No amount of reassurance would change that.
paras.zh: 再多的安慰也无法改变这一点。

paras.en: There was only one solution.
paras.zh: 只有一个办法。

paras.en: She had to find the source of this mysterious frost.
paras.zh: 她必须找到这神秘冰霜的源头。

paras.en: And put a stop to it.
paras.zh: 并让它停下来。

paras.en: And fast. “Then I must leave at once to investigate it,” Elsa started, but Kristoff stopped her. “No, Sven and I will go,” he said firmly. “We need to make some returns anyway.
paras.zh: 而且要快。”“那么我必须立刻动身去调查，”艾莎刚开口，克里斯托夫就拦住了她。“不，斯文和我会去，”他坚定地说，“反正我们也得去送些回程货。

paras.en: Also, they’re more likely to confide in me and tell the truth.
paras.zh: 而且，他们更可能对我吐露实情。

paras.en: Maybe I can find out the cause—and stop it before it gets out of hand.
paras.zh: 也许我能查出原因——在它失控之前将其阻止。

paras.en: Hopefully, it’s just superstitions amplified by fear and rumors.” “And if not?” she asked, biting her lip. “What if it’s real?” “Then we’ll find a way to stop it,” Kristoff said. “After all, we’ve faced worse before.” Kristoff was right.
paras.zh: 但愿只是被恐惧和流言放大的迷信。”“若不是呢？”她咬着嘴唇问，“如果它是真的呢？”“那我们也会想办法阻止它，”克里斯托夫说，“毕竟，我们以前面对过更糟的。”克里斯托夫说得对。

paras.en: This problem they could handle.
paras.zh: 这个问题他们能对付。

paras.en: Crops naturally froze when fall turned sharply to winter anyway.
paras.zh: 毕竟，当秋天骤然转入冬天，庄稼本就会自然冻伤。

paras.en: But frozen hearts were something else.
paras.zh: 但被冻住的心却是另一回事。

paras.en: They could not be easily mended.
paras.zh: 那可不容易修补。

paras.en: Only an act of pure love could thaw them.
paras.zh: 唯有纯粹的爱的举动才能将其融化。

paras.en: Suddenly a group of kids ran by, giggling and chasing after one another.
paras.zh: 突然，一群孩子笑着跑过，互相追逐。

paras.en: But then their eyes fell on Elsa.
paras.zh: 可随后他们的目光落在了艾莎身上。

paras.en: They skidded to a halt; their giggles ceased.
paras.zh: 他们猛地停下脚步，笑声戛然而止。

paras.en: Their mother hurried over and shooed them away with a deferential bow and a “Your Majesty.” Kristoff climbed into his sled and tossed the kids some fresh apples from the bushels in the back.
paras.zh: 他们的母亲匆匆赶来，恭敬地行了个礼，说了句“陛下”，便把孩子们哄走了。克里斯托夫爬上雪橇，从后厢的果筐里抓了些新鲜苹果抛给孩子们。

paras.en: But they were afraid of her.
paras.zh: 可他们怕她。

paras.en: That meant even the children must have heard the rumors.
paras.zh: 这意味着连孩子们都一定听说了那些流言。

paras.en: However, before she could dwell on it, a familiar voice reverberated through the streets.
paras.zh: 然而，她还没来得及多想，一个熟悉的声音便在街巷间回荡开来。

paras.en: And it was most welcome. “There you are—I’ve been looking everywhere for you.” It was Anna.
paras.zh: 那声音最受欢迎了。“原来你在这儿——我到处找你呢。”是安娜。

paras.en: She wore a beautiful, light, summery sheath paired with soft brown leather boots.
paras.zh: 她穿着一件轻盈美丽的夏日连衣裙，配着柔软的棕色皮靴。

paras.en: A chartreuse cloak that matched her dress was draped elegantly across her shoulders. “Are you off again so soon?” she asked when her eyes fell on Kristoff in his sled.
paras.zh: 一件与衣裙相配的黄绿色斗篷优雅地披在肩头。“你这么快又要走？”她的目光落在雪橇上的克里斯托夫身上，问道。

paras.en: Anna looked disappointed.
paras.zh: 安娜显得有些失望。

paras.en: The love between them was utterly infectious.
paras.zh: 他们之间的爱意极具感染力。

paras.en: It warmed Elsa’s heart, as always.
paras.zh: 一如往常，这温暖了艾莎的心。

paras.en: Seeing her sister happy was the single most important thing in the world to her. “Right, Elsa has a little mission for me,” Kristoff said, while Sven snorted. “Something about a mysterious frost and rumors in the farmlands.
paras.zh: 看到妹妹幸福，是她在这世上最看重的事。“对，艾莎给我派了个小任务，”克里斯托夫说，斯文在一旁喷着鼻息，“是关于农田里那场神秘冰霜和流言的事。

paras.en: It shouldn’t take long.” “Well, then, care for some company?” Anna said, sliding onto the seat next to Kristoff and assuming her place.
paras.zh: “应该花不了多久。”“那，介意有人作伴吗？”安娜说着，滑坐到克里斯托夫身旁的位子上，占了她的位置。

paras.en: It wasn’t a question.
paras.zh: 这可不是在征求意见。

paras.en: Clearly, she was going with him. “Seriously, mysterious frost sounds… exciting,” she added with an impish grin, resting her boots on his lacquered sled, much to Kristoff’s dismay. “I need some fresh air.
paras.zh: 显然，她是要跟他去。“说真的，神秘冰霜听起来……很刺激嘛，”她淘气地咧嘴一笑，补充道，把靴子搭在他的漆面雪橇上，让克里斯托夫一脸无奈，“我需要点新鲜空气。

paras.en: And some fun.” “Anna, I don’t know if that’s a good idea.…” Elsa started.
paras.zh: “还有点乐子。”“安娜，我不确定这是不是个好主意……”艾莎开口道。

paras.en: But her sister gave her that look.
paras.zh: 可妹妹给了她那个眼神。

paras.en: The stubborn one.
paras.zh: 那个固执的眼神。

paras.en: The one that meant she wouldn’t change her mind. “You’re right.
paras.zh: 那个表示她绝不会回心转意的眼神。“你说得对。

paras.en: It’s not a good idea—it’s a great idea,” Anna said, with a smirk. “Summer is delightful.
paras.zh: 这不是个好主意——这是个绝妙的主意，”安娜得意地笑着说，“夏天真惬意。

paras.en: Olaf loves it.
paras.zh: 雪宝喜欢夏天。

paras.en: But I miss a little adventure.” “Would a no dissuade you from coming along?” Kristoff asked with a wink.
paras.zh: 可我有点想念冒险了。”“说个‘不行’，能劝退你别跟着去吗？”克里斯托夫眨眨眼问。

paras.en: Sven raised his eyebrows, warning Kristoff that he was treading on dangerous territory. “Listen, I’m your princess,” Anna said, slipping into a faux authoritative tone. “That means I give the orders, not the other way around.
paras.zh: 斯文扬起眉毛，警告克里斯托夫他正踩在危险地带。“听着，我是你的公主，”安娜摆出一副假正经的权威腔调，“这意味着下令的是我，而不是反过来。

paras.en: I’m coming—and that’s final.” They all laughed at this repartee.
paras.zh: 我就是要去——这事没得商量。”这番妙语逗得大家直笑。

paras.en: But then Anna grinned at Kristoff. “Plus, admit it—you missed me.” “What do you mean?
paras.zh: 可接着安娜冲克里斯托夫咧嘴一笑。“还有，承认吧——你想我了。”“你这是什么意思？

paras.en: Sven is great company,” Kristoff said.
paras.zh: 斯文是很棒的伙伴啊，”克里斯托夫说。

paras.en: The reindeer grinned, but then he backpedaled when Anna glanced at him. “Also, you don’t even need to ask that.
paras.zh: 驯鹿咧嘴笑了，可安娜瞥他一眼，他又连忙改口。“再说了，你根本不用问这个。

paras.en: You know that I always miss you.
paras.zh: 你明知道我一直都想你。

paras.en: And so does Sven.” Sven snorted, while Anna leaned over and kissed his furry cheek with her rosy lips, making the reindeer dip his head bashfully.
paras.zh: 斯文也是。”斯文喷了喷鼻息，安娜俯身用粉嫩的嘴唇亲了亲他毛茸茸的脸颊，惹得驯鹿羞怯地低下了头。

paras.en: But then Sven licked her with his long tongue.
paras.zh: 可接着斯文用长舌头舔了她一下。

paras.en: It was both gross and utterly charming.
paras.zh: 那既恶心又十足可爱。

paras.en: Anna wiped it off with a giggle, then tossed him another carrot, which he crunched happily.
paras.zh: 安娜咯咯笑着擦掉，又扔给他一根胡萝卜，他开心地咔嚓咔嚓嚼起来。

paras.en: She also obliged Kristoff with a kiss on his cheek.
paras.zh: 她也赏了克里斯托夫一个脸颊吻。

paras.en: Elsa knew better than to try to talk any of them out of this adventure.
paras.zh: 艾莎很清楚，劝他们任何一人放弃这趟冒险都是徒劳。

paras.en: Plus, Kristoff was right.
paras.zh: 况且，克里斯托夫说得对。

paras.en: Maybe they could help her and get to the bottom of what was causing the rumors. “Fine, but don’t be gone too long,” Elsa said. “Promise?” “Promise,” they said in unison.
paras.zh: 也许他们能帮上她，查清流言的起因。“好吧，但别离开太久，”艾莎说，“答应我？”“答应，”他们齐声说。

paras.en: Elsa watched them gallop away into the late afternoon sunlight, then returned to the castle.
paras.zh: 艾莎望着他们驰入午后渐斜的阳光中，然后回到了城堡。

paras.en: They were brave, intelligent, and strong-willed.
paras.zh: 他们勇敢、机敏，且意志坚定。

paras.en: If anyone could get to the bottom of this problem, it was them.
paras.zh: 若说有谁能查清这个问题，那一定是他们。

paras.en: But even so, Elsa had a bad feeling about it—actually… about everything, suddenly.
paras.zh: 但即便如此，艾莎对此有种不祥的预感——其实……是对一切，忽然间。

paras.en: She felt a chill despite the hot sun beating down on her back.
paras.zh: 尽管烈日灼烤着她的后背，她仍感到一阵寒意。

paras.en: Magic swirled in the complex tangle of emotions, threatening to burst from her fingertips.
paras.zh: 魔力在错综复杂的情绪中盘旋，随时可能从指尖迸出。

paras.en: But she fought to slow her racing heart and keep her powers under control.
paras.zh: 但她努力平复狂跳的心，将力量控制在掌握之中。

paras.en: A few deep breaths and she finally calmed her heart, and magic.
paras.zh: 几次深呼吸后，她终于让心——和魔力——都平静下来。

paras.en: The chill left her body.
paras.zh: 寒意离她而去。

paras.en: But one thing was clear— This had to be remedied.
paras.zh: 但有一点很清楚——这事必须得到解决。

paras.en: And fast, before the rumors spread further into Arendelle.
paras.zh: 而且要快，趁流言尚未进一步蔓延到阿伦黛尔深处。

paras.en: Two days passed without Anna and Kristoff’s return.
paras.zh: 两天过去，安娜和克里斯托夫仍未归来。

paras.en: On the third day, Elsa began to worry something terrible had happened.
paras.zh: 到了第三天，艾莎开始担心发生了可怕的事。

paras.en: She woke to the sounds of a ruckus beyond the castle gates.
paras.zh: 她被城堡大门外的喧闹声惊醒。

paras.en: She ran to the window from her empty bed and thrust open the curtains—just in time to see Sven dash toward the castle, still pulling his sled.… Only it was empty.
paras.zh: 她从空荡的床上跑到窗前，一把拉开窗帘——刚好看见斯文拽着雪橇朝城堡飞奔而来……只是雪橇上空空如也。

paras.en: There was no sign of Kristoff or Anna.
paras.zh: 不见克里斯托夫，也不见安娜。

paras.en: Elsa felt her heart plummet as icy shivers plunged through her veins.
paras.zh: 艾莎的心猛地一沉，冰冷的战栗顺着血管窜遍全身。

paras.en: Worse, Sven had a spooked look in his eyes.
paras.zh: 更糟的是，斯文的眼里满是惊惶。

paras.en: The poor reindeer was… terrified .
paras.zh: 那可怜的驯鹿……吓坏了。

paras.en: Something awful had happened.
paras.zh: 一定发生了可怕的事。

paras.en: Elsa dressed quickly, grabbed her cloak, and then rushed down the stairs.
paras.zh: 艾莎迅速穿衣，抓起披风，冲下楼梯。

paras.en: On her way out of the castle, she heard a familiar voice echo through the halls after her. “Elsa… wait up,” Olaf said, scrambling to catch her. “Hurry, something has happened,” she said.
paras.zh: 正要出城堡，她听见一个熟悉的声音在身后廊间回响。“艾莎……等等，”雪宝说，手忙脚乱地追上她。“快，出事了，”她说。

paras.en: He waddled faster. “You know, it’s hard to run without proper legs.” They burst outside, and Elsa rushed over to Sven, who was stamping around and looking really upset in the courtyard. “Sven… what happened?” she said, trying to calm the poor reindeer.
paras.zh: 他加快了摇摆的步子。“你知道，没有像样的腿跑起来可真难。”他们冲到外面，艾莎奔向斯文，他正在院子里跺着脚，显得万分焦躁。“斯文……发生什么了？”她边说边想安抚这可怜的驯鹿。

paras.en: She reached into the burlap sack in the sleigh for a carrot, but then pulled her hand back with a start.
paras.zh: 她伸手到雪橇上的麻袋里掏胡萝卜，却猛地抽回了手。

paras.en: The carrot was… frozen .
paras.zh: 那根胡萝卜……冻住了。

paras.en: Ice crystals clung to the delicate green fronds.
paras.zh: 冰晶附着在娇嫩的绿色叶梢上。

paras.en: How could this be? “The frost?” she whispered to Sven, holding up the carrot.
paras.zh: 这怎么可能？“是冰霜？”她举起胡萝卜，对着斯文低语。

paras.en: Sven nodded and pawed the ground.
paras.zh: 斯文点了点头，用蹄子刨着地面。

paras.en: It wasn’t just a superstitious rumor—it was real.
paras.zh: 那不只是迷信的流言——它是真的。

paras.en: Something had frozen the carrots.
paras.zh: 真有什么冻住了这些胡萝卜。

paras.en: She noticed strange marks on Sven’s back. “Good boy, Sven.
paras.zh: 她注意到斯文背上有奇怪的痕迹。“好孩子，斯文。

paras.en: Steady now,” Elsa said, investigating the markings seared into his hide.
paras.zh: “先稳住，”艾莎说着，察看着烙在他皮毛上的印记。

paras.en: She looked up at him with in concern. “Frost burns?
paras.zh: 她抬起头，担忧地望着他。“冻伤？

paras.en: But… how?” Again, Sven nodded emphatically and pawed the ground.
paras.zh: “可……怎么会？”斯文再次用力点头，刨着地面。

paras.en: Olaf cowered behind her.
paras.zh: 雪宝缩在她身后。

paras.en: He seemed worried, too.
paras.zh: 他似乎也忧心忡忡。

paras.en: Elsa thought back to the superstitions. “You mean the Frost Monster is real?” she asked. “Does it have Anna and Kristoff?” Sven nodded, looking afraid.
paras.zh: 艾莎回想起那些迷信说法。“你是说霜怪是真的？”她问，“它抓走了安娜和克里斯托夫？”斯文点了点头，一脸害怕。

paras.en: Elsa struggled to make sense of it.
paras.zh: 艾莎努力想理清头绪。

paras.en: Frost creature myths were stories told to frighten children and keep them from running off into wintry blizzards.
paras.zh: 霜之生物的传说，是用来吓唬孩子、不让他们跑进冬日暴风雪的故事。

paras.en: She had assumed they were simply that—myths.
paras.zh: 她原以为那不过如此——只是传说。

paras.en: But the strange frost afflicting the farmlands… the rumors and gossip… the frozen carrots… the ice burns on Sven’s back… and now, Kristoff and Anna were missing.
paras.zh: 可那侵扰农田的诡异冰霜……流言与闲话……冻住的胡萝卜……斯文背上的冻伤……而现在，克里斯托夫和安娜又失踪了。

paras.en: Something had to be causing all of it.
paras.zh: 一定有是什么引发了这一切。

paras.en: Elsa made a snap decision. “Olaf, come on.
paras.zh: 艾莎当即做出决定。“雪宝，过来。

paras.en: You’re coming with me.
paras.zh: 你跟我一起去。

paras.en: We’ve got to find Kristoff and Anna—and rescue them from the Frost Monster.
paras.zh: 我们必须找到克里斯托夫和安娜——把他们从霜怪手中救出来。

paras.en: They’re in grave danger.” “Oh, yay, that sounds like fun!” Olaf said, hopping up into the sled enthusiastically. “Except the frost part.
paras.zh: 他们处境危险。”“哦，好耶，听起来很有趣！”雪宝兴奋地蹦上雪橇，“除了冰霜那部分。

paras.en: And the monster part.
paras.zh: 还有怪物那部分。

paras.en: And the Kristoff-and-Anna-in-danger part.” Elsa slid next to Olaf and took hold of the reins. “Sven, take us to Kristoff and Anna.
paras.zh: 还有克里斯托夫和安娜身处险境那部分。”艾莎滑到雪宝身旁，握住了缰绳。“斯文，带我们去找克里斯托夫和安娜。

paras.en: And hurry.” Sven pulled them away from the castle, retracing his steps.
paras.zh: 快。”斯文拉着他们离开城堡，循着原路折返。

paras.en: He led them to the outskirts of a farm.
paras.zh: 他把他们带到一座农庄的外围。

paras.en: But the crops were wilted and blackened from frost.
paras.zh: 可庄稼已被冰霜冻得枯萎发黑。

paras.en: Icicles dripped from the delicate fronds.
paras.zh: 冰柱从娇嫩的叶梢上滴落。

paras.en: But how?
paras.zh: 可这怎么可能？

paras.en: The summer season remained strong.
paras.zh: 盛夏时节正盛。

paras.en: Bright sunlight shone down on the fields.
paras.zh: 明媚的阳光洒在田野上。

paras.en: A farmer came out, looking afraid.
paras.zh: 一个农夫走了出来，神色惶恐。

paras.en: He had blond hair and blue eyes and wore stained coveralls and boots.
paras.zh: 他金发蓝眼，穿着沾了污渍的连体工装和靴子。

paras.en: He looked surprised to see the queen there.
paras.zh: 看到女王在此，他显得惊讶。

paras.en: He quickly bowed his head. “Your Majesty…” “What’s causing this ruin?” Elsa asked, indicating the decimated fields.
paras.zh: 他连忙低下头。“陛下……”“是什么造成了这场毁坏？”艾莎指着被毁的田地问。

paras.en: Fear lit up his eyes. “Your Majesty, it comes in the night.
paras.zh: 恐惧在他眼中燃起。“陛下，它是夜里来的。

paras.en: It has bright blue eyes that burn like sapphires.
paras.zh: 它有一双明亮的蓝眼睛，像蓝宝石般灼灼发光。

paras.en: And scraggly stick hands.
paras.zh: 还有枯瘦如柴的树枝手臂。

paras.en: It comes in the darkness to lay waste to all in its path.” “Stick hands?” Olaf said, raising his tiny twig hands.
paras.zh: 它趁黑而来，所过之处尽数化为废墟。”“树枝手臂？”雪宝举起自己细小的树枝手说。

paras.en: His big eyes took on the sheen of worry.
paras.zh: 他的大眼睛蒙上一层担忧的光泽。

paras.en: But the farmer shook his head. “Longer and sharper, like daggers,” he said, raising his arms. “And I can’t forget those eyes.
paras.zh: 可农夫摇了摇头。“更长更尖，像匕首，”他举起手臂说，“而那些眼睛，我永远忘不了。

paras.en: How they burned if they caught you in their sights, and how they left the frost scars on my lands.” Elsa spotted his wife and towheaded kids crowding the window of his quaint thatched-roof cottage.
paras.zh: 它们一旦盯上你，便灼灼逼人，又如何在我的土地上留下那一道道冰霜的伤痕。”艾莎注意到他的妻子和一头金发的孩子们挤在古朴茅草屋的窗前。

paras.en: Smoke meandered out of the chimney, bringing aromas of sage and stew.
paras.zh: 炊烟从烟囱里袅袅飘出，带来鼠尾草和炖菜的香气。

paras.en: But they were hiding.
paras.zh: 但他们躲着。

paras.en: They looked afraid.
paras.zh: 他们显得害怕。

paras.en: The farmer shuddered at the memory, wrapping his arms around his chest despite the warmth kindled in the air, while Sven stamped the ground in emphasis.
paras.zh: 农夫想起那幕便打了个寒战，尽管空气中已暖意融融，仍抱臂环住胸口，而斯文重重跺地以示强调。

paras.en: That meant—this creature was what must have taken Anna and Kristoff. “A Frost Monster?” Elsa asked, taking it all in. “Aye,” the farmer said. “A frost demon, if I’ve ever seen one.
paras.zh: 这意味着——抓走安娜和克里斯托夫的，定是这怪物。“霜怪？”艾莎将一切尽收眼底，问道。“正是，”农夫说，“要我说，那是个霜之恶魔。

paras.en: For what else could it be?” His question hung in the air.
paras.zh: 还能是什么呢？”他的问题悬在半空。

paras.en: The answer stood before him: the queen herself also wielded the beautiful yet terrible powers of snow and frost.
paras.zh: 答案就立在他面前：女王本人也掌握着美丽却又可怕的冰雪之力。

paras.en: But the farmer didn’t dare give voice to the gossip that was bleeding into Arendelle.
paras.zh: 但农夫不敢把正渗入阿伦黛尔的流言说出口。

paras.en: Instead he reached over and patted Sven. “Good boy, keep the queen safe.” His eyes met Elsa’s worried gaze. “Arendelle needs her.” Sven snorted, and then they were off again.
paras.zh: 他反而伸手拍了拍斯文。“好孩子，护好女王。”他的目光与艾莎忧心的视线相遇。“阿伦黛尔需要她。”斯文喷了喷鼻息，随后他们再次上路。

paras.en: Elsa spied a trail of frost burned into the fields, leading away from the farm and toward the mountains.
paras.zh: 艾莎瞥见一道烧进田里的冰霜痕迹，从农庄延伸出去，通向群山。

paras.en: She ran her hands through the wilted crops, cradling the melting, fragile ice tendrils encasing their leaves.
paras.zh: 她把手拂过枯萎的庄稼，托起包裹着叶片、正在消融的脆弱冰丝。

paras.en: She straightened up and spoke to Sven. “Is there where it took them?” she asked, her eyes tracking over the frost trail. “Where does it lead?” “Oooh, the North Mountain,” Olaf said, raising his little twig arm. “Looks tall and far… and very cold.
paras.zh: 她直起身，对斯文说。“它是从这里带走他们的吗？”她目光沿冰霜痕迹追踪，问道，“通向哪里？”“噢，北山，”雪宝举起小树枝手臂说，“看起来又高又远……还非常冷。

paras.en: That’s where I came from.” “Of course, the one place still in winter’s grasp,” Elsa said, following Olaf’s gesture to the highest peak.
paras.zh: “我就是那儿来的。”“当然，唯一还被冬天攥在手里的地方，”艾莎顺着雪宝的指向，望向最高的峰顶。

paras.en: Dark, blustery clouds encircled it like a foreboding crown. “Look, there it is,” she said, as the clouds briefly lifted and exposed the exquisite spires of the ice palace she had erected there from magic-driven snow and ice. “Oh, it’s so pretty,” Olaf said, dancing a little jig under his flurry cloud. “Is that where we’re going?” Then he stopped dancing. “But what if… the Frost Monster lives there?” “Let’s hope so,” Elsa said as she climbed back into the sled and grabbed the reins.
paras.zh: 阴沉狂暴的云如不详的王冠般环绕着它。“看，就在那儿，”她说，云层短暂散开，露出她曾以魔力驱动的冰雪修建起的精美尖塔。“哦，真漂亮，”雪宝在雪云下跳起小步舞，“我们要去那儿吗？”接着他停下舞步，“可要是……霜怪住在那儿呢？”“但愿如此，”艾莎说着爬回雪橇，握住缰绳。

paras.en: Olaf leaned over and whispered into Sven’s ears. “Pssst, think she’s okay?” he said, glancing at Elsa with grave concern. “I’m not an expert… but usually it’s best to avoid monsters.…” But Sven snorted again and whined, seeming to be saying— Not if it has our friends.
paras.zh: 雪宝凑过去，对着斯文的耳朵低语。“嘘，你觉得她还好吗？”他神情严峻地瞥了艾莎一眼说，“我算不上专家……但一般来说，最好还是避开怪物……”可斯文又喷了喷鼻息，发出哀鸣，像是在说——除非怪物抓走了我们的朋友。

paras.en: Sven pulled them up the mountain, following the trail and scent of Kristoff and Anna.
paras.zh: 斯文循着克里斯托夫和安娜的踪迹与气味，拉他们上了山。

paras.en: The temperature dropped precipitously the higher they climbed, and the greenery gave way to sparse shrubbery and hardy pine trees.
paras.zh: 越往上爬，气温骤降，葱绿让位于稀疏的灌木和耐寒的松树。

paras.en: And then— “Snow,” Olaf said in awe.
paras.zh: 然后——“雪，”雪宝惊叹道。

paras.en: Elsa conjured ice blades so the sled could traverse the snowy trails.
paras.zh: 艾莎变出冰刃，好让雪橇能在雪道上行驶。

paras.en: Threatening clouds clung to the mountain, blocking out the sun and turning the landscape gray and frigid.
paras.zh: 不祥的云紧贴着山体，遮住了太阳，让天地变得灰暗而冰冷。

paras.en: The farther they went, the colder it got.
paras.zh: 他们走得越远，寒气越重。

paras.en: Real flurries started to fall over the mountain.
paras.zh: 真正的飞雪开始在山上飘落。

paras.en: But the cold had never bothered either Elsa or Olaf.
paras.zh: 但寒冷从未困扰过艾莎或雪宝。

paras.en: This was part of why she had agreed to bring Olaf—she knew he would not be harmed by frost or snow magic.
paras.zh: 这也是她同意带上雪宝的部分原因——她知道他不会被冰霜或冰雪魔法所伤。

paras.en: She’d forgotten how beautiful winter could be when it was this wild and free… the soft patter of fresh snow blanketing and transforming the landscape into a white wonderland.
paras.zh: 她忘了冬天在如此狂野自由时有多美……新雪轻柔地沙沙落下，覆盖大地，将景致化作白色的奇境。

paras.en: She found herself falling in love with the frigidity and beauty of it all over again.
paras.zh: 她发现自己再次爱上了这份凛冽与美丽。

paras.en: But then she shook her head.
paras.zh: 可接着她摇了摇头。

paras.en: With great beauty also came great danger.
paras.zh: 极度的美丽也伴随着极大的危险。

paras.en: As if hearing her thought, out of nowhere the winds whipped up, changing the snowfall into a blizzard.
paras.zh: 仿佛听见了她的想法，风凭空骤起，将落雪化作一场暴风雪。

paras.en: Elsa, Olaf, and Sven trekked onward, but the wind grew stronger—and the snow hurtled down harder and harder.
paras.zh: 艾莎、雪宝和斯文继续前行，可风越来越大——雪也越下越猛。

paras.en: Then— A mournful howl cut through the blinding snow.
paras.zh: 接着——一声哀嚎穿透了迷眼的飞雪。

paras.en: Then another and another.
paras.zh: 接着又是一声，再一声。

paras.en: And then the wolves burst through the trees and attacked. “Run, Sven!” Elsa yelled, twisting the reins.
paras.zh: 随后群狼冲出树林，发起攻击。“快跑，斯文！”艾莎拽紧缰绳喊道。

paras.en: They took off like a bolt into the storm.
paras.zh: 他们如离弦之箭般冲入风雪。

paras.en: But the wolves were gaining on them.
paras.zh: 可狼群正在逼近。

paras.en: Elsa tossed the reins to Olaf while she clambered to the back of the sled.
paras.zh: 艾莎把缰绳扔给雪宝，自己爬到雪橇后厢。

paras.en: She conjured her powers and shot ice out at the wolves, but they skillfully dodged it and kept running.
paras.zh: 她催动魔力，朝狼群射出冰，可它们灵巧地闪避，仍紧追不舍。

paras.en: That was when she saw their eyes.
paras.zh: 就在这时，她看清了它们的眼睛。

paras.en: They glowed like blue sapphires.
paras.zh: 它们像蓝宝石般发光。

paras.en: These were no ordinary wolves.
paras.zh: 这些可不是普通的狼。

paras.en: Something had bewitched them—and this whole mountain.
paras.zh: 有什么蛊惑了它们——还有整座山。

paras.en: The blizzard had stirred up out of nowhere.
paras.zh: 这场暴风雪凭空而起。

paras.en: But what had done it?
paras.zh: 可是什么造成的？

paras.en: And why?
paras.zh: 又是为了什么？

paras.en: She didn’t have time to think as the wolves lurched closer and nipped at the sled.
paras.zh: 狼群猛地逼近，啃咬着雪橇，她没时间细想。

paras.en: They seemed immune to her powers.
paras.zh: 它们似乎对她的力量免疫。

paras.en: Ice clung to their fur and teeth like a second skin but didn’t appear to bother them.
paras.zh: 冰像第二层皮肤般贴在它们的毛和牙上，却似乎并不困扰它们。

paras.en: These were ice wolves—and they were gaining on them.
paras.zh: 这些是冰狼——而且正在追上他们。

paras.en: One vicious wolf snapped at her cloak, ripping a shred out of it, while another rammed into the sled, causing it to wobble and almost topple over.
paras.zh: 一只凶狠的狼咬住她的披风，撕下一块，另一只则撞上雪橇，使其摇晃欲翻。

paras.en: Elsa steadied it, then threw some more ice blocks at them.
paras.zh: 艾莎稳住雪橇，又朝它们掷出几块冰。

paras.en: That slowed them down a little but did not stop their chase.
paras.zh: 这稍稍拖慢了它们，却未能终止追击。

paras.en: The wolves burst through the ice.
paras.zh: 狼群冲破冰层。

paras.en: They howled louder, regaining their speed. “Uh, I don’t want you to worry,” Olaf said, tugging at her cloak. “But—cliff!” Sven was too spooked by the wolves to slow down, plus there wasn’t space.
paras.zh: 它们嚎得更大声，重又加速。“呃，我不想让你担心，”雪宝扯着她的披风说，“可是——悬崖！”斯文被狼群吓坏了，根本慢不下来，况且也没有空间。

paras.en: Even if he stopped running, they’d still slide over the edge and likely plummet to their deaths.
paras.zh: 即便他停下，他们仍会滑过边缘，很可能坠崖丧命。

paras.en: Without thinking, acting on pure instinct, Elsa conjured an ice bridge that arced over the ravine, which Sven careened over.
paras.zh: 想都没想，仅凭本能，艾莎变出一座横跨深谷的冰桥，斯文疾驰而过。

paras.en: But the wolves raced onto it after them.
paras.zh: 可狼群紧追不舍，也冲上了桥。

paras.en: They were gaining again. “Come on, just a little farther,” Elsa murmured, waiting for the perfect moment as Sven cleared the bridge.
paras.zh: 它们又追近了。“快，再远一点就好，”艾莎低语，等斯文驶离桥面的完美时机。

paras.en: Right when the wolves reached the middle of the bridge, she shattered it into a thousand shards.
paras.zh: 就在狼群跑到桥中央时，她将桥击碎成千万片。

paras.en: The wolves plummeted into the ravine, landing in the snow with distraught yelps, then dispersing.
paras.zh: 狼群坠入深谷，在雪地里发出绝望的嚎叫，随后四散而去。

paras.en: The magic that was bewitching them also seemed to have evaporated and left them.
paras.zh: 那蛊惑它们的魔力似乎也随之消散，离它们而去。

paras.en: But what had caused it?
paras.zh: 可是什么造成的？

paras.en: The only way to find it was to keep going—and reach the palace.
paras.zh: 要找到答案，唯一的办法就是继续前进——抵达冰宫。

paras.en: With that, they continued onward into the fierce blizzard that threatened to derail their journey.
paras.zh: 于是，他们顶着那场险些令旅程脱轨的猛烈暴风雪，继续前行。

paras.en: Finally, they reached the ice palace.
paras.zh: 终于，他们到达了冰宫。

paras.en: The sun was setting through the clouds, casting the last gasps of daylight over the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 夕阳穿过云层，将白昼最后的余晖洒在北山上。

paras.en: Sven stayed back, while Elsa marched up to her icy creation with Olaf waddling after her through the deep snow. “So pretty… and scary…” Olaf said, looking amazed at the palace at sunset.
paras.zh: 斯文留在后面，艾莎则大步走向自己的冰雪造物，雪宝在深雪中摇摇摆摆跟在身后。“好漂亮……又好吓人……”雪宝望着夕阳下的冰宫，惊叹道。

paras.en: They reached the door.
paras.zh: 他们来到门前。

paras.en: Olaf peered up at it, then back at her. “Knock… you do know how to knock?” Olaf said in concern, his eyebrows knitting together. “Your sister didn’t know.
paras.zh: 雪宝仰头看看门，又回头看她。“敲门……你知道怎么敲门吧？”雪宝皱着眉，担忧地说，“你妹妹就不懂。

paras.en: But don’t tell her I said that.…” Elsa rolled her eyes. “I made it.
paras.zh: 但别告诉她是我说的……”艾莎翻了个白眼。“这是我造的。

paras.en: You don’t have to knock at your own home.” “Oh, right,” Olaf said. “But what if someone else moved in?
paras.zh: 你不必敲自己家的门。”“哦，对，”雪宝说，“可要是别人搬进来了呢？

paras.en: You’ve been gone a while.” Elsa rolled her eyes again.
paras.zh: 你离开挺久了。”艾莎又翻了个白眼。

paras.en: But he had a point. “Fine.” She started to rap her knuckles, but then the doors opened of their own accord. “Uh, that wasn’t creepy,” Olaf said in a tremulous voice, glancing into the dark and shadowy entryway. “Not creepy at all… perfectly normal door behavior…” “Hello… anybody home?” Elsa called out. “Anna… Kristoff…” Elsa ventured inside with Olaf behind her, but something about the ice palace felt ominous and haunted now.
paras.zh: 可他说得有道理。“好吧。”她正要叩响指节，门却自己开了。“呃，这一点都不诡异，”雪宝用发颤的声音望着幽暗的门廊说，“一点都不诡异……门的正常行为……”“有人……在家吗？”艾莎喊道，“安娜……克里斯托夫……”艾莎带着雪宝走进去，可如今这冰宫透着不祥与阴森。

paras.en: When she had stayed there, the ice glowed with a beautiful magic, but now it cast threatening shadows across the sleek, icy floors.
paras.zh: 她曾住在这里时，冰雪透着美丽的魔法之光，可如今却在光洁的冰面上投下充满威胁的阴影。

paras.en: She entered cautiously. “Hello… anybody here?” she called again.
paras.zh: 她谨慎地走进去。“有人……在吗？”她又喊了一声。

paras.en: Her voice echoed out—and then it was answered. “Elsa… up here!” It was Anna.
paras.zh: 她的声音在回荡——随后有了回应。“艾莎……在上面！”是安娜。

paras.en: And she sounded afraid.
paras.zh: 而且她听起来很害怕。

paras.en: Her voice echoed down the from the top floor. “Hold on, I’m coming!” Elsa didn’t wait.
paras.zh: 她的声音从顶层传来，在下方回响。“等等，我来了！”艾莎没有等待。

paras.en: She bounded up the steps after the voice.
paras.zh: 她循声蹦跳着冲上台阶。

paras.en: Olaf hurried right behind her on his stumpy legs.
paras.zh: 雪宝用他短粗的腿紧跟在她身后。

paras.en: Elsa reached the top, then slid to a halt, making Olaf slide into her.
paras.zh: 艾莎冲到顶层，猛地刹住，害得雪宝撞上她。

paras.en: Her eyes landed on Anna and Kristoff.
paras.zh: 她的目光落在安娜和克里斯托夫身上。

paras.en: But they were trapped.
paras.zh: 可他们被困住了。

paras.en: They lay imprisoned inside a large cage made entirely from icicles that sprouted out from the ceiling itself.
paras.zh: 他们被关在一个完全由冰柱编成的大笼子里，那些冰柱从天花板本身生长而出。

paras.en: Water—when frozen solid—became extremely strong.
paras.zh: 水——一旦冻实——便坚不可摧。

paras.en: They both looked on the verge of unconsciousness, weakened from their prolonged exposure to the cold. “Hold on, I’ll get you out of there,” Elsa said, rushing over.
paras.zh: 两人都濒临昏迷，因长时间受冻而虚弱不堪。“撑住，我把你们弄出来，”艾莎边说边冲过去。

paras.en: Her sister stirred weakly in her cage.
paras.zh: 妹妹在笼中虚弱地动了动。

paras.en: Her face was pale, while her teeth chattered. “Anna, who did this to you?” “Elsa… no… stay back… it’s a trap…” Anna said weakly. “Don’t come up here.…” But her warning came too late.
paras.zh: 她脸色苍白，牙齿打颤。“安娜，谁对你下的手？”“艾莎……不……退后……这是个陷阱……”安娜虚弱地说，“别上来……”可她的警告来得太迟。

paras.en: Suddenly a dark shadow fell over Elsa.
paras.zh: 突然，一道黑影笼罩了艾莎。

paras.en: The Frost Monster lurched out.
paras.zh: 霜怪猛地窜出。

paras.en: She stared at the creature in horror.
paras.zh: 她惊恐地盯着那怪物。

paras.en: Just as the farmer had said, it had bright sapphire eyes and scraggly, dagger-sharp tree branches for arms.
paras.zh: 正如农夫所说，它有一双明亮的蓝宝石眼睛，和枯瘦如匕首般锋利的树枝手臂。

paras.en: It cracked open its jaws and roared through jagged icicle fangs, emitting a cold blast of wintry air. “Hey, he looks like me,” Olaf said. “Only like… a mean version of me.” “And he’s bigger,” Elsa said. “Watch out!” The Frost Monster loomed over them and roared again.
paras.zh: 它张开大嘴，透过参差冰牙怒吼，喷出一股寒冷的冬日气息。“嘿，他长得像我，”雪宝说，“只是像……一个刻薄版的我。”“而且他更大，”艾莎说，“小心！”霜怪逼近他们，再次怒吼。

paras.en: The next wave of frosted breath hit Olaf directly, causing him to topple and fall apart.
paras.zh: 下一股霜息直接击中雪宝，让他栽倒、散了架。

paras.en: His head rolled away from his body, while his torso collapsed into frantic snowballs that bowled away over the slippery floors.
paras.zh: 他的头滚离了身体，躯干则塌成一团慌乱的雪球，在光滑的地板上骨碌碌滚远。

paras.en: But Elsa didn’t have time to worry.
paras.zh: 可艾莎无暇担忧。

paras.en: Instead, she summoned her powers and cast ice daggers at the creature— But to her dismay, they had no effect.
paras.zh: 她反而催动魔力，朝怪物掷出冰刃——可令她沮丧的是，毫无作用。

paras.en: Then, something worse happened.
paras.zh: 接着，更糟的事发生了。

paras.en: The monster absorbed the ice and snow hurled at it, growing larger and stronger.
paras.zh: 怪物吸收了掷向它的冰雪，变得更大更强。

paras.en: It roared with newfound strength, emitting another gale of wintry breath that blew Elsa back through the doors and onto the balcony.
paras.zh: 它用新得的力气怒吼，又喷出一股冬日狂风，把艾莎吹过门洞，摔到阳台上。

paras.en: The icicle cage overhead rocked precipitously, threatening to fall and shatter and take Anna and Kristoff with it.
paras.zh: 头顶的冰柱笼剧烈摇晃，眼看就要坠落碎裂，把安娜和克里斯托夫一同卷进去。

paras.en: Elsa had to act fast.
paras.zh: 艾莎必须速速行动。

paras.en: The blizzard tore at her while the monster hit her with another frigid blast.
paras.zh: 暴风雪撕扯着她，怪物又朝她喷出一股凛冽的气息。

paras.en: She stood up, shielding her face against it all.
paras.zh: 她站起身，用手护住脸挡住这一切。

paras.en: She tried to fight back with a burst of snow and ice.
paras.zh: 她试图用一股冰雪反击。

paras.en: But her powers only backfired again, making the creature stronger.
paras.zh: 可她的力量再次适得其反，让怪物更强。

paras.en: Why don’t my powers work on this creature? she thought frantically.
paras.zh: “为什么我的力量对它无效？”她慌乱地想。

paras.en: The balcony’s sheer drop-off threatened behind her.
paras.zh: 身后是阳台陡然向下的悬崖。

paras.en: One more strong blast— And it could send her over the edge.
paras.zh: 再来一股强风——就可能把她吹下边缘。

paras.en: She thought fast and studied the demon’s face.
paras.zh: 她飞快思考，端详着恶魔的脸。

paras.en: Clearly, the creature was… angry.
paras.zh: 显然，这怪物……很愤怒。

paras.en: Anna had also mentioned a trap.
paras.zh: 安娜也提到过陷阱。

paras.en: Had the creature purposely lured her back to the ice palace?
paras.zh: 是这怪物故意把她引回冰宫的吗？

paras.en: And if so, why? “What do you want from me?” Elsa tried speaking to it, meeting the creature’s sapphire gaze. “Why did you take my sister and friend?
paras.zh: 若是如此，又是为了什么？“你想从我这里得到什么？”艾莎迎着怪物蓝宝石般的目光，试着与它对话，“你为何抓走我的妹妹和朋友？

paras.en: Why did you want me to come back here?” Pain tore over the demon’s face.
paras.zh: 你为何想让我回到这里？”剧痛掠过恶魔的脸。

paras.en: Icy tears rolled down the cheeks.
paras.zh: 冰冷的泪珠滚下脸颊。

paras.en: Then it cracked open its jaws, and a shrill, piercing voice emerged.
paras.zh: 接着它张开大嘴，发出尖利刺耳的声音。

paras.en: It sounded like a fierce wind whistling through trees. “You made me… then abandoned me.…” the creature spoke. “Summer is a blight on the land.… The light… it burns and melts… and it hurts me.… Bring back winter.…” Elsa stared back in shock.
paras.zh: 那声音像狂风穿过树林的呼啸。“你创造了我……又抛弃了我……”怪物说，“夏天是大地上的灾祸……那光……灼烧、融化……让我痛苦……让冬天回来……”艾莎震惊地回望。

paras.en: She’d made this creature?
paras.zh: 是她创造了这怪物？

paras.en: She couldn’t believe it.
paras.zh: 她简直不敢相信。

paras.en: But how?
paras.zh: 可怎么会？

paras.en: Had it been during her reign at the ice palace?
paras.zh: 是在她统治冰宫期间吗？

paras.en: She glanced over at Olaf, still rolling around and dismembered.
paras.zh: 她瞥向雪宝，他还在地上滚着，支离破碎。

paras.en: But hadn’t she accidentally made the snowman from her childhood come alive, too?
paras.zh: 可她小时候不也意外让那个雪人活了过来吗？

paras.en: Frost Monsters lived in stories and fairy tales.
paras.zh: 霜怪活在故事和童话里。

paras.en: Every kid in Arendelle grew up knowing the legends.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的每个孩子都是伴着这些传说长大的。

paras.en: So of course she could have conjured it.
paras.zh: 所以，她当然可能召唤出它。

paras.en: Now that she thought about it, this creature did resemble Olaf in certain key ways—only a bigger, scarier version that had become possessed with great rage and furious anger. “But why did you leave me here?” it spoke again, the shrill voice making chills shoot up her spine. “And then bring the great thaw… to destroy me?” Anger at that memory seemed to overtake the creature as it roared and prepared to attack her again.
paras.zh: 如今细想，这怪物确在某些关键处像雪宝——只是更大、更吓人，且被巨大的愤怒与狂怒所附身。“可你为何把我留在这里？”它又开口，尖利的声音让她脊背发凉，“然后又带来大融雪……来毁掉我？”对那段记忆的愤怒似乎攫住了怪物，它怒吼着，准备再次攻击她。

paras.en: Of course, that wasn’t why she had left the castle and thawed the lands.
paras.zh: 当然，那并非她离开城堡、融化大地的原因。

paras.en: But now she realized why the creature would be so angry with her, even if it hadn’t been her intention.
paras.zh: 可如今她明白了，为何这怪物会对她如此愤怒，即便那并非她的本意。

paras.en: The creature stomped onto the balcony toward her.
paras.zh: 怪物踏着步子，朝阳台上的她走来。

paras.en: Elsa scrambled back, hitting the railing.
paras.zh: 艾莎慌忙后退，撞上栏杆。

paras.en: She didn’t know what to do.
paras.zh: 她不知如何是好。

paras.en: The same magic that animated this terrible, mournful creature came from inside her, and so it only made the creature stronger.
paras.zh: 驱动这可怕、哀伤怪物的魔力同源于她体内，因而只会让怪物更强。

paras.en: All hope seemed lost.
paras.zh: 一切希望似乎都破灭了。

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff lay trapped in the cage.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫困在笼中。

paras.en: They wouldn’t survive much longer, and this monster would continue to ravage the farmlands and terrorize the people of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 他们撑不了多久，而这怪物还会继续蹂躏农田、恐吓阿伦黛尔的百姓。

paras.en: Nevertheless, she summoned ice powers to her fingertips.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，她仍将冰雪之力汇聚于指尖。

paras.en: What other choice did she have?
paras.zh: 她别无选择。

paras.en: But then, Olaf’s head rolled toward her, still detached from his body.
paras.zh: 可就在这时，雪宝的头滚到她身边，仍与身体分离着。

paras.en: His lips moved. “Elsa, remember what the more powerful force is…” he whispered in a soft voice.
paras.zh: 他的嘴唇动了。“艾莎，记得那更强大的力量是什么吗……”他轻声低语。

paras.en: That was it.
paras.zh: 就是它。

paras.en: Elsa stood up and walked toward the creature with open arms.
paras.zh: 艾莎站起身，张开双臂，朝怪物走去。

paras.en: But instead of hitting him with ice, she made her powers go dormant.
paras.zh: 可她没有用冰击打它，而是让力量沉寂下来。

paras.en: Her fingertips were harmless now. “I’m sorry…” she said, taking another tentative step toward her creation. “Sorry?” it said in surprise. “I hope you can forgive me,” she went on, taking another step. “I didn’t know I created you—or that I hurt you like that.
paras.zh: 她的指尖此刻已无害。“对不起……”她说着，朝自己的造物又试探地迈了一步。“对不起？”它惊讶地说。“希望你能原谅我，”她继续向前，又迈了一步，“我不知道自己创造了你——也不知道那样伤了你。

paras.en: I didn’t mean it.
paras.zh: 我不是故意的。

paras.en: And I’m very sorry… please forgive me.” Her heart pulsed with warmth— that was the power of love —for this poor creature whom she’d abandoned and accidentally brought pain upon.
paras.zh: 我真的很抱歉……请原谅我。”她的心涌起暖意——那便是爱的力量——为这被她遗弃、又被她意外带来痛苦的可怜造物。

paras.en: The blizzard died down a little, and she could see more clearly now.
paras.zh: 暴风雪稍歇，此刻她看得更清楚了。

paras.en: The monster’s features seemed to soften in that moment and almost melt a little, while the razor-sharp icicles in its jaws retreated into its mouth.
paras.zh: 怪物的面容似乎在那一刻柔和下来，几乎微微融化，而它嘴里那些锋利的冰牙也缩了回去。

paras.en: The creature could’ve easily hurt her sister and Kristoff, but it hadn’t.
paras.zh: 这怪物本可轻易伤害她妹妹和克里斯托夫，可它没有。

paras.en: Instead, it had only used them to summon Elsa back to the ice palace.
paras.zh: 它只是用他们把艾莎召回冰宫。

paras.en: It didn’t mean to hurt anyone. “I’m sorry—and I love you,” Elsa said. “Just as I love my sister, Anna… Kristoff… Olaf… Sven…” She ticked them off, feeling her heart pump even stronger with love’s warmth.
paras.zh: 它并不想伤害任何人。“对不起——而且我爱你，”艾莎说，“就像我爱我的妹妹安娜……克里斯托夫……雪宝……斯文……”她一一数着，感到心在爱的温暖中跳得更加强劲。

paras.en: The blood flowed through her veins faster, bringing with it the pure magic of heat and warmth.
paras.zh: 血液在血管中流淌得更快，带来炽热与温暖的纯净魔法。

paras.en: And just like that, the monster, which had grown angry and powerful with rage and neglect, began to shrink down as its terrible power melted away, until all that was left was— A lumpy, harmless snowman.
paras.zh: 就这样，那因愤怒与遭弃而变得狂怒强大的怪物，随着可怖的力量消融，开始缩小，直到最后只剩——一个凹凸不平、无害的雪人。

paras.en: The blizzard also ceased howling, and the skies cleared, displaying a beautiful, moonlit night.
paras.zh: 暴风雪也停止了呼啸，天空放晴，展现出美丽的月夜。

paras.en: Elsa walked over, running her hands over the snowman’s now inanimate face.
paras.zh: 艾莎走过去，用手抚过雪人如今了无生气的脸。

paras.en: A refrain of a song that Anna used to sing— do you want to build a snowman?— echoed through her head.
paras.zh: 安娜从前常唱的那句歌——你想不想堆个雪人？——在她脑中回响。

paras.en: She reassembled Olaf, who appeared unharmed.
paras.zh: 她把雪宝重新拼好，他看来毫发无伤。

paras.en: Olaf waddled over to the now docile snowman. “I think it’s missing something…” he mused.
paras.zh: 雪宝摇摇摆摆走到如今温顺的雪人身边。“我觉得它少了点什么……”他若有所思。

paras.en: With that, he plucked out his carrot nose and wedged it into the snowman’s face.
paras.zh: 说着，他拔下自己的胡萝卜鼻子，塞进雪人的脸上。

paras.en: He stood back and peered at it in delight.
paras.zh: 他退后一步，欣喜地端详着。

paras.en: The nose did make it feel complete now. “You’re right—the finishing touch,” Elsa said. “But what about your nose?” “Plenty of carrots in the sled,” Olaf said, then frowned. “Unless Sven got hungry… we’d better go check… not good to leave reindeer unattended around bushels of carrots.” That was Kristoff began to wake from the enchantment.
paras.zh: 那鼻子确实让它显得完整了。“你说得对——点睛之笔，”艾莎说，“可你的鼻子呢？”“雪橇里还有好多胡萝卜，”雪宝说，接着皱了皱眉，“除非斯文饿了……我们最好去瞧瞧……让驯鹿守着成筐的胡萝卜可不安全。”就在这时，克里斯托夫开始从魔怔中醒来。

paras.en: Anna stirred sleepily in the cage overhead, too. “I’m hungry, too.… Hurry up… and get us down from here.…” Elsa cracked a smile at her sister. “Always thinking with your stomach?” But then she worked quickly to free Anna and Kristoff from the ice cage.
paras.zh: 安娜也在头顶的笼里睡眼惺忪地动了动。“我也饿了……快点……把我们弄下去……”艾莎冲妹妹抿嘴一笑。“总是用肚子思考？”可接着她赶紧动手，把安娜和克里斯托夫从冰笼中解救出来。

paras.en: With Olaf’s help, they climbed into the back of the sled.
paras.zh: 在雪宝的帮助下，他们爬进了雪橇后厢。

paras.en: Elsa wrapped them in thick woolen blankets.
paras.zh: 艾莎用厚厚的羊毛毯把他们裹好。

paras.en: Then she climbed back into the sled and seized the reins as Olaf hopped in next to her. “Sven, take us home,” Elsa said in relief. “You know the way.” As they rocketed off across the snow and careened down the mountain, Elsa glanced back one last time at the ice palace—and realized something important.
paras.zh: 接着她爬回雪橇，握住缰绳，雪宝跳到她身旁。“斯文，带我们回家，”艾莎如释重负地说，“你认得路。”当他们飞驰过雪原、冲下山时，艾莎最后一次回望冰宫——并意识到一件重要的事。

paras.en: This place no longer held any pull over her; it was as if a powerful spell had been broken.
paras.zh: 这地方不再对她有任何牵绊；仿佛一道强大的咒语已被打破。

paras.en: Now, it felt forlorn and lonely.
paras.zh: 如今，它显得凄凉而孤寂。

paras.en: That was because—it wasn’t her home.
paras.zh: 那是因为——它不是她的家。

paras.en: Sven pulled them down the mountain and back toward the castle, where they could all rest and recover.
paras.zh: 斯文拉他们下山，返回城堡，在那里他们都能休息、恢复。

paras.en: They soon left the North Mountain—and winter’s frigid grasp—far behind them, as the snow receded and they emerged into the blast of light from a new morning.
paras.zh: 他们很快将北山——以及冬天冰冷的掌控——远远抛在身后，随着积雪退去，他们迎来一个新晨的耀眼光芒。

paras.en: After that fateful day, the Frost Monster no longer ravaged the farmlands, nor threatened the vital harvest.
paras.zh: 在那命运之日过后，霜怪不再蹂躏农田，也不再威胁至关重要的收成。

paras.en: Before she left her winter palace, Elsa summoned her powers and conjured a soft arctic wind to disperse the snowman.
paras.zh: 离开冬宫前，艾莎催动魔力，召来一阵柔和北极风，吹散那个雪人。

paras.en: Gently and naturally, it transformed into snowflakes that fluttered through the air magically like icy diamonds and blew out the window, where they refracted the brilliant rays of the dawn sunlight, returning to the wild where they belonged.
paras.zh: 它温柔而自然地化作雪花，如冰钻般神奇地在空中翩飞，从窗口飘出，折射着黎明阳光的灿烂光芒，回归到本应所属的旷野。

paras.en: Thus, the peaceful balance was restored, just as it should be.
paras.zh: 于是，平和的平衡得以恢复，正如应有的样子。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Anna and Kristoff returned to full health, with no permanent injuries and very little recollection of their icy imprisonment.
paras.zh: 与此同时，安娜和克里斯托夫完全康复，没有留下永久伤痕，对他们冰中之困也几乎没什么记忆。

paras.en: Soon a great bounty bloomed and ripened in the fields, untouched by winter or frost.
paras.zh: 不久，田野里绽放并成熟了丰盛的物产，不受冬天或冰霜的侵扰。

paras.en: Summer continued to bring warmth and life to the land, while Elsa ruled over the great kingdom of Arendelle, having learned, once again, that love was indeed the strongest magic of all.
paras.zh: 夏天继续为大地带来温暖与生机，而艾莎统治着伟大的阿伦黛尔王国，再次懂得：爱，确实是最强大的魔法。

paras.en: Deep in the forest far past Arendelle, where a large castle was being built, sat a camp made up of tents, campfires, and herds of reindeer.
paras.zh: 在阿伦黛尔远方那片森林的深处，一座宏伟的城堡正在修建，那里坐落着一个由帐篷、篝火和成群驯鹿组成的营地。

paras.en: It was the home of the Northuldra, a group of people who were one with nature, who were the people of the sun, and who were the people that followed wherever their reindeer roamed.
paras.zh: 那是北地人的家园，他们是一群与自然融为一体的人，是太阳的子民，也是追随驯鹿足迹四处迁徙的人。

paras.en: As the sun slowly began to sink, setting the leaves of the fall trees ablaze with light, children gathered around the biggest campfire at the knees of a man.
paras.zh: 当夕阳缓缓西沉，秋树的叶片被余晖点燃，孩子们聚到最大的篝火旁，围坐在一个男子的膝前。

paras.en: It was story time in the Northuldra camp, and the man’s deep baritone voice was known for keeping all the listeners enthralled.
paras.zh: 这是北地人营地的讲故事时间，而那位男子低沉的男中音远近闻名，总能让所有听众听得入迷。

paras.en: He held up his hands, and the friendly chatter began to quiet.
paras.zh: 他举起双手，友好的喧闹声渐渐安静下来。

paras.en: It was then he began his story.
paras.zh: 就在这时，他讲起了故事。

paras.en: Along the banks of a rushing stream, a sky boy named Clemet sat with his grandfather, Henry, a fishing pole held tightly in his small hand.
paras.zh: 在一条湍急溪流的两岸，一个名叫克莱梅特的天族男孩和祖父亨利坐在一起，小手紧紧攥着一根钓竿。

paras.en: The two of them were from a tiny village named Aljel, which was close to the kingdom of Arendelle, and they loved spending time together in the forest.
paras.zh: 他们来自一个紧邻阿伦黛尔王国的小村庄——阿尔耶尔，两人都喜爱一起在森林里消磨时光。

paras.en: Many sounds surrounded them, but louder than all the others was a bird’s cry. “Grandpa, what’s that?” the little boy asked, worry in his dark eyes.
paras.zh: 四周声响不绝，可盖过一切的，是一声鸟鸣。“爷爷，那是什么？”小男孩问道，乌黑的眼眸里满是担忧。

paras.en: At the end of his grandpa’s pole, a fish jerked against the line, trying to get away.
paras.zh: 钓竿那头，一条鱼猛地一扯鱼线，拼命想挣脱。

paras.en: With a quick flick of his wrist, Henry pulled the fish in as he answered the question. “That, my child, is a cuckoo.
paras.zh: 亨利手腕一抖，边回答边把鱼拉了上来。“孩子，那是布谷鸟。

paras.en: Whenever you hear one call, you can wish for three things.” Clemet looked around, trying to spy the bird, wondering if such a magical creature really existed.
paras.zh: “每当听见它鸣叫，你就能许下三个愿望。”克莱梅特环顾四周，想找到那只鸟，心里怀疑这般神奇的生灵是否真的存在。

paras.en: Henry smiled at him as if he was happy to be sharing a big secret.
paras.zh: 亨利冲他笑了笑，仿佛正为分享一个重大的秘密而高兴。

paras.en: The family dog lay next to them.
paras.zh: 家里的狗趴在他们身旁。

paras.en: Clemet scooched forward and hugged him around his neck.
paras.zh: 克莱梅特往前挪了挪，搂住狗的脖子。

paras.en: Still, he saw nothing in the trees.
paras.zh: 可他依旧没在树丛里瞧见什么。

paras.en: He just heard the sounds. “Are you sure, Grandpa?” he asked.
paras.zh: 他只听见声音。“您确定吗，爷爷？”他问。

paras.en: Henry calmly took the fish off his line and leaned his fishing pole against a tree as he looked lovingly at his grandson. “I am sure, Clemet.
paras.zh: 亨利不慌不忙地取下鱼，把钓竿往树上一靠，疼爱地望着孙子。“我确定，克莱梅特。

paras.en: Make a wish for anything you want.” Sitting down next to Clemet, Henry softly stroked his dark curly hair. “But how do you know it works?” the little boy asked, still feeling uncertain.
paras.zh: “去许下任何你想要的愿望吧。”亨利在克莱梅特身边坐下，轻轻抚摸他乌黑的卷发。“可您怎么知道它灵验呢？”小男孩还是有些将信将疑。
