paras.en: Are you sure there isn’t more I can do?
paras.zh: 你确定我帮不上更多忙？

paras.en: I’m good at wrangling snowgies and assembling chocolate fountains.” Anna laughed from Berit’s front porch. “Nope, being my getaway wagon is perfect.
paras.zh: 我可是很会驯小雪宝、搭巧克力喷泉的。“安娜站在贝丽特家门廊上笑了。”不用，当我的'溜号马车'就完美了。

paras.en: I can handle the rest.” Kristoff nodded and flicked Sven’s reins. “All right, but I’m here if you need me.
paras.zh: 剩下的我来应付。“克里斯托夫点点头，轻甩斯文的缰绳。”好吧，不过需要我时我就在。

paras.en: And Sven says, ‘ I’m here, too .’” As the wagon pulled away, Olaf took off one of his arms so he could wave it to get her attention. “And me!” “Thanks,” Anna called.
paras.zh: 斯文也说：'我也在。'“马车驶离时，雪宝卸下一条胳膊，挥着引起她注意。”还有我呢！“”谢了，“安娜喊道。

paras.en: Under her breath she added, “But I should do it myself.” She straightened her crown and knocked.
paras.zh: 她又压低声音补了句：”不过这事该我自己来。“她扶正王冠，敲了敲门。

paras.en: At least this part of her day should be delightful.
paras.zh: 至少今天这一段该是舒心的。

paras.en: She loved meeting Arendellians, and who knew, maybe there would be chocolate! “Hello?” she called. “Anyone home?” The door swung open to reveal a room with blue wallpaper, patterned with white diamonds; a polished wooden floor; and a small girl with dark braids and huge eyes.
paras.zh: 她最爱见阿伦黛尔的百姓，谁知道呢，说不定还有巧克力！”有人吗？“她唤道，”家里有人吗？“门开了，露出一间贴着白色菱形蓝壁纸、地板打磨锃亮、站着个深色辫子大眼睛小女孩的房间。

paras.en: She gasped. “You must be the birthday girl,” said Anna with a grin. “Welcome to Arendelle, Berit.
paras.zh: 小女孩倒吸一口气。”你一定就是小寿星了，“安娜咧嘴笑道，”欢迎来到阿伦黛尔，贝丽特。

paras.en: And happiest tenth birthday!” “You came!” Berit curtsied, then hugged her, turning her head to call over her shoulder while her arms were still tight around Anna’s waist. “See, Mama?
paras.zh: 祝你十岁生日最快乐！“”您真的来了！“贝丽特行了个屈膝礼，随即抱住她，双臂还紧紧箍着安娜的腰，却转过头朝身后喊：”看见没，妈妈？

paras.en: I told you she’d come.
paras.zh: 我说过她会来的。

paras.en: Mama said the queen is too busy, but everyone says you’re so nice and I just knew you’d come.
paras.zh: 妈妈说女王太忙，可大家都说您人特别好，我就知道您一定会来。

paras.en: Maybe I like Arendelle after all!” “Queen Anna!” A tall woman with a round face and a white apron dropped into a trembling curtsy as she stared, unblinking, at Anna. “You actually came?
paras.zh: 说不定我真的会喜欢阿伦黛尔呢！“”安娜女王！“一位圆脸、系着白围裙的高个子女人盯着安娜一眨不眨，颤抖着行了个屈膝礼。”您真来了？

paras.en: Er… welcome!
paras.zh: 呃……欢迎！

paras.en: We are so honored to have you visit our house.” She curtsied again, then added, “Berit, stop smothering the queen and invite her inside.” “I’m so happy to be here.” Anna let Berit take her hand and lead her.
paras.zh: 您能来寒舍，我们不胜荣幸。“她又行了一礼，接着说，”贝丽特，别把女王闷坏了，请她进屋呀。“”我很高兴来到这儿。“安娜任由贝丽特牵着手领她进屋。

paras.en: The room seemed to be half birthday party and half still-packed crates. “Wow, you really did just move here.” “Four days ago.” Berit scrunched her nose. “I wanted to celebrate my birthday back in Weselton, but we were too busy packing.” “I’m glad that you’re here.” Anna squeezed the girl’s hand. “And I’m sure you’re going to make new friends really soon.” “I hope so,” said Berit.
paras.zh: 这房间像是半派对半没拆完的箱子。”哇，你们真是刚搬来。“”四天前。“贝丽特皱了皱鼻子。”我本想在韦塞尔顿过生日，可我们忙着打包。“”我很高兴你来了。“安娜握了握女孩的手。”而且我敢说，你很快就能交到新朋友。“”希望如此。“贝丽特说。

paras.en: Anna scanned the room again, noticing a tray of her favorite dessert on the table. “I see you’ve already discovered Blodget’s Bakery—so you’re off to a good start.” “Queen Anna,” Berit’s mom said, “may we get you anything?
paras.zh: 安娜又打量了一圈房间，注意到桌上有一盘她最爱的甜点。”看来你们已经发现了布洛杰特面包房——这开局不错。“”安娜女王，“贝丽特的妈妈说，”要我们给您拿点什么吗？

paras.en: A drink?
paras.zh: 喝点什么？

paras.en: Some food?
paras.zh: 吃点什么？

paras.en: A seat?” She hastily moved a box from a chair and brushed off the cushion. “Oh.” Anna glanced out the window toward her waiting friends.
paras.zh: 坐坐？“她匆忙把椅子上的箱子挪开，掸了掸坐垫。”哦。“安娜望向窗外等候的朋友们。

paras.en: She really couldn’t stay, but… “Maybe just one krumkake.” “Those are my favorite!” Berit beamed, her twin braids flying as she rushed to get a rolled cookie for the queen.
paras.zh: 她实在不能久留，可是……”那就来一块卷心饼好了。“”那是我的最爱！“贝丽特眉开眼笑，双辫飞扬着跑去给女王拿一块卷饼。

paras.en: But as the girl placed one on a plate, Anna’s eyes landed on what was next to the dessert. “Presents!
paras.zh: 可女孩刚把饼放到盘里，安娜的目光就落在甜点旁的物件上。”礼物！

paras.en: Drat, I forgot yours.” “That’s okay.” Berit handed her the krumkake with a shrug. “You don’t have to bring me a gift.
paras.zh: 糟了，我忘了你的礼物。“”没关系。“贝丽特耸耸肩，把卷饼递给她。”您不必带礼物给我。

paras.en: I’m just so happy you’re here.” “Truly, we’re honored, Your Majesty,” said her mom. “Nope.
paras.zh: 您能来我就高兴坏了。“”说真的，我们不胜荣幸，陛下，“她妈妈说。”不行。

paras.en: The birthday girl gets a present,” said Anna, stuffing the cookie into her mouth.
paras.zh: 小寿星必须有礼物，“安娜把饼塞进嘴里说。

paras.en: She had no idea what that present would be, but this was the perfect excuse to get out the door and on to her next stop.
paras.zh: 她压根不知道送什么，但这正好是出门赶下一站的绝妙借口。

paras.en: Still chewing, she backed out of the house.
paras.zh: 她嚼着饼，倒退着出了门。

paras.en: Then she swallowed and stuck her head through the doorway to add, “I’ll just scoot back to the castle and get it.
paras.zh: 然后她咽下饼，把头探进门里补了一句：”我这就回城堡取来。

paras.en: Be back soon.” Kristoff, Olaf, Sven, and the wagon were ready and waiting.
paras.zh: 马上回来。“克里斯托夫、雪宝、斯文和马车都已备好等着。

paras.en: They were deep in a debate about which treat from Blodget’s Bakery was the best.
paras.zh: 他们正热烈争论布洛杰特面包房哪种点心最棒。

paras.en: Kristoff, in his best Sven voice, was answering. “Really, I insist, it must be the carrot cake.” “Cake!” Anna’s stomach rumbled; one krumkake was never enough. “Oh, I do hope I’m back in time for cake, but for now… let’s go plant some seeds.” “Think there’s extra cake for us, too?” Kristoff asked.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫用他最像斯文的嗓音答道：”真的，我坚持，一定是胡萝卜蛋糕。“”蛋糕！“安娜肚子咕咕叫；一块卷饼哪够。”哦，真希望我能赶回来吃蛋糕，不过现在嘛……咱们去种种子吧。“”你说会不会也给我们留点蛋糕？“克里斯托夫问。

paras.en: He flicked the reins and told Sven, “We’re off to the fields.” “Olaf,” Anna said, “I need a present.
paras.zh: 他甩了甩缰绳，对斯文说：”咱们去田里。“”雪宝，“安娜说，”我需要一份礼物。

paras.en: What should I give a ten-year-old?” “A puppy!” Olaf suggested immediately.
paras.zh: 该送十岁孩子什么好？“”小狗！“雪宝立刻提议。

paras.en: Anna shook her head. “No live gifts.” Olaf paused to think. “A boat?
paras.zh: 安娜摇了摇头。”不要活物当礼物。“雪宝略一思索。”小船？

paras.en: A sauna?
paras.zh: 桑拿房？

paras.en: A bridge?” Kristoff turned around in the driver’s seat. “Are you just naming things you see?” They all laughed when Olaf said, “Well, yes.” Kristoff leaned forward to pat the reindeer. “I always give Sven a bunch of carrots.” He switched to his Sven voice and spoke for the reindeer. “The perfect gift.
paras.zh: 桥？“克里斯托夫在车夫座上转过身。”你是在报眼前看到的东西吗？“雪宝答”嗯，是啊“时，大家都笑了。克里斯托夫前倾拍了拍驯鹿。”我总给斯文一大把胡萝卜。“他切换成斯文的嗓音替驯鹿说话。”最完美的礼物。

paras.en: Thank you, Kristoff.” In his normal voice, he added, “The trolls gave me a new moss quilt for my birthday every year.” Anna smiled at the mention of his unusual family. “While I’m sure that was lovely, that’s probably not the right gift for Berit.” Olaf leaned his head on Anna’s shoulder. “I’ve never been to a tenth-birthday party.” Anna sighed. “Unless you count those five minutes, me neither.” She tried to remember what she’d wanted when she was ten.
paras.zh: 谢谢你，克里斯托夫。“他用平常的声音补了一句，”地精每年生日都送我一条新苔藓被。“安娜听到他这个特别的家庭，微微一笑。”那想必很温馨，不过大概不是送给贝丽特的好礼物。“雪宝把头靠上安娜的肩。”我从未参加过十岁生日派对。“安娜叹气。”要不算上那五分钟，我也没参加过。“她努力回想自己十岁时想要什么。

paras.en: Mostly it had just been Elsa’s company.
paras.zh: 大多只是想有艾莎陪在身边。

paras.en: Sven’s hooves clattered to a stop, and Olaf hopped up on the seat, his sadness forgotten as he spread his arms to point at the freshly plowed fields. “Have you ever been to a seed dedication?
paras.zh: 斯文的蹄声得得停下，雪宝蹦上座位，忘了方才的伤感，张开双臂指向刚犁好的田地。”你参加过种子供奉仪式吗？

paras.en: Because we’re here!” Anna straightened her crown again and smoothed her skirt as she stepped out of the wagon.
paras.zh: 咱们到啦！“安娜下车时，又扶正王冠、抚平裙摆。

paras.en: Think queenly, regal thoughts, she told herself.
paras.zh: 要想些女王范儿、威严的念头，她对自己说。

paras.en: But her queenly, regal thoughts were interrupted by Sven clearing his throat.
paras.zh: 可她这女王范儿的思绪，被斯文清嗓子的声音打断了。

paras.en: He lifted a hoof and gestured to his snout.
paras.zh: 他抬起一只蹄子，指了指自己的鼻子。

paras.en: At first she thought he was demanding a snack—which was fair; he’d been busy that morning—but then he pointed his hoof at her.
paras.zh: 起初她以为他在讨吃的——这也难怪，他一上午可没闲着——可接着他把蹄子指向了她。

paras.en: Anna wiped her mouth, her hand coming away with an impressive number of krumkake crumbs. “Thanks, Sven,” she whispered, cleaning her hand on her skirt before extending it to shake Farmer Niels’s. “Welcome, Queen Anna.” Niels used his broad-brimmed hat to gesture to all the other farmers standing alongside the field. “We are honored you’ve come to plant the ceremonial first seed as a sign of the coming spring and our hope for a good growing season.” “I’m glad to be here.” Anna bounced on the toes of her purple silk shoes, which caused them to sink into the soft soil. “Do you know my favorite part of spring?” Olaf popped up between Anna and Niels to ask. “It’s almost summer.” The snowman sighed and got a dreamy look on his face. “Ah, summer…” The farmers, Anna, and Kristoff waited for his reverie to end, but after five seconds Sven snorted impatiently and Anna blurted, “So, basically what I need to do is plant a seed?
paras.zh: 安娜擦了擦嘴，手上沾了一大把卷饼屑。”谢了，斯文，“她低声说，在裙子上擦净手，才伸出去和尼尔森农夫握手。”欢迎您，安娜女王。“尼尔森用宽檐帽向田边站着的众农夫一指。”您能来种下象征春天将至、寄托我们对丰收期盼的仪式头一粒种子，我们深感荣幸。“”很高兴来到这里。“安娜踮着紫色绸鞋的脚尖蹦了蹦，鞋尖陷进松软的泥土。”你知道我最喜欢春天的哪一点吗？“雪宝从安娜和尼尔森之间冒出来问道。”快到夏天了。“雪人叹了口气，一脸神往。”啊，夏天……“农夫们、安娜和克里斯托夫等着他回过神来，可五秒后斯文不耐烦地打了个响鼻，安娜脱口而出：”所以，基本上我只要种下一粒种子就行？

paras.en: I’ve never done that before.
paras.zh: 我以前从没种过。

paras.en: Sounds fun.” “The ceremonial first seed of the season,” Niels said, correcting her.
paras.zh: 听起来挺好玩。“”本季仪式用的头一粒种子，“尼尔森纠正道。

paras.en: He gestured to another farmer, who stepped forward holding a large bag of seeds.
paras.zh: 他朝另一位农夫示意，那人捧着一大袋种子走上前。

paras.en: Niels reached inside, plucked one out, and placed it carefully in Anna’s cupped hands. “It’s so tiny!” she said, marveling and balancing it on the tip of her finger so she could see the speck better. “I’ve got freckles bigger than this.” “That’s smaller than Sven’s fleas,” said Kristoff as he peered over her shoulder.
paras.zh: 尼尔森伸手进去，捻出一粒，小心放进安娜捧起的手心。”这么小！“她惊叹道，把它立在指尖上，好更清楚地看那颗小点。”我脸上的雀斑都比它大。“”比斯文身上的跳蚤还小，“克里斯托夫从她肩后探头说。

paras.en: When the reindeer stomped a foot indignantly, Kristoff scratched his own head and said, “You know, if he had fleas—which he doesn’t.
paras.zh: 驯鹿愤愤地跺了跺脚，克里斯托夫挠了挠自己的头说：”你知道，要是他有跳蚤——其实他没有。

paras.en: I don’t, either.” He froze mid-scratch and lowered his hand, bumping Anna’s outstretched one.
paras.zh: 我也没有。“他挠到一半僵住，放下手，碰到了安娜伸着的手。

paras.en: She looked up from her finger—her now bare finger—and smiled sheepishly at the farmers. “Uh… How important is the ‘ceremonial’ part versus the ‘first’ part?” She held out her empty hand. “Because I might have accidentally lost it.” There was a collective gasp from the farmers as Anna dropped to her knees. “But don’t worry!
paras.zh: 她从指尖——如今空空如也的指尖——抬起眼，朝农夫们不好意思地笑了笑。”呃……'仪式'和'头一粒'哪部分更重要？“她摊开空空的手。”因为我可能不小心把它弄丢了。“农夫们齐声倒吸凉气，安娜已跪倒在地。”不过别担心！

paras.en: I’ll find it!” She scanned the bumpy ground in front of her. “It really is very tiny, though.
paras.zh: 我找得回来！“她扫视眼前坑洼的地面。”不过它真的非常小。

paras.en: Does it have to be so impossibly small?” Anna leaned forward and pinched something off the ground. “Is that it?
paras.zh: 非得小到这种地步吗？“安娜俯身从地上捏起什么。”是它吗？

paras.en: No, that’s dirt.
paras.zh: 不，那是泥。

paras.en: That’s dirt, too.
paras.zh: 那也是泥。

paras.en: That’s—that’s krumkake crumbs.
paras.zh: 那是——那是卷饼渣。

paras.en: It’s going to be nearly impossible to find it among all this dirt—but… ceremonial first seed.
paras.zh: 要在这么多泥里找到它，简直难如登天——可是……这是仪式头一粒种子。

paras.en: Don’t worry.
paras.zh: 别担心。

paras.en: I’ll keep looking.” “Your Majesty, you’re muddying your gown!” said Niels. “Please stand up.
paras.zh: 我会继续找。“”陛下，您把礼裙弄脏了！“尼尔森说，”快起来吧。

paras.en: We’ll give you another seed!” Anna’s cheeks burned as she stood and wiped her dirty hands on her skirt.
paras.zh: 我们再给您一粒就是！“安娜脸颊发烫，站起身，在裙子上擦了擦脏手。

paras.en: She hoped she hadn’t let the farmers down, and she really wished her sister were there.
paras.zh: 她但愿没让农夫们失望，也更盼着姐姐能在身边。

paras.en: Elsa wouldn’t have dropped the seed.
paras.zh: 艾莎绝不会把种子弄掉。

paras.en: She probably would’ve floated it into the ground on a beautiful, magical snowflake. “If you plant two seeds, that’s got to be double the luck,” called out a grinning farmer in green overalls. “So double thanks from us all, Queen Anna.” Kristoff caught her eye and gave her an encouraging thumbs-up.
paras.zh: 她大概会用一片美丽的魔法雪花，把它送进土里。”你种两粒，运气准能翻倍，“一位穿绿背带裤、咧嘴笑的农夫喊道，”那我们大伙儿就双倍感谢您啦，安娜女王。“克里斯托夫与她目光相接，给了她一个鼓励的大拇指。

paras.en: Anna smiled weakly and held out her hand for a second ceremonial “first” seed.
paras.zh: 安娜勉强一笑，伸出手去接第二粒仪式”头“种子。

paras.en: This time she bent and carefully placed it directly in the pre-dug hole Niels indicated.
paras.zh: 这次她弯下腰，小心把它放进尼尔森指定的预先挖好的小坑里。

paras.en: He looked at her with an expectant smile.
paras.zh: 他带着期待的微笑望着她。

paras.en: All the farmers were, actually.
paras.zh: 其实所有农夫都是。

paras.en: Maybe she was supposed to say something? “Um.” She thought quickly. “May this seed be a symbol of all the crops.
paras.zh: 莫非她该说点什么？”呃。“她飞快思索。”愿这粒种子成为所有庄稼的象征。

paras.en: May Arendelle’s skies be filled with the perfect amount of sunshine and rain and…” “And who knows—maybe in a few months we’ll be singing about this Peter Pumpkin becoming fertilizer,” added Olaf as he tapped a snowball foot over the hole.
paras.zh: 愿阿伦黛尔的天空有恰到好处的阳光与雨水，还有……“”说不定几个月后，我们就会唱起这颗'彼得南瓜'化作肥料的故事，“雪宝边说边用雪球脚在坑上轻敲。

paras.en: Niels cleared his throat. “That was a carrot seed.” Sven grunted and swiveled his head toward the mention of his favorite food. “Oh.” Olaf nodded. “So in a few months we’ll be chasing Sven away from these fields.” “Speaking of away from the fields …”—Anna glanced down the hill toward Arendelle’s clock tower—“as much as I’d love to stay, I’ve got to get back to the castle.” As she dashed through the castle’s corridors, Anna’s braid began to unravel.
paras.zh: 尼尔森清了清嗓子。”那是一粒胡萝卜种子。“斯文听到最爱的食物，咕哝一声转过头。”哦。“雪宝点头。”那么几个月后，我们可得把斯文从田里赶走了。“”说到离开田地……“——安娜朝山下阿伦黛尔的钟楼望了一眼——”虽然我很想留下，但我得回城堡了。“她冲过城堡走廊时，辫子开始散开。

paras.en: She tucked it under her crown and hoped it would stay put.
paras.zh: 她把辫子塞进王冠底下，但愿它能固定住。

paras.en: Maybe she’d start a new hair trend.
paras.zh: 说不定她能引领新发型潮流。

paras.en: Disheveled chic?
paras.zh: 慵懒风？

paras.en: That could be a thing.
paras.zh: 没准会流行。

paras.en: Anna took a deep breath and entered the library. “Prince Lars, Princess Helga, I’m so sorry to keep you waiting.” “Oh.” They looked up from their books, seeming startled to find her standing there. “No problem, Queen Anna,” said Lars. “This really is a wonderful library you have.” “I’m so glad to hear it.” She slumped onto a chair and caught her breath. “There was a minor issue I had to take care of, but I’m here now.” Helga lowered her book. “What sort of issue?
paras.zh: 安娜深吸一口气，走进藏书室。”拉尔斯王子、赫尔加公主，让二位久等，万分抱歉。“”哦。“他俩从书中抬起头，似乎惊讶地发现她就站在那儿。”没关系，安娜女王，“拉尔斯说，”您这藏书室真是绝妙。“”听您这么说我很高兴。“她瘫坐到椅子上喘了口气。”方才有点小状况要处理，不过我现在回来了。“赫尔加放下书。”什么样的状况？

paras.en: Your gown is muddy.” “And you’ve lost an earring.” Lars inserted a bookmark and closed his cover. “Is everything okay?” “I’m missing an earring?” Anna’s hands flew to her ears, confirming that, yes, her left lobe was bare. “The symbol of the good relationship between our countries?
paras.zh: 您的礼裙沾了泥。“”而且您还掉了一只耳环。“拉尔斯夹好书签合上封面。”一切还好吗？“”我少了一只耳环？“安娜双手飞向耳边，确认左耳垂确实空着。”那象征两国友好关系的耳环？

paras.en: Oh, no!” The prince and princess exchanged alarmed looks when Anna jumped out of her seat. “I’m sure it will—” Helga began. “I’ll find it!” Anna called over her shoulder. “Don’t worry.
paras.zh: 哦，不！“安娜跳起身时，王子和公主交换了惊慌的眼神。”我确信会——“赫尔加开口。”我去找回来！“安娜回过头喊道。”别担心。

paras.en: Be right back.” She burst into the hallway and bent over—both to catch her breath and to scan the carpet.
paras.zh: 马上回来。“她冲进走廊，弯下腰——既为喘口气，也为搜寻地毯。

paras.en: No earring anywhere she could see, but there was a friendly snowman. “Are we still looking for the carrot seed?” Olaf asked. “Because I’m pretty sure that’s a goner.” Between pants, Anna filled him in. “Did you know that amber sinks in fresh water but floats in salt water?” Olaf began his own scan of the carpet. “That doesn’t really work here.
paras.zh: 地毯上哪儿都看不到耳环，却有个友好的雪人。”咱们还在找胡萝卜种子吗？“雪宝问，”因为我相当确定它已经没戏了。“安娜喘着气把情况告诉了他。”你知道琥珀在淡水里会沉、在盐水里会浮吗？“雪宝也开始在地毯上搜寻。”那在这儿派不上用场。

paras.en: We’d have to flood the whole castle to get it to float.
paras.zh: 咱们得把整座城堡淹了才能让它浮起来。

paras.en: So we should probably just keep looking.” “It’s got to be at the party.” Anna straightened up and straightened her crown. “At least it gives me an excuse to head back there.
paras.zh: 所以咱们大概还是继续找吧。“”准是在派对上。“安娜直起身，扶正王冠。”至少这给了我回去一趟的借口。

paras.en: Let’s go!” All these quick trips over the cobblestones were starting to make Anna feel wagon-sick.
paras.zh: 走吧！“这一趟趟在鹅卵石路上奔波，安娜开始觉得坐车坐得犯晕。

paras.en: Or maybe she was hungry.
paras.zh: 或许她是饿了。

paras.en: What she wouldn’t give for some chocolate right about then.
paras.zh: 那一刻，她恨不得用一切去换点巧克力。

paras.en: Thinking of chocolate, Anna groaned. “I still don’t have a present for Berit.
paras.zh: 想到巧克力，安娜呻吟起来。”我还没给贝丽特准备礼物。

paras.en: Where’s Oaken’s Cloaken’s when you need it?” Olaf tapped his chin. “It’s a few streets over.
paras.zh: 急需奥肯百货时，它偏不在。“”雪宝敲了敲下巴。“它就在几条街外。

paras.en: Oooh, are we getting her a sauna after all?
paras.zh: 哦，咱们难道还是要给她买桑拿房？

paras.en: Or some sunscreen?
paras.zh: 还是买点防晒霜？

paras.en: It’s Oaken’s own invention.
paras.zh: 那可是奥肯自创的。

paras.en: Smells like lutefisk.” The whole wagon was laughing when they reached Berit’s house, but Anna was surprised to hear laughing coming from inside , too.
paras.zh: 闻起来像碱渍鱼。”马车到贝丽特家时，一车人都笑了起来，可安娜意外地听到屋里也传来笑声。

paras.en: Good!
paras.zh: 太好了！

paras.en: Maybe they didn’t need her anymore.
paras.zh: 说不定他们已经不需要她了。

paras.en: She could just pop in, grab her earring, apologize for forgetting her present—again—and then get back to the castle before Lars and Helga finished their books. “Queen Anna!” Berit called from the doorway. “You’re back!” “I am,” said Anna. “It looks like you made some friends.” “It’s because they heard you were here!” Berit was the first to hug Anna, but a half dozen children piled on. “Can you stay?” “Oof.” Anna looked over the heads of the group surrounding her.
paras.zh: 她只需进去一下，取回耳环，为又忘了礼物道个歉，赶在拉尔斯和赫尔加读完书之前回城堡就成了。“安娜女王！”贝丽特在门口喊，“您回来啦！”“回来了，”安娜说，“看来你交到朋友了。”“因为他们听说您在这儿！”贝丽特第一个抱住安娜，随即五六个孩子一拥而上。“您能留下吗？”“哎哟。”安娜从围着她的那群孩子头顶望过去。

paras.en: She didn’t spot the earring anywhere. “For a little while.
paras.zh: 她哪儿也没瞧见耳环。“待一小会儿吧。

paras.en: How about a party game?
paras.zh: 来玩个派对游戏怎样？

paras.en: Hide-and-seek?” Berit’s mom helped peel the cheering children off Anna as the birthday girl announced, “I’ll count first.
paras.zh: 捉迷藏？”贝丽特的妈妈帮着把欢呼的孩子从安娜身上扒开，小寿星宣布：“我先数。

paras.en: Everyone’s playing.
paras.zh: 大家都玩。

paras.en: You too, Mama.” Anna used the counting time to search for her earring.
paras.zh: 您也是，妈妈。”安娜趁数数的工夫寻找耳环。

paras.en: It wasn’t beneath the tablecloth—but there were two boys giggling under there.
paras.zh: 桌布底下没有——不过有两个男孩在那儿咯咯笑。

paras.en: It wasn’t behind a stack of unpacked crates with Berit’s mom.
paras.zh: 也没在贝丽特妈妈身旁那叠未拆的箱子后。

paras.en: It wasn’t on or under the flowered cushion of the chair. “Ten.
paras.zh: 也不在椅子花垫的上面或底下。“十。

paras.en: Nine.
paras.zh: 九。

paras.en: Eight…” Berit was facing the stone fireplace with her hands firmly over her eyes.
paras.zh: 八……”贝丽特面朝石壁炉，双手紧紧蒙住眼睛。

paras.en: The earring didn’t appear to be on the mantel, either. “Drat!” whispered Anna.
paras.zh: 耳环似乎也不在壁炉架上。“糟了！”安娜低声说。

paras.en: Maybe it truly was in the castle hallway.
paras.zh: 说不定它真在城堡走廊里。

paras.en: Or in the field!
paras.zh: 或者在田里！

paras.en: As Berit counted, “Five-four-three… ,” Anna snuck out of the house and climbed into the wagon. “Where to?” asked Kristoff. “The castle.” Anna rubbed her forehead.
paras.zh: 贝丽特数着“五四三……”时，安娜偷偷溜出家门，爬上马车。“去哪儿？”克里斯托夫问。“城堡。”安娜揉了揉额头。

paras.en: She was getting sweaty from all the running around, which was not helping her crown stay put. “Olina is going to kill me.
paras.zh: 四处奔波让她渗出了汗，王冠更戴不稳了。“奥丽娜非杀了我不可。

paras.en: Lunch has got to be so cold.” “Eh.” Kristoff shrugged as the wagon bumped toward the docks and the castle beyond. “Arendelle’s main export is ice.
paras.zh: 午饭准凉透了。”“呃。”马车颠簸着驶向码头和更远处的城堡，克里斯托夫耸耸肩。“阿伦黛尔的主要出口是冰。

paras.en: Tell the prince it’s supposed to be cold, that he’s just getting a taste of our goods.” “Kristoff, that’s brilliant!” Or maybe it was bonkers; Anna wasn’t sure which.
paras.zh: 告诉王子，凉才是正常的，他不过是先尝尝咱们的货色。”“克里斯托夫，这主意绝了！”——或者简直荒唐，安娜也拿不准。

paras.en: He looked delighted as he paused the wagon by the harbor to let a baker with an overloaded cart pass.
paras.zh: 他在港口边停下马车，让一位推着超载推车的面包师先过，脸上满是欣喜。

paras.en: The scent of freshly baked bread made Anna’s stomach rumble. “There you are, Your Majesty,” someone called. “We thought you’d forgotten us.” Anna turned to see the harbormaster waiting with a group of boat captains. “No, of course not,” she told him. “Er, forgotten what exactly?” “Why, the boat christening ceremony, of course.
paras.zh: 新鲜面包的香气让安娜肚子咕咕叫。“陛下，您可算来了，”有人喊道，“我们还以为您把我们忘了。”安娜转身，看见港务长领着一群船长在等候。“不，当然没有，”她答道，“呃，具体忘了什么来着？”“嗨，当然是新船命名仪式呀。

paras.en: For Captain Thea’s new ship.” “Right!
paras.zh: 为西娅船长的新船。”“对！

paras.en: The boat christening.” Anna climbed off the wagon.
paras.zh: 新船命名。”“安娜下了马车。

paras.en: Huh.
paras.zh: 嗯。

paras.en: She must’ve slept right through Kai’s mentioning that, but now that she thought about it, she did recall Captain Thea asking her a few weeks earlier, and of course she’d said yes.
paras.zh: 她准是凯提起这事儿时睡过去了，不过现在回想，她确实记得几周前西娅船长来问过她，她自然一口应下。

paras.en: Anna would really have to start remembering to check her schedule.
paras.zh: 安娜真得开始记着查看日程了。

paras.en: Also, what was a boat christening?
paras.zh: 还有，新船命名仪式到底是怎么个弄法？

paras.en: Was it quick?
paras.zh: 快不快？

paras.en: Luckily, it was .
paras.zh: 幸好，很快。

paras.en: The harbormaster recited a short poem about calm seas and gentle waves and then asked Anna to crack a bottle across the ship’s bow. “Really give it a good whack,” he said encouragingly. “It’s bad luck if it doesn’t break.” “Wouldn’t want that.” Anna inhaled and concentrated on putting all her muscle into swinging the bottle at the ship.
paras.zh: 港务长念了首关于风平浪静的短诗，然后请安娜用酒瓶在船首砸碎。”使劲砸，“他鼓励道，”不碎可不吉利。“”那可不行。“安娜深吸一口气，凝神聚力，把全身力气都用在向船身挥瓶上。

paras.en: It smashed beautifully, and the captains cheered and clapped.
paras.zh: 瓶子漂亮地碎裂，船长们欢呼鼓掌。

paras.en: They spun Anna down the dock in a parade of hugs, backslaps, and praise.
paras.zh: 他们簇拥着安娜沿码头前行，一路拥抱、拍背、称赞。

paras.en: It was important to her that she acknowledge everyone waiting to greet her, but when she reached the end of the line—and the end of the dock—she leaned back against a ship to steal a moment of privacy.
paras.zh: 向每位等候问候的人致意对她十分重要，可当她走到队伍尽头——也是码头尽头——她靠在一艘船上，偷得片刻独处。

paras.en: She just needed to catch her breath before she raced back to the wagon, the castle, the meeting, the party.… “Heads up!” called someone from above her, and Anna did raise her head—just in time to see a deckhand with a mop toss a bucket of dirty water over the side of boat… and all over her.
paras.zh: 她只想喘口气，再奔回马车、城堡、会议、派对……”抬头！“上方有人喊，安娜还真抬起头——正好看见一名水手拿着拖把，把一桶脏水从船舷泼下……全泼在了她身上。

paras.en: Anna couldn’t shriek; she didn’t want to scare the poor deckhand.
paras.zh: 安娜发不出尖叫；她不想吓着那可怜的水手。

paras.en: It wasn’t his fault she’d been hiding in the path of his mop water.
paras.zh: 她自己躲在拖把水的路径上，可不是他的错。

paras.en: But what was she going to do ?
paras.zh: 可她该怎么办？

paras.en: What could possibly be the next right thing?
paras.zh: 当下到底该做哪件对的事？

paras.en: Anna dripped her way back down the dock, drawing shocked and confused glances from all the people who’d seen her—dry—just moments before. “Kristoff,” she called, trying to hang on to her smile. “I got you,” he said, clasping her wet hand in his dry, steady one and helping her off the dock. “What—what happened?” “Mop water and—never mind that.” Anna looked down at the puddle forming around her feet. “I can’t go back to the meeting like this!” “Um, you could tell them that since Arendelle’s biggest export is ice, you’re demonstrating ice in its liquid form.” Kristoff shook his head. “Nope.
paras.zh: 安娜滴着水沿码头往回走，方才见她干干爽爽的那些人，此刻都投来震惊又困惑的目光。”克里斯托夫，“她喊道，努力挂住笑脸。”有我在，“他说着，用自己干爽稳健的手握住她湿漉漉的手，扶她下码头。”怎、怎么了？“”拖把水，算了，别提了。“安娜低头看着脚边积起的水洼。”我这副模样可没法回会议！“”呃，你可以告诉他们，既然阿伦黛尔最大的出口是冰，你正用液态形式演示冰。“克里斯托夫摇了摇头。”不行。

paras.en: Don’t call me brilliant this time.
paras.zh: 这回可别夸我绝了。

paras.en: I got nothing.” “Your Majesty,” two people called from her right.
paras.zh: 我什么主意也没有。“”陛下，“右侧两人喊道。

paras.en: One was the harbormaster, carrying a stack of towels.
paras.zh: 一位是港务长，抱着一叠毛巾。

paras.en: They smelled suspiciously fishy.
paras.zh: 那味道透着可疑的鱼腥气。

paras.en: The second was Dagmar, the dressmaker. “Queen Anna,” Dagmar said from the door to her shop. “I have your new dress practically finished.
paras.zh: 另一位是裁缝达格玛。”安娜女王，“达格玛在店门口说，”您的新裙子基本做好了。

paras.en: Step in here and we’ll get you changed in a jiffy.” “Really?” Anna beamed.
paras.zh: 进来吧，我们马上给您换上。“”真的？“安娜眉开眼笑。

paras.en: Kristoff groaned as he flopped onto a bench in front of the store. “The dressmaker always takes forever.” “No, no,” said Anna, both in response to the harbormaster’s offer of fish-scented towels and to her disgruntled fiancé. “This will be quick.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫一屁股坐在店前的长椅上，叹了口气。”裁缝向来磨蹭得要命。“”不不，“安娜答道，既回应港务长那鱼腥味毛巾的提议，也安抚不情愿的未婚夫，”这次很快。

paras.en: The dress is practically done, right, Dagmar?” “Of course, Your Majesty.
paras.zh: 裙子基本做好了，对吧，达格玛？“”当然，陛下。

paras.en: Just a few final stitches.” “I’ll be right back.” Anna seemed to be saying that an awful lot.
paras.zh: 就差最后几针。“”我马上回来。“安娜这话似乎说得太多了。

paras.en: Except… how could a few final stitches take so long?
paras.zh: 可是……区区几针，怎会拖这么久？

paras.en: Normally she appreciated Dagmar’s attention to detail.
paras.zh: 平时她很欣赏达格玛的细致。

paras.en: But not at the moment.
paras.zh: 但此刻可没这份心情。

paras.en: After hearing a particularly loud sigh from Sven though the shop’s open window, Anna stepped off the dressmaker’s stool. “Thank you so much, Dagmar.
paras.zh: 透过店敞开的窗，听到斯文一声格外响亮的叹息后，安娜从裁缝凳上站了起来。”太谢谢你了，达格玛。

paras.en: The dress is beautiful—but I really must be going.
paras.zh: 裙子真美——可我真的得走了。

paras.en: There’s a luncheon and they’re waiting and—” Anna tripped on the hem but turned it into a curtsy. “Thank you!” “Bo-bing?” Dagmar spat out the pins she had balanced between her lips. “Going, Your Majesty?
paras.zh: 那边有午宴，大家都在等——“安娜被裙摆绊了一下，顺势行了个屈膝礼。”多谢！“”别——冰？“达格玛吐出衔在唇间的针。”这就走啊，陛下？

paras.en: But there are still pins along the seams.” Anna waved her hand. “It’ll be fine.
paras.zh: 可缝边还别着针呢。“安娜摆了摆手。”没事的。

paras.en: I’m sure it’ll be fine.
paras.zh: 肯定没事的。

paras.en: Thank you again.” She dashed out the door with a final wave.
paras.zh: 再次感谢。“她最后挥了挥手，冲出门去。

paras.en: Kristoff quickly had Sven buckled into his harness, and Olaf bounced into the wagon. “Ouch!” Anna exclaimed as she settled onto the bench beside him.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫麻利地给斯文套上挽具，雪宝蹦上马车。”哎哟！“安娜在他身旁坐定，叫出声来。

paras.en: She’d just found the first pin.
paras.zh: 她刚碰到了第一根针。

paras.en: By the time they made it through the castle gates, she’d found three more. “You’re like a royal pincushion,” Olaf said. “Or a yo-yo—back and forth.
paras.zh: 等他们穿过城堡大门时，她又找到了三根。”你像个皇家针垫，“雪宝说，”或者说像个溜溜球——来来回回。

paras.en: Back and forth.” “So true, Olaf.” She gave each of them a hasty hug before scrambling down and through the castle door. “So true.” Anna shoved her crown onto her sopping hair before plunging into the library. “Hello again!
paras.zh: 来来回回。“”说得太对了，雪宝。“她匆匆挨个拥抱了他们，才连滚带爬地钻过城堡大门。”太对了。“安娜把王冠往湿淋淋的头发上一扣，冲进藏书室。”又见面啦！

paras.en: Now, where were we?” Lars didn’t look up from his book. “You were looking for your missing earring.” Helga marked her page with a finger and gave a startled blink. “Did you change dresses, Your Majesty?
paras.zh: 那么，我们方才说到哪儿了？“拉尔斯没从书里抬头。”您在找您丢的那只耳环。“赫尔加用手指夹住书页，惊讶地眨了眨眼。”陛下，您换裙子了？

paras.en: That’s a lovely shade of green.” “Right!
paras.zh: 那绿色真好看。“”对！

paras.en: My earring.” Anna raised a hand to her still-empty earlobe, then pivoted. “I’ll go find that.” She was halfway in the hall when a pin’s jab reminded her of Helga’s compliment. “Oh, and thank you.
paras.zh: 我的耳环。“安娜抬手摸了摸仍空着的耳垂，随即转身。”我去找它。“她走到走廊一半，一根针的刺痛让她想起赫尔加的夸赞。”哦，还有，谢谢你。

paras.en: Be right back.” “Mm-hmm.” Helga was already engrossed in her book. “Take your time.” At least they didn’t miss her.
paras.zh: 马上回来。“”嗯哼。“赫尔加已沉浸书中。”慢慢来。“好在没人念叨她。

paras.en: There’d been a tray of sandwiches and soup on the table, so clearly Olina had known not to delay the meal for her.
paras.zh: 桌上摆着一盘三明治和汤，显然奥丽娜知道不必为她推迟开饭。

paras.en: Her stomach rumbled as she raced down the hallway.
paras.zh: 她沿走廊飞奔时，肚子咕咕直叫。

paras.en: She should’ve grabbed a sandwich to go.
paras.zh: 她方才真该顺手拿个三明治带走。

paras.en: The earring had to be at the party, right?
paras.zh: 耳环准在派对上，对吧？

paras.en: She must’ve overlooked it last time.
paras.zh: 上回她准是漏看了。

paras.en: Or maybe it was in the field?
paras.zh: 或者它在田里？

paras.en: She hoped she hadn’t planted it with the ceremonial second seed.
paras.zh: 她但愿没把它和那第二粒仪式种子一起种进土里。

paras.en: Anna was out of breath by the time she reached the wagon.
paras.zh: 安娜赶到马车边时已经上气不接下气。

paras.en: Sven and Olaf looked like they’d been napping, and Kristoff was casually strumming his lute.
paras.zh: 斯文和雪宝像刚睡过一觉，克里斯托夫正随意拨弄着鲁特琴。

paras.en: They all jumped when she clambered in and gasped, “Back to the party.” “Already?” Kristoff looked at her flushed face and changed his question to a statement. “All righty—let’s go.” The earring was not at the party, but plenty more children were.
paras.zh: 她爬上车、喘着气喊”回派对“时，大家都吓了一跳。”又去？“克里斯托夫看着她涨红的脸，把疑问改成了陈述。”好嘞——走吧。“耳环不在派对上，可孩子却多了不少。

paras.en: Berit gave her a delighted smile. “You’re very good at hide-and-seek!
paras.zh: 贝丽特冲她欢喜地一笑。”您捉迷藏可真厉害！

paras.en: No one could find you anywhere.
paras.zh: 哪儿都找不到您。

paras.en: Did you see all my new friends?” Anna nodded.
paras.zh: 您看到我所有新朋友了吗？“安娜点点头。

paras.en: She was exhausted.
paras.zh: 她累坏了。

paras.en: Also hungry.
paras.zh: 也饿坏了。

paras.en: And all the krumkaker were gone. “My new friends were asking if you’d come to their birthday parties, too,” Berit told her. “I said of course you would.
paras.zh: 而卷饼全吃光了。”我的新朋友们问，您会不会也去参加他们的生日派对，“贝丽特告诉她，”我说您当然会去。

paras.en: You will, right?” There were at least twenty sets of eyes watching her.
paras.zh: 您会去的，对吧？“至少有二十双眼睛盯着她。

paras.en: How could she disappoint them?
paras.zh: 她怎忍心让他们失望？

paras.en: But twenty parties?
paras.zh: 可二十场派对？

paras.en: Twenty more days like this?
paras.zh: 再熬二十个这样的日子？

paras.en: Anna’s stomach rumbled.
paras.zh: 安娜的肚子咕咕叫。

paras.en: She looked at the empty dessert tray.
paras.zh: 她望着空空的甜点盘。

paras.en: Her wet hair dripped down her back, and a pin poked her shin as she took a shaky breath and a step back toward the door. “Um, wow.
paras.zh: 湿发顺着后背往下滴，一根针扎进她小腿，她深吸一口气，颤抖着后退一步朝门口挪。”呃，哇。

paras.en: What an honor to have so many invitations.… I really must be going now.
paras.zh: 收到这么多邀请，真是我莫大的荣幸……我真的得走了。

paras.en: Thank you for inviting me to your wonderful party.” Outside, Kristoff had the wagon ready. “Where to now?” he asked. “The harbor?
paras.zh: 谢谢你邀我参加这么棒的派对。“屋外，克里斯托夫已备好马车。”现在去哪儿？“他问，”码头？

paras.en: The castle?
paras.zh: 城堡？

paras.en: The fields?
paras.zh: 田地？

paras.en: Somewhere new?” Anna’s hands trembled as she removed her crown.
paras.zh: 还是新地方？“安娜摘下王冠，双手微微发抖。

paras.en: It kept slipping in her wet hair. “Um.” “Anywhere on Arenfjord.
paras.zh: 王冠在湿发上直打滑。”呃。“”阿伦峡湾哪儿都行。

paras.en: You just tell me where to go,” he said encouragingly, gripping the reins. “I’m not sure.
paras.zh: 你只管说去哪儿，“他握着缰绳，鼓励道。”我也说不准。

paras.en: I need to”—she closed her eyes—“think.
paras.zh: 我得——“她闭上眼——”想想。

paras.en: Next right thing… but which is next ?” “What is she doing?” asked Olaf. “Shhh,” said Anna. “Give me a second.” Olaf gave her half of one before whispering to Kristoff, “Do you think we need to call a doctor?
paras.zh: 做当下该做的事……可哪件才是'当下'？“”她在干吗？“雪宝问。”嘘，“安娜说，”给我一秒钟。“雪宝只安静了半秒，就凑到克里斯托夫耳边悄声问：”你觉得要不要请医生？

paras.en: Is she frozen again?
paras.zh: 她又冻住了？

paras.en: Do we need to tell Grand Pabbie?
paras.zh: 要不要告诉皮比长老？

paras.en: Maybe someone should go get Elsa.” “I’m already ahead of you, little buddy,” Kristoff whispered back.
paras.zh: 或许该派人去叫艾莎。“”小家伙，我早就想到你前头了，“克里斯托夫悄声回道。

paras.en: Anna opened her eyes. “I think I need my sis—” “Anna!” The cry, accompanied by a whinny, came from behind them.
paras.zh: 安娜睁开眼。”我想我需要我姐——“”安娜！“一声呼喊伴着嘶鸣从身后传来。

paras.en: She spun to see Elsa and a frozen Water Nokk galloping into the square and pivoting into a graceful stop.
paras.zh: 她转身，看见艾莎和一头冻住的水马奔进广场，优雅地一转停住。

paras.en: As Elsa dismounted, Anna ran to embrace her. “How did you know I needed you?” “A little birdie told me—a paper birdie, written by Kristoff and delivered by Gale.
paras.zh: 艾莎下马时，安娜跑上去拥抱她。”你怎么知道我需要你？“”一只小鸟告诉我的——一只纸小鸟，是克里斯托夫写的，由风灵盖尔送来。

paras.en: I called the Water Nokk.” She gestured to the water horse, which nodded and stomped its watery hoof, leaving a small puddle on the cobblestones. “Tough day?” “You didn’t have to drop everything and come,” Anna said, but she was glad Elsa had. “That’s what sisters are for.
paras.zh: 我唤来了水马。“她朝那匹水马一指，水马点了点头，用水做的蹄子跺了跺，在鹅卵石上留下一小滩水。”今天不好过？“”你不必放下一切赶来的，“安娜说，可她心里高兴艾莎来了。”姐妹本就该这样。

paras.en: You taught me that.” Elsa took the crown and placed it back on Anna’s head, then braided her hair. “How did you do it, Elsa?” Anna asked, her blue-green eyes watery. “I want to be a good queen, but everyone needs something.
paras.zh: 这是你教我的。“艾莎拿起王冠重新戴回安娜头上，又替她编好头发。”艾莎，你是怎么做到的？“安娜问，蓝绿色的眼睛泛着水光。”我想当个好女王，可每个人都有所求。

paras.en: How do I do the next right thing when they’re all right things and they’re happening at the same time?
paras.zh: 当这些事全是对的、又同时发生，我该怎么选择当下该做的那件？

paras.en: How did you make being queen look so easy?” Elsa laughed. “Easy?
paras.zh: 你怎么把当女王做得看起来那么轻松？“艾莎笑了。”轻松？

paras.en: Being queen is a huge job; it was never easy.
paras.zh: 当女王是份大事；从来都不轻松。

paras.en: If I made it look easy, it’s only because I had you and Olaf and Kristoff and Sven here to help me.” Anna’s shoulders drooped. “Sometimes I feel like I’m letting people down if I say no.” Elsa shook her head, then put an arm around Anna’s shoulder. “You’re a great queen.
paras.zh: 若我显得轻松，不过是因为有你、雪宝、克里斯托夫和斯文在这里帮我。“安娜肩膀垮了下来。”有时我觉得，若我说不，就像辜负了别人。“艾莎摇了摇头，伸手揽住安娜的肩。”你是个很棒的女王。

paras.en: We all think you’re a great queen.
paras.zh: 我们都觉得你是个很棒的女王。

paras.en: You need to stop listening to the voice in your head telling you otherwise.” “Wait!” Olaf popped up beside them, forgetting that he was pretending not to eavesdrop. “Anna’s hearing voices, too?
paras.zh: 你得不再去听脑子里那个说你不行的小声音。“”等等！“雪宝从旁冒出来，忘了自己正假装没偷听。”安娜也听到声音了？

paras.en: Ah- ah -ah- ah !” He sang an off-key version of the tune that had led Elsa to Ahtohallan. “Olaf!” Elsa laughed. “Not that kind of voice.
paras.zh: 啊——啊——啊——啊！“他跑调地唱起那支曾引艾莎去阿图蕴的曲子。”雪宝！“艾莎笑道，”不是那种声音。

paras.en: This is the kind that comes from doubt, but the only person who needs to believe in Anna is hersel f .” She turned back to her sister. “You have such a big heart; you want to help everyone—but people want to help you, too.
paras.zh: 这是怀疑生出的声音，可唯一需要相信安娜的人，是她自己。“她转回姐姐面前。”你心肠这么好，想帮所有人——可别人也想帮你。

paras.en: Let us.
paras.zh: 让我们帮吧。

paras.en: It’s what sisters do.” “And fiancés,” added Kristoff. “And friends,” said Olaf. “Right, Sven?” Sven looked up from the carrot he was chomping and nodded. “Agreed,” added Kristoff in his Sven voice.
paras.zh: 这是姐妹该做的事。“”还有未婚夫呢，“克里斯托夫补充。”还有朋友，“雪宝说，”对吧，斯文？“斯文从啃着的胡萝卜上抬起头，点了点。”同意，“克里斯托夫用斯文的嗓音补了一句。

paras.en: Olaf wandered off while Anna stood quietly, absorbing their words.
paras.zh: 雪宝走开了，安娜静静站着，把他们的这番话揣进心里。

paras.en: Finally, she lifted her head. “I guess I could’ve sent Sven and Kristoff to the seed ceremony.
paras.zh: 终于，她抬起头。”我想，我本可以派斯文和克里斯托夫去种子仪式。

paras.en: Sven’s going to eventually eat half that carrot crop, so why shouldn’t he be there when it’s planted?” “Exactly,” said Elsa. “And maybe the Water Nokk could’ve gone to the boat christening?” Anna said. “The harbormaster loves the Water Spirit.” Elsa nodded encouragingly. “The Water Nokk loves to race the boats.” “And the party…” They turned to where Olaf had been standing, then toward the shrieks of laughter coming from Berit’s open door.
paras.zh: 斯文迟早要吃掉那一半胡萝卜收成，种的时候他为何不该在场？“”正是，“艾莎说。”或许水马本可以去新船命名仪式？“安娜说。”港务长最爱水灵了。“艾莎鼓励地点头。”水马最爱和船赛跑。“”还有派对……“他们转向雪宝方才站着的地方，又朝贝丽特敞开的门里传来的阵阵欢笑望去。

paras.en: Through it they could see Olaf entertaining practically every child in the village with his shape-shifting charades. “Clearly all they needed was an enchanted snowman.” As if on cue, Berit called out, “Best birthday ever.
paras.zh: 透过门，他们看见雪宝正用变形猜谜逗得全村孩子几乎都在乐。”显然，他们要的不过是一个有魔法的雪人。“仿佛收到暗号，贝丽特喊道：”最棒的生日了。

paras.en: I love my present, Queen Anna!” “He’s only to borrow,” Anna called back.
paras.zh: 我爱我的礼物，安娜女王！“”他只是借来的，“安娜回喊。

paras.en: Berit gave her a thumbs-up and turned back to her guests.
paras.zh: 贝丽特冲她竖起大拇指，转回客人中间。

paras.en: Anna groaned and faced her sister. “I still need to attend the meeting with Prince Lars myself, huh?” Elsa laughed and pointed to her sister’s head. “It comes with the crown.” Then she reached for Anna’s hand and gave it a squeeze. “If it helps, I’ll go, too.” “Thanks.
paras.zh: 安娜叹了口气，面对姐姐。”拉尔斯王子的会，我还是得自己去参加，对吧？“艾莎笑着指了指妹妹的头。”这是王冠带来的责任。“接着她握住安娜的手，轻轻一捏。”若有用，我也去。“”谢了。

paras.en: Because somehow, we’re going to have to be more entertaining than whatever books they’re reading.” Anna laughed and tugged her sister toward the wagon. “Check this out,” Kristoff called from where he was standing by his reindeer. “Sven’s got some fancy new harness decorations.” “My earring!” Anna ran across the cobblestones and threw her arms around the reindeer.
paras.zh: 因为不管他们读的是什么书，咱们总得比书更有意思。“安娜笑着把姐姐拉向马车。”快看，“克里斯托夫站在驯鹿旁喊道，”斯文身上多了些漂亮的挽具新装饰。“”我的耳环！“安娜跑过鹅卵石路，一把抱住驯鹿。

paras.en: He gave her a confused lick. “Sven, you saved it.” “Hey!
paras.zh: 驯鹿困惑地舔了舔她。”斯文，是你保住了它。“”嘿！

paras.en: I’m the one who found it,” Kristoff insisted, plucking the glittering jewel from Sven’s strap and handing it to her.
paras.zh: 明明是我找到的，“克里斯托夫坚持道，从斯文的皮带上摘下那颗闪亮的宝石递给她。

paras.en: Anna gave him a kiss. “Thank you!
paras.zh: 安娜给了他一个吻。”谢谢你！

paras.en: You’ve saved the day more than once.
paras.zh: 你不止一次救了场。

paras.en: All of you have.” As Kristoff helped her and Elsa into the wagon and they headed back to the castle, Anna knew she still didn’t look like some storybook’s picture of a perfect, regal queen.
paras.zh: 你们所有人都是。“克里斯托夫扶她和艾莎上马车，朝城堡驶去，安娜知道自己的模样仍不像童话里那位完美威严的女王画像。

paras.en: Her hair was wet; there was dirt beneath her nails; there were pins in her dress, and probably some sugary children’s handprints on it, too—but each of these was a sign of her connection to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 她头发湿着；指甲缝里有泥；裙子上别着针，大概还留着孩子们甜甜的掌印——可每一样都是她与阿伦黛尔相连的标志。

paras.en: She didn’t have to be a queen like anyone else.
paras.zh: 她不必像任何其他人那样当女王。

paras.en: She only had to be true to herself… and maybe double-check her schedule… and let those who loved her help.
paras.zh: 她只需做真实的自己……也许再核对下日程……并让爱她的人帮忙。

paras.en: She beamed at her favorite people. “I don’t know what I’d do without you all.” Elsa helped Anna fasten the earring, then linked her arm through her sister’s. “Well, good thing you’ll never have to find out.”
paras.zh: 她朝最爱的那些人绽开笑容。”没有你们，我真不知该怎么办。“艾莎帮安娜扣好耳环，然后挽起妹妹的手臂。”好吧，幸好你永远不必去弄清楚。“

paras.en: “It’s coronation day!” Elsa groaned at the sound of the way-too-cheery voice chirping in her ears.
paras.zh: “今天是加冕日！”艾莎一听到那过分欢快的声音在耳边叽叽喳喳，便抱怨起来。

paras.en: She rolled over in bed, pulling the covers over her head, but it did no good.
paras.zh: 她在床上翻了个身，把被子拉过头顶，但这毫无用处。

paras.en: A moment later, she was pounced on by something very excited.
paras.zh: 片刻之后，有个格外兴奋的东西朝她扑了过来。

paras.en: And very sister-shaped. “I can’t believe you’re still sleeping on a day like today,” Anna cried, unceremoniously yanking the covers off her sister’s head and giving her a reproachful look.
paras.zh: 而且形状十足像个妹妹。“真不敢相信，今天这种日子你居然还在睡，”安娜一边喊，一边毫不客气地把盖在姐姐头上的被子扯下来，用责备的眼神看着她。

paras.en: She was dressed in an olive-green nightgown, and her hair was plaited in two messy braids. “And here they say I’m the lazy one!” Elsa rubbed her eyes blearily. “Sorry,” she said. “I was having the strangest dream.” “Dream?
paras.zh: 她穿着一件橄榄绿的睡裙，头发编成两条乱糟糟的辫子。“可他们还说我是那个懒鬼呢！”艾莎睡眼惺忪地揉了揉眼睛。“抱歉，”她说，“我刚做了个最奇怪的梦。”“梦？

paras.en: What was it about?” Elsa frowned, trying to remember.
paras.zh: 讲的什么呀？”艾莎皱起眉头，努力回想。

paras.en: It was all rather foggy yet very vivid at the same time.
paras.zh: 整个梦朦朦胧胧，却又同时栩栩如生。

paras.en: Like an old memory, frayed at the edges. “Well, for one thing, you were queen of Arendelle,” she said slowly. “And I was… well, I was hanging out in this… icy cave of memories?” “Cave of memories,” Anna repeated, her eyes sparkling. “That’s kind of neat.
paras.zh: 就像一段边缘磨损的旧记忆。“嗯，有一点是，你当上了阿伦黛尔的女王，”她缓缓地说，“而我……嗯，我待在一个……冰冷的记忆之洞里？”“记忆之洞，”安娜重复道，眼睛闪闪发亮，“这还挺酷的。

paras.en: If I had one of those, I’d never have to remember where I put my hat again.” She paused. “Which reminds me.
paras.zh: 要是我也有一个，就再也不用记得把帽子放哪儿了。”她顿了顿，“这倒提醒我了。

paras.en: Have you seen my hat?” Elsa rolled her eyes.
paras.zh: 你看见我的帽子了吗？”艾莎翻了个白眼。

paras.en: Anna giggled and poked her in the ribs.
paras.zh: 安娜咯咯笑着，戳了戳她的肋骨。

paras.en: Elsa returned the gesture by conjuring up a delicate ice flurry and aiming it directly at her sister’s freckled nose.
paras.zh: 艾莎回敬了她一下，凭空变出一簇精巧的冰花，直直地朝妹妹长着雀斑的鼻子飞去。

paras.en: Anna squealed and leapt backward. “So unfair!” she cried. “Ice powers are totally cheating!” “You started it,” Elsa reminded her with a smile, starting to feel better.
paras.zh: 安娜尖叫着向后跳开。“太不公平了！”她喊道，“用冰魔法完全是作弊！”“是你先招惹我的，”艾莎微笑着提醒她，心情开始好转。

paras.en: The dream was slipping away, and reality was setting in.
paras.zh: 梦境正在溜走，现实渐渐浮现。

paras.en: There was no cave.
paras.zh: 根本没有洞。

paras.en: And she was the one becoming queen today, not Anna.
paras.zh: 而且今天要成为女王的是她，不是安娜。

paras.en: Her sister grinned. “Hey, that’s what little sisters are for!
paras.zh: 妹妹咧嘴一笑。“嘿，小妹妹就是用来干这个的！

paras.en: To be totally annoying!” “Even when they’re eighteen years old?” Elsa asked, raising an eyebrow. “Even when they’re eighty .
paras.zh: 烦死人！”“就算她们已经十八岁了也这样？”艾莎挑起一边眉毛问道。“就算她们八十了也是。

paras.en: Trust me, you’re not getting rid of me that easily,” Anna declared, making a grand gesture with her hand and managing to lose her balance in the process.
paras.zh: 相信我，你没那么容易甩掉我，”安娜宣称，夸张地挥了挥手，结果把自己弄得失了平衡。

paras.en: Elsa had to grab her to stop her from falling off the bed. “Good,” she said. “’Cause you’re stuck with me, too.” “Girls, are you dressed yet?” The two princesses looked up to see Iduna, their mother, standing at the door.
paras.zh: 艾莎不得不一把抓住她，免得她从床上摔下去。“好，”她说，“因为你也甩不掉我。”“姑娘们，你们穿好衣服了吗？”两位公主抬起头，看见母亲伊杜娜正站在门口。

paras.en: The queen was outfitted in a luminous purple gown, making her look more like a young maiden than the mother of two grown girls.
paras.zh: 女王身着一袭发光的紫色长裙，让她看上去更像个年轻少女，而不像两个大姑娘的母亲。

paras.en: When her eyes fell on her daughters, still in their wrinkled nightclothes, she clucked her tongue disapprovingly. “It’s nearly eleven o’clock,” she scolded.
paras.zh: 当她的目光落到还穿着皱巴巴睡衣的女儿们身上时，她不赞同地咂了咂舌。“都快十一点了，”她责备道。

paras.en: But Elsa could hear the amusement at the edge of her voice.
paras.zh: 但艾莎听得出她话音里藏着一丝好笑。

paras.en: She wasn’t really cross.
paras.zh: 她并没有真的生气。

paras.en: Iduna beckoned to Anna. “Go back to your own room,” she told her. “I’ll send Gerda up to help you dress.” “I thought Gerda was going to help Elsa.” Iduna smiled. “ I’m going to help Elsa.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜朝安娜招了招手。“回你自己的房间去，”她吩咐道，“我让格尔达上去帮你穿衣打扮。”“我还以为格尔达是来帮艾莎的呢。”伊杜娜笑了。“我要亲自帮艾莎。

paras.en: It is her special day, after all.” Anna grinned at her sister, then skipped out of the room.
paras.zh: 毕竟今天是她的大日子。”安娜朝姐姐咧嘴一笑，然后蹦蹦跳跳地出了房间。

paras.en: Elsa turned to her mother, who was reaching into the wardrobe and plucking out an elegant green-and-black dress with rosemaling on the bodice and skirt.
paras.zh: 艾莎转向母亲，母亲正把手伸进衣柜，取出一件优雅的绿黑相间连衣裙，胸前和裙摆上都绣着玫瑰花纹。

paras.en: Elsa’s coronation dress, which her mother had hand-embroidered for the occasion.
paras.zh: 那是艾莎的加冕礼服，是母亲为这一刻亲手绣的。

paras.en: Her mother… Elsa felt an unexpected pang in her chest as she watched Iduna brush lint off the dress.
paras.zh: 母亲……艾莎望着伊杜娜拂去礼服上的绒屑，胸口忽然涌起一阵莫名的刺痛。

paras.en: Suddenly, she found herself crossing the room and throwing her arms around her mother as if she hadn’t seen her in years. “What’s this all about?” Iduna asked, laughing. “You’re going to wrinkle your dress!” She kissed the top of her daughter’s head, then shooed her back to the bed.
paras.zh: 突然，她发现自己穿过房间，一把抱住了母亲，仿佛多年未见。“这是怎么回事？”伊杜娜笑着问，“你会把礼服弄皱的！”她亲了亲女儿的头顶，然后把她赶回床上。

paras.en: Elsa obeyed, feeling a little sheepish.
paras.zh: 艾莎顺从地照做，心里有点难为情。

paras.en: Why had she just done that? “Is everything okay, Elsa?” Iduna asked, carrying the dress over.
paras.zh: 她刚才为什么要那样做？“一切都还好吗，艾莎？”伊杜娜拿着礼服走过来问道。

paras.en: She peered at her daughter worriedly. “You’re not nervous about today, are you?” Elsa shook her head. “I’m fine,” she assured her mother. “I just… had a disturbing dream.” “Oh?” Suddenly Elsa wasn’t sure she wanted to talk about it.
paras.zh: 她担忧地端详着女儿。“你今天不紧张吧，嗯？”艾莎摇了摇头。“我很好，”她向母亲保证，“只是……做了一个令人不安的梦。”“哦？”艾莎忽然不太确定自己想不想说。

paras.en: But then her mother always told her it was best to talk about things that frightened you.
paras.zh: 可母亲总对她说，把你害怕的事说出来才是最好。

paras.en: To not keep them locked inside. “Well, Anna was ruling Arendelle,” she explained slowly. “And…” Her brow furrowed. “You and Father… died… in a shipwreck.” She felt a shiver crawl down her spine as the words slipped from her lips.
paras.zh: 不要把它们锁在心里。“嗯，安娜统治着阿伦黛尔，”她缓缓地解释道，“还有……”她皱起眉头，“你和父亲……在……一场船难中……去世了。”话一出口，她便感到一阵寒意顺着脊背爬下。

paras.en: As if saying them aloud somehow gave them a terrible power to come true.
paras.zh: 仿佛把话说出口，就赋予了它们应验的可怕力量。

paras.en: But that was ridiculous, right? “Oh, sweetheart,” Iduna exclaimed. “That must have been awful.” She met Elsa’s eyes with her own, sympathy welling in her pupils. “But as you can see, it was just a dream.
paras.zh: 但这太荒谬了，对吧？“哦，亲爱的，”伊杜娜惊呼，“那一定很可怕。”她用自己的眼睛迎上艾莎的目光，瞳孔里盈满怜惜。“但如你所见，那只是个梦。

paras.en: Your father and I are very much alive.
paras.zh: 你父亲和我都活得好好的。

paras.en: In fact, I believe he’s down in the kitchen, taste-testing all the coronation chocolate and driving poor Olina crazy.” She snorted. “Taking his retirement a little too seriously, if you ask me.” “I still can’t believe he’s giving up the throne for me,” Elsa mused as she stepped carefully into the gown Iduna held out for her, holding her mother’s hand for balance. “I mean, most kings rule until they die.
paras.zh: 事实上，我相信这会儿他正待在厨房里，把加冕用的巧克力统统试吃一遍，把可怜的奥丽娜逼得发疯。”她哼了一声，“要我说，他这退休也太当回事了。”“我还是不敢相信，他竟愿意为了我放弃王位，”艾莎一边思忖，一边小心地套上伊杜娜替她撑着的礼服，握着母亲的手保持平衡，“我是说，大多数国王都是统治到死的。

paras.en: They don’t just randomly abdicate their thrones so their twenty-one-year-old daughters can take charge of their kingdoms.” “Well, you might have noticed your father is not like most kings,” Iduna pointed out.
paras.zh: 他们可不会随随便便就退位，好让二十一岁的女儿来掌管王国。”“嗯，你大概也注意到，你父亲和大多数国王不一样，”伊杜娜指出。

paras.en: She began to fasten Elsa’s dress. “Anyway, I think it’s smart.
paras.zh: 她开始为艾莎系好礼服。“总之，我觉得这很明智。

paras.en: Your grandfather died suddenly, which meant your father was forced to become king with very little guidance.
paras.zh: 你祖父突然离世，这意味着你父亲在几乎没有指引的情况下被迫登基。

paras.en: He doesn’t want the same for you.
paras.zh: 他不希望你也落得如此。

paras.en: He wants to be around to help you learn your new role and guide you into being the best queen you can possibly be.” “I just hope I don’t disappoint him,” Elsa murmured. “Disappoint him?” Iduna repeated incredulously. “Impossible.” She peered at Elsa with worried eyes. “Are you sure you’re all right?” she asked. “You don’t seem yourself this morning.” Elsa didn’t feel like herself, either.
paras.zh: 他想陪在你身边，帮你学会新角色，引导你成为最出色的女王。”“我只希望自己别让他失望，”艾莎低声说。“让他失望？”伊杜娜难以置信地重复道，“不可能。”她用担忧的眼神端详着艾莎。“你确定自己没事吧？”她问，“今天早上你看起来不像平时的你。”艾莎自己也觉得不像平时的自己。

paras.en: But she forced a laugh. “I guess I am just a little nervous about taking the scepter in hand today.
paras.zh: 但她勉强笑了一声。“我想我只是对今天要接过权杖，有点紧张罢了。

paras.en: Hopefully it won’t freeze when I touch it.” She made a face. “That would be awkward.” “It would be amazing, ” Iduna assured her, her frown disappearing and her eyes dancing with laughter. “In fact, if it didn’t, I think people would be disappointed.
paras.zh: 希望我碰到它时它不会结冰。”她做了个鬼脸，“那就尴尬了。”“那才叫厉害呢，”伊杜娜向她保证，眉头舒展开来，眼里闪着笑意，“事实上，如果它没有结冰，我觉得大家反而会失望。

paras.en: You know how they love your ice powers.” “Right,” Elsa said.
paras.zh: 你知道他们有多喜欢你的冰雪魔法。”“嗯，对，”艾莎说。

paras.en: Even though it didn’t sound exactly right for some reason.
paras.zh: 尽管不知为何，这话听上去并不完全对劲。

paras.en: Wow, the dream had really thrown her off balance. “Don’t worry, Elsa,” Iduna said, pulling her daughter into a warm hug. “Everything is going to be perfect today.
paras.zh: 哇，那个梦真的把她搞得心神不宁。“别担心，艾莎，”伊杜娜说着，把女儿搂进一个温暖的怀抱，“今天一切都会完美的。

paras.en: Because you are perfect.
paras.zh: 因为你就是完美的。

paras.en: My sweet little Snow Queen.” Elsa buried her face in her mother’s shoulder, sinking into the warmth of her embrace.
paras.zh: 我甜甜的小冰雪女王。”艾莎把脸埋进母亲的肩头，沉浸在她怀抱的温暖里。

paras.en: Her mother always smelled so warm and earthy, as if she’d just stepped out of an enchanted forest.
paras.zh: 母亲的身上总有一股温暖而质朴的气息，仿佛她刚从魔法森林里走出来。

paras.en: Whenever Elsa felt scared or insecure, she just had to breathe in that warm, familiar scent and everything would be okay.
paras.zh: 每当艾莎感到害怕或不安，只要深深吸一口那温暖而熟悉的气味，一切就会好起来。

paras.en: But today, to Elsa’s surprise, her mother smelled different.
paras.zh: 但今天，令艾莎意外的是，母亲的味道变了。

paras.en: Salty, almost… and a bit damp.
paras.zh: 带着咸味，几乎……还有点潮湿。

paras.en: As if she had just bathed in the sea… “We’re about to rehearse!
paras.zh: 仿佛她刚在海里沐浴过……“我们马上要彩排了！

paras.en: Where’s your sister?” Queen Anna of Arendelle looked up at her fiancé, Kristoff, who was standing beside his reindeer, Sven, wringing his large hands together in frustration.
paras.zh: 你妹妹呢？”阿伦黛尔女王安娜抬起头，望向未婚夫克里斯托夫——他正站在自己的驯鹿斯文身旁，懊恼地搓着一双大手。

paras.en: She wrinkled her brow. “Wait, she’s not here yet?” she asked. “I thought I saw Gale and Bruni an hour ago.” “Gale and Bruni are here,” Kristoff agreed, gesturing to the Wind Spirit, who was swirling around Anna’s parents’ statue in the town square, and the Fire Spirit, who stood nearby watching. “Elsa, however, is not.” Anna rose to her feet. “She said she’d be here,” she muttered, feeling a little cross. “I told her three times I needed her first thing in the morning for rehearsal.” “Maybe she’s too busy with her important life in the Enchanted Forest and has forgotten all about us!” Olaf suggested brightly as he waddled over to the group.
paras.zh: 她皱起眉头。“等等，她还没来？”她问，“我以为一小时前看见风灵盖尔和火灵布伦尼了。”“盖尔和布伦尼确实在这儿，”克里斯托夫表示同意，指了指正在广场上安娜父母雕像周围打转的风灵，以及站在不远处观望的火灵。“可是艾莎不在。”安娜站起身来。“她说好会来的，”她小声嘀咕，有点恼火，“我告诉过她三遍，一早就要她来彩排。”“也许她在魔法森林里有重要生活，忙得把我们全忘了！”雪宝摇摇摆摆地走到众人面前，快活地猜测道。

paras.en: Anna shot him a sharp look, and the snowman took an apologetic step backward. “At least that’s what I heard some of the townspeople say,” he amended quickly. “Obviously, I don’t think that!” Anna frowned. “Elsa would never do that.
paras.zh: 安娜狠瞪了他一眼，雪人抱歉地往后退了一步。“至少，我是听几个镇上人这么说的，”他连忙改口，“当然，我才不这么认为！”安娜皱起眉头。“艾莎绝不会那样做。

paras.en: Especially not today of all days!
paras.zh: 尤其今天这种日子，更不可能！

paras.en: We planned this together!
paras.zh: 这是我们一块儿计划的！

paras.en: She was looking forward to it.” She glanced unhappily at the statue she’d commissioned of Iduna and Agnarr, holding hands as children.
paras.zh: 她本来还盼着呢。”她不快地瞥了一眼那座雕像——是她委托制作的伊杜娜和安格瑞，像孩子一样手牵着手。

paras.en: It had been seven years since their parents had been lost at sea, and Anna had decided, as queen, she would declare their wedding anniversary an official Arendellian holiday.
paras.zh: 他们的父母已在海上失踪七年，安娜作为女王，决定把他们的结婚纪念日定为阿伦黛尔的官方节日。

paras.en: All the shops and schools would close and people would gather to share stories about their beloved king and queen.
paras.zh: 届时所有店铺和学校都会关门，人们会聚在一起，分享关于他们敬爱的国王与王后的故事。

paras.en: Elsa had been thrilled at the idea of honoring their parents.
paras.zh: 艾莎曾对这个纪念父母的点子兴奋不已。

paras.en: So why wasn’t she here?
paras.zh: 那她为什么还不在这儿？

paras.en: Anna approached Gale, waving to get the Wind Spirit’s attention. “Have you seen Elsa anywhere?” she asked hopefully.
paras.zh: 安娜走向盖尔，挥手想引起风灵的注意。“你在哪儿见过艾莎吗？”她满怀希望地问。

paras.en: But the spirit only shook its pile of leaves from side to side, its way of saying no.
paras.zh: 但风灵只是把那堆叶子左右摇了摇——这是它表示“没有”的方式。

paras.en: Then it anxiously swirled around Anna, almost picking her up off her feet. “I know.
paras.zh: 接着它焦急地在安娜身边打转，差点把她从地上卷起来。“我知道。

paras.en: I’m getting worried, too,” she said, grabbing on to a nearby lamppost for balance.
paras.zh: 我也在担心了，”她抓着旁边的路灯杆保持平衡说道。

paras.en: Kristoff came up behind her, steadying her with his strong hands. “I’m sure she’s fine,” he insisted. “I mean, hello.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫走到她身后，用有力的双手稳住她。“我肯定她没事的，”他坚持说，“我是说，拜托。

paras.en: Magical Snow Queen?
paras.zh: 魔法冰雪女王？

paras.en: Pretty good at taking care of herself.” “I know.” Anna turned to face him, looking up into his deep brown eyes.
paras.zh: 很会照顾自己好吗。”“我知道。”安娜转过身面对他，抬头望进他深邃的棕色眼眸。

paras.en: Kristoff was always great at helping her relax when she was stressed out.
paras.zh: 每当她压力大的时候，克里斯托夫总很擅长让她放松。

paras.en: But this time, for some reason, she couldn’t let it go.
paras.zh: 但这一次，不知为何，她放不下。

paras.en: Call it sixth sense—a sister thing. “I just think it’s strange she’s not here.” Kristoff reached up, brushing a lock of hair from her eyes. “Do you want me to go look for her?” he asked. “Sven and I could travel to the Enchanted Forest.
paras.zh: 就当是第六感吧——一种姐妹之间的感应。“我就是觉得她不在这儿很奇怪。”克里斯托夫抬手，把一缕垂到她眼前的头发拨开。“要我去找她吗？”他问，“我和斯文可以去一趟魔法森林。

paras.en: Maybe she just lost track of time.
paras.zh: 也许她只是忘了时间。

paras.en: You know how she can be when she’s deeply concentrating on her magic.” Anna nodded. “Good idea.
paras.zh: 你知道她专心施展魔法时会是什么样。”安娜点了点头。“好主意。

paras.en: I’ll come, too.” “Aren’t you needed here?
paras.zh: 我也去。”“你不是需要留在这儿吗？

paras.en: To work on the memorial?” “There’s not going to be a memorial if we can’t find my sister,” Anna pointed out. “Saddle up the wagon.
paras.zh: 来弄纪念雕像？”“要是找不到我妹妹，就根本没纪念雕像可弄了，”安娜指出，“把马车套好。

paras.en: We’ll head out as soon as you’re ready.” She turned to Olaf, who had removed one of his stick arms to scratch a tough-to-reach spot on his back. “You need to hold down the fort,” she told the snowman. “Don’t let the people of Arendelle think anything’s wrong.” “Is something wrong?” Olaf’s eyes grew wide. “Is Elsa in trouble?
paras.zh: 你一准备好我们就出发。”她转向雪宝——雪人正卸下自己的一条树枝手臂，去挠后背够不着的地方。“你得守好大本营，”她对雪人说，“别让阿伦黛尔的百姓觉得出了什么事。”“出什么事了吗？”雪宝瞪大了眼睛，“艾莎有危险了？

paras.en: Because if Elsa’s in trouble, I need to be there to help.” He stuffed his arm back in its proper place. “I’m very helpful, you know.
paras.zh: 要是艾莎有危险，我得去帮忙。”他把胳膊塞回原位，“你知道的，我可管用了。

paras.en: Remember the time I pretended to be king to save the town from a killer zombie?” Anna sighed.
paras.zh: 还记得那次我假扮国王，把镇子从僵尸杀手手里救出来吗？”安娜叹了口气。

paras.en: That wasn’t exactly how it had happened.
paras.zh: 事情可并不是那样发生的。

paras.en: But she didn’t have time to argue. “Fine.
paras.zh: 但她没时间争辩。“好吧。

paras.en: You can come.
paras.zh: 你跟来吧。

paras.en: Mattias can keep everyone in check.” The Arendelle general stepped up, as if on cue. “In check?” he asked, his brow furrowing. “Is something wrong?” “Elsa’s in trouble!” Olaf exclaimed. “We’re going to the Enchanted Forest to save her from certain death!” Kristoff groaned. “Olaf!
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯能维持秩序。”阿伦黛尔将军应声上前，仿佛早有默契。“维持秩序？”他皱起眉头问，“出什么事了吗？”“艾莎有危险了！”雪宝惊叫，“我们要去魔法森林把她从必死之局里救出来！”克里斯托夫呻吟了一声。“雪宝！

paras.en: We don’t even know if anything’s actually—” Mattias straightened his military jacket. “If our Snow Queen is in trouble, it is my duty to help her.
paras.zh: 我们甚至都不确定到底有没有——”马蒂亚斯挺直了军装。“如果我们的冰雪女王有难，相助是我的职责。

paras.en: I’m coming with you.” Anna sighed.
paras.zh: 我跟你们去。”安娜叹了口气。

paras.en: Before she knew it, the whole town would be asking to come along.
paras.zh: 不知不觉间，全镇人都要请求跟着去了。

paras.en: Which was rather sweet—to know how much they cared about Elsa.
paras.zh: 这倒挺让人暖心的——知道他们多关心艾莎。

paras.en: But also impractical. “Okay, fine,” she told Mattias. “But no one else.
paras.zh: 但也不切实际。“行吧，”她对马蒂亚斯说，“但不要再带别人了。

paras.en: Or Sven won’t even be able to pull the wagon.” Bruni leapt onto Sven’s back, cocking its little salamander head questioningly.
paras.zh: 不然斯文连马车都拉不动。”布伦尼跳上斯文的背，歪着小蜥蜴脑袋，一脸疑惑。

paras.en: Anna smiled. “I suppose you’re little enough,” she amended. “But seriously, let’s head out now, before the Waffle Brothers and Mrs.
paras.zh: 安娜笑了。“我想你够小，”她改口道，“不过说真的，趁华夫兄弟和布洛杰特夫人——

paras.en: Blodget also decide they’re needed on this quest and there’s no one left in Arendelle at all.” “There she is, queen of Arendelle!” Elsa grinned sheepishly when her father started cheering as she walked into the Great Hall, which was all decorated for her coronation after-party.
paras.zh: 也觉得这趟任务少不了他们，弄得阿伦黛尔一个都不剩，我们赶紧出发吧。”“她来了，阿伦黛尔女王！”当父亲在艾莎走进大礼堂时开始欢呼，艾莎不好意思地咧嘴笑了——大礼堂已被布置好，准备她的加冕后会。

paras.en: There were long tables piled high with delicious-looking meats and fish and cheeses and oh-so-many desserts.
paras.zh: 那里有一张张长桌，上面高高堆着看起来美味的肉、鱼、奶酪，还有数不清的甜点。

paras.en: And the centerpiece?
paras.zh: 而最抢眼的中心装饰？

paras.en: A towering, ringed kransekake, drizzled in chocolate. “Not yet,” she reminded her father. “I still must be officially coronated.
paras.zh: 是一座高耸的、一圈圈套叠的克兰斯卡克杏仁糕，淋着巧克力。“还早呢，”她提醒父亲，“我还得正式加冕才行。

paras.en: You’re stuck with the job until then, and don’t you forget it.” Agnarr laughed, coming around the table, dipping his finger into a vat of chocolate on the way and sticking it in his mouth.
paras.zh: 在那之前这活儿还是你的，你可别忘了。”安格瑞大笑着绕过桌子，途中把手指伸进一大缸巧克力里蘸了蘸，又塞进嘴里。

paras.en: Elsa smirked. “Mother would kill you if she saw you doing that,” she noted.
paras.zh: 艾莎偷笑。“母亲要是看见你这样，非杀了你不可，”她点评道。

paras.en: Agnarr’s eyes twinkled. “She would expect nothing less.” He reached Elsa and threw his arms around her. “I can’t tell you how proud I am of you,” he whispered in her ear.
paras.zh: 安格瑞眼里闪着光。“她正巴不得呢。”他走到艾莎面前，一把抱住她。“我无法形容我有多为你骄傲，”他在她耳边低语。

paras.en: Then he pulled away, gazing at Elsa with loving green eyes. “This is a big deal, especially at your young age.
paras.zh: 然后他退开，用充满爱意的绿眼睛凝视着艾莎。“这可是件大事，尤其你还这么年轻。

paras.en: But you’re handling it magnificently.
paras.zh: 但你处理得极好。

paras.en: Not at all like yours truly, when I came to the throne.” “Well, to be fair, you had some not-so-great circumstances,” Elsa reminded him. “That’s true,” Agnarr agreed.
paras.zh: 完全不像我当年登基时的样子。”“嗯，公平地说，你当时处境可不太妙，”艾莎提醒他。“那倒是，”安格瑞同意。

paras.en: His eyes grew faraway. “I honestly don’t think I would have survived those years had it not been for your mother.
paras.zh: 他的目光变得悠远。“说实话，若不是你母亲，我真不知道能不能熬过那几年。

paras.en: She was my everything back then.
paras.zh: 那时她就是我的一切。

paras.en: Still is, actually, now that I think about it.” Elsa groaned. “Oh no.
paras.zh: 说真的，现在想想，至今仍是。”艾莎呻吟道。“哦不。

paras.en: Do not start getting mushy about Mother again.” “Hey!
paras.zh: 别又开始对母亲肉麻了。”“嘿！

paras.en: I will be as mushy about your mother as I want to be,” her father declared. “Gotta make up for lost time after we spent so many years concealing our love from the kingdom.” “Conceal, don’t feel,” Elsa murmured.
paras.zh: 我想对你母亲多肉麻就多肉麻，”父亲宣称，“毕竟我们瞒着王国、藏起爱意那么多年，得把失去的时间补回来。”“掩饰，别去感受，”艾莎喃喃道。

paras.en: Her father gave her a sharp look. “Wait.
paras.zh: 父亲锐利地看了她一眼。“等等。

paras.en: Where did you hear that?” Elsa shrugged uneasily, suddenly not sure. “I—I think… you must have said it to me before?” she stammered. “No.” Agnarr shook his head, vehemently. “I would never say that to you, Elsa.
paras.zh: 你从哪儿听来的？”艾莎不安地耸耸肩，忽然也不确定了。“我——我想……你以前一定跟我说过吧？”她结巴道。“没有。”安格瑞用力摇着头，“我绝不会对你说这种话，艾莎。

paras.en: It’s a poisonous expression my father used to say to shame me for having feelings.
paras.zh: 这是我父亲过去常说的一句毒话，用来为我流露感情而羞辱我。

paras.en: In fact, it almost destroyed your mother’s and my relationship.
paras.zh: 事实上，它差点毁了你母亲和我的关系。

paras.en: We both suffered for years, keeping secrets from each other.
paras.zh: 我们瞒着彼此，彼此都受了好几年苦。

paras.en: And we vowed not to repeat those mistakes with you girls.
paras.zh: 我们发誓不会把这些错误在你们姐妹身上重演。

paras.en: We’ve always tried to encourage you to express your emotions.
paras.zh: 我们一直努力鼓励你们表达情感。

paras.en: I honestly think that’s what’s helped you keep your ice powers under control.
paras.zh: 说实话，我觉得正是这个让你学会了控制冰雪魔法。

paras.en: I can’t imagine what would happen if you tried to conceal them.” “Me neither.” Elsa shuddered. “Of course, that’s not to say we’re perfect,” Agnarr added with a shrug. “I’ve made plenty of mistakes over the years.
paras.zh: 我无法想象你要是试图掩饰它们，会发生什么。”“我也想象不到。”艾莎打了个寒颤。“当然，这倒不是说我们就完美了，”安格瑞耸耸肩补充道，“这些年来我犯过的错可不少。

paras.en: And you will, too, as queen.
paras.zh: 你当女王后也会犯错。

paras.en: But just remember, Elsa.
paras.zh: 但你要记住，艾莎。

paras.en: You never have to be anything but yourself.
paras.zh: 你只需要做你自己，别的都不必。

paras.en: The rest—you can simply let it go.” Elsa found herself nodding. “Let it go,” she repeated, feeling out the words with her lips.
paras.zh: 其余的——你大可以放手让它过去。”艾莎不由自主地点点头。“放手让它过去，”她重复道，用嘴唇品味着这几个字。

paras.en: It was definitely better than conceal, don’t feel . “I like the sound of that.” “The sound of what?” Elsa turned to see her sister prance into the room, decked out in a beautiful green-and-yellow ball gown that expertly brought out her green eyes.
paras.zh: 这肯定比“掩饰，别去感受”好多了。“我喜欢这个说法。”“什么说法？”艾莎转过身，看见妹妹蹦跳着进了房间，身着一袭漂亮的绿黄相间舞会礼服，恰到好处地衬出她的绿眼睛。

paras.en: She watched as Anna made a beeline for the chocolate, just as her father had done, dipping her finger into it with much enthusiasm.
paras.zh: 她看着安娜像父亲一样直奔巧克力而去，兴致勃勃地把手指蘸了进去。

paras.en: Elsa groaned. “The two of you, I swear!” “Aw.
paras.zh: 艾莎呻吟道。“你们俩，我真服了！”“哎呀。

paras.en: Come on!
paras.zh: 别这样嘛！

paras.en: You know you want some,” Anna teased, dancing up to her sister and waving her chocolate-covered finger. “Mmmm.
paras.zh: 你明明也想要，”安娜逗她，蹦跳着凑到姐姐跟前，挥着沾满巧克力的手指。“嗯。

paras.en: Chocolate…” Elsa rolled her eyes, playfully swatting her sister’s hand away.
paras.zh: 巧克力……”艾莎翻了个白眼，俏皮地拍开妹妹的手。

paras.en: Then she noticed something odd and frowned. “What did you do to your hair?” she asked, reaching out and plucking a strange-looking lock from Anna’s otherwise auburn tresses.
paras.zh: 接着她注意到不对劲，皱起了眉。“你对你的头发做了什么？”她问，伸手从安娜那头原本赤褐色的秀发里，揪出一缕看起来奇怪的发丝。

paras.en: Anna’s face went pale. “What are you talking about?” she asked. “What’s wrong with my hair?” “It’s just… white,” Elsa stammered. “Like… pure white.” “White?” Anna repeated.
paras.zh: 安娜的脸色一下子变白。“你在说什么？”她问，“我的头发怎么了？”“只是……变白了，”艾莎结巴道，“像……纯白。”“白色？”安娜重复道。

paras.en: She grabbed the lock of hair from Elsa and stretched it out in front of her face. “Where?
paras.zh: 她从艾莎手里夺过那缕头发，伸到自己脸前。“哪儿？

paras.en: What do you mean?” “It’s right…” Elsa started, then trailed off.
paras.zh: 什么意思？”“就在这儿……”艾莎开口，又没了下文。

paras.en: Wait.
paras.zh: 等等。

paras.en: Where was it?
paras.zh: 它去哪儿了？

paras.en: She was sure that it had been there a moment before.
paras.zh: 她确信片刻之前它还在那儿。

paras.en: But now… it was gone. “Um, never mind,” she mumbled. “Must have been a trick of the light.” “Are you okay, Elsa?” Anna peered at her worriedly. “I’m fine,” she assured her.
paras.zh: 但现在……它不见了。“嗯，没事了，”她嘟囔道，“多半是光线造成的错觉。”“你没事吧，艾莎？”安娜担忧地盯着她。“我没事，”她向她保证。

paras.en: She was starting to get annoyed at everyone asking her this.
paras.zh: 她开始对所有人问她这句，感到有点烦了。

paras.en: She forced a grin to her face. “I mean, nothing a little chocolate won’t help.…” “Can’t you move any faster, Sven?” Anna tapped her foot impatiently against the wagon.
paras.zh: 她挤出一个笑脸。“我是说，吃点巧克力就没事了……”“斯文，你就不能走快点吗？”安娜不耐烦地用脚敲着马车。

paras.en: She was now regretting taking the whole crew to the Enchanted Forest instead of just riding off on her horse, Havski.
paras.zh: 她现在有点后悔，带了一大帮人去魔法森林，而不是只骑自己的马哈夫斯基走掉。

paras.en: Of course, that would have been dangerous—to go off alone.
paras.zh: 当然，独自离开会很危险。

paras.en: But then, Anna had never really taken danger into consideration when she was worried about her sister.
paras.zh: 但话说回来，安娜在为妹妹担心时，从来不会真正考虑危险。

paras.en: And she was worried now.
paras.zh: 而此刻她正担心着。

paras.en: The spirits seemed equally agitated.
paras.zh: 精灵们似乎也同样焦躁。

paras.en: She’d sent Gale on ahead to search for Elsa, but the Wind Spirit had come back with no message from her sister and kept swirling around the wagon as if also frustrated by its lack of speed.
paras.zh: 她派盖尔先去搜寻艾莎，可风灵回来时没带妹妹的口信，还一直围着马车打转，仿佛也对这速度感到沮丧。

paras.en: This set off Bruni, who proceeded to accidentally set the wagon on fire. “Hey!” Kristoff protested when he saw the smoke. “That’s fresh lacquer!” “Don’t worry—I got it!” Olaf exclaimed, plopping himself down on top of the fire and succeeding in dousing the flames. “Ahh,” he said with a smile as his snow sizzled. “That feels just like summer.” “Olaf, we need to hire you as Arendelle fire chief one of these days,” Mattias joked.
paras.zh: 这把布伦尼惹着了，结果它不小心把马车点着了。“嘿！”克里斯托夫看到烟抗议道，“那上面才刷的新漆！”“别担心——我搞定！”雪宝大叫，一屁股坐到火上，成功把火灭了。“啊，”他雪做的身子滋滋作响，笑着说，“这感觉就像夏天。”“雪宝，改天我们得聘你当阿伦黛尔的消防队长，”马蒂亚斯开玩笑说。

paras.en: The snowman beamed at the idea. “My butt is always at your service,” he declared.
paras.zh: 雪人听了对这主意眉开眼笑。“我的屁股随时听候差遣，”他宣称。

paras.en: Anna groaned. “Come on, Sven, pick up the pace,” she urged again. “Pretend there’s a carrot factory at the end of the road.” Kristoff turned to Anna, giving her a concerned look. “You really think something’s not right?
paras.zh: 安娜呻吟道。“快点，斯文，加快脚步，”她再次催促，“就当路的尽头有个胡萝卜工厂。”克里斯托夫转向安娜，露出关切的神情。“你真觉得出了什么事？

paras.en: Maybe Elsa just forgot.” “No.” Anna shook her head. “Elsa wouldn’t forget something this important.
paras.zh: 也许艾莎只是忘了。”“不会。”安娜摇摇头，“这种大事艾莎不会忘。

paras.en: And she wouldn’t just blow me off.” But even as she said the words, something uncomfortable seemed to worm inside of her.
paras.zh: 她也不会就这么把我晾在一边。”可即便她说着这话，某种不安的东西似乎也钻进了她心里。

paras.en: Her sister was the fifth spirit now, her powers growing every day.
paras.zh: 妹妹如今是第五个精灵，力量一天天增长。

paras.en: What if at some point she did start to forget about her old life in Arendelle?
paras.zh: 万一哪天她真的开始忘了在阿伦黛尔的旧生活呢？

paras.en: After all, she had Ahtohallan.
paras.zh: 毕竟，她有阿托哈兰。

paras.en: The Enchanted Forest.
paras.zh: 魔法森林。

paras.en: The spirits themselves.
paras.zh: 精灵们本身。

paras.en: What did she need with ordinary people like them?
paras.zh: 她还要他们这些普通人做什么？

paras.en: Anna felt a tightening in her throat.
paras.zh: 安娜感到喉咙发紧。

paras.en: No, I know my sister, she scolded herself.
paras.zh: 不，我了解我妹妹，她责备自己。

paras.en: She would never forget us.
paras.zh: 她绝不会忘了我们。

paras.en: But the alternative, she realized with rising dread, was even worse.
paras.zh: 但她怀着越来越强的恐惧意识到，另一种可能更糟。

paras.en: For if Elsa hadn’t forgotten, it meant something was wrong.
paras.zh: 因为如果艾莎没忘，那就意味着出了什么事。

paras.en: Anna grabbed the reins from Kristoff, urging Sven on. “We have to hurry!” “Your gloves, Your Majesty.” Elsa startled at the sound of the voice, her eyes dropping down to her hands.
paras.zh: 安娜从克里斯托夫手里夺过缰绳，催促斯文前行。“我们得赶快！”“陛下，您的手套。”艾莎被这声音吓了一跳，目光落到自己手上。

paras.en: She was in the chapel.
paras.zh: 她在小教堂里。

paras.en: In the midst of her own coronation ceremony, with all of Arendelle and the neighboring kingdoms in attendance.
paras.zh: 正身处自己的加冕典礼之中，阿伦黛尔和周边各国的宾客都在场。

paras.en: Her brow wrinkled in confusion.
paras.zh: 她困惑地皱起眉头。

paras.en: Hadn’t she just been in the dining room, joking with her family?
paras.zh: 她刚才不是还在餐厅里和家人说笑吗？

paras.en: How was she suddenly here?
paras.zh: 怎么突然就到这儿了？

paras.en: And why was she wearing gloves?
paras.zh: 还有，她为什么要戴手套？

paras.en: Elsa never wore gloves.
paras.zh: 艾莎从不戴手套。

paras.en: Mostly because the cold never bothered her.
paras.zh: 主要是因为寒冷从不困扰她。

paras.en: Also, they hindered her ice magic.
paras.zh: 而且，手套会妨碍她的冰雪魔法。

paras.en: But for some reason her hands were now sheathed in light blue fabric.
paras.zh: 但不知为何，她的手此刻裹在浅蓝色的布料里。

paras.en: She realized everyone was staring at her.
paras.zh: 她意识到所有人都在盯着她。

paras.en: Her cheeks heated.
paras.zh: 她的脸颊发烫。

paras.en: She hastily removed the gloves and handed them to her mother, who was standing with her father to her right. “Go on,” Agnarr urged quietly. “Take the scepter and orb.” Elsa felt her heart pounding in her chest, though she wasn’t sure why.
paras.zh: 她匆忙摘下手套，递给站在右侧、与父亲同行的母亲。“继续，”安格瑞轻声催促，“拿起权杖和宝球。”艾莎感到心跳如鼓，尽管她不明白为什么。

paras.en: She reached down, carefully plucking the royal objects from the velvet pillow.
paras.zh: 她俯身，小心地从天鹅绒软垫上取过这两件王室之物。

paras.en: Then she turned to face the crowd.
paras.zh: 然后她转身面向人群。

paras.en: She could feel the ice seeping from her fingers as it always did when she got nervous, and the scepter and orb soon became encased in silvery ice.
paras.zh: 她能感觉到冰从指尖渗出——每当紧张时总是这样，很快权杖和宝球便被裹上了一层银白的冰。

paras.en: The audience only oohed and aahed at the public display of magic, just as her mother had predicted.
paras.zh: 观众只是对这公开的魔法展示发出阵阵惊叹，正如她母亲所料。

paras.en: Elsa felt herself relax a bit. “Your new queen, ladies and gentlemen, Elsa of Arendelle!” the bishop announced grandly.
paras.zh: 艾莎感到自己放松了些。“女士们，先生们，你们的新女王——阿伦黛尔的艾莎！”主教隆重宣布。

paras.en: Everyone cheered.
paras.zh: 所有人都欢呼起来。

paras.en: Anna threw her arms around her sister, almost knocking the royal objects to the ground. “You did it,” she cried. “Good job.
paras.zh: 安娜一把抱住姐姐，差点把王室之物撞到地上。“你做到了，”她喊道，“干得好。

paras.en: Now it’s party time!” Before Elsa could reply, Anna broke from the hug, dancing down the aisle toward the back of the chapel, chatting with the various townspeople as she passed.
paras.zh: 现在是派对时间！”艾莎还没来得及回话，安娜便松开怀抱，蹦跳着沿通道朝教堂后方走去，一路和各个镇民聊着天。

paras.en: Elsa watched her go a little wistfully; Anna was always so friendly with the people of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 艾莎略带惆怅地目送她离开；安娜对阿伦黛尔的百姓总是那么亲切。

paras.en: In fact, she hardly spent any time in the castle at all, she was so active in town.
paras.zh: 事实上，她在城堡里几乎不怎么待，在镇上活跃得很。

paras.en: Her mind suddenly flashed back to her dream.
paras.zh: 她的思绪忽然闪回到那个梦。

paras.en: Anna as queen.
paras.zh: 安娜当女王。

paras.en: She could totally see it.
paras.zh: 她完全能想象。

paras.en: But no.
paras.zh: 但算了。

paras.en: She shook her head, looking down at the scepter still in her hands.
paras.zh: 她摇摇头，低头看着仍握在手中的权杖。

paras.en: She was queen now.
paras.zh: 她现在是女王了。

paras.en: And she’d do whatever it took to be a good one.
paras.zh: 她会竭尽所能，做个好女王。

paras.en: Luckily, she had her family to help her.
paras.zh: 幸好，她有家人帮她。

paras.en: She couldn’t imagine doing this job alone.
paras.zh: 她无法想象独自做这份工作。

paras.en: She glanced over at her parents, who were gazing fondly into each other’s eyes.
paras.zh: 她瞥了眼父母，他们正深情地对望着。

paras.en: They looked so happy.
paras.zh: 他们看起来那么幸福。

paras.en: Still so in love.
paras.zh: 依然如此相爱。

paras.en: Elsa suddenly felt glad she could take this burden off her father’s shoulders at last.
paras.zh: 艾莎忽然很高兴，自己终于能替父亲卸下这副重担。

paras.en: He’d been ruling since he was a boy.
paras.zh: 他从孩提时起就在执政了。

paras.en: It was time for some rest and relaxation. “What are you going to do now, with all your free time?” she asked him. “Oh!
paras.zh: 是时候休息放松一下了。“现在你有了大把空闲时间，打算做点什么？”她问他。“哦！

paras.en: Are you kidding?” Agnarr laughed. “We have all sorts of adventures planned!” “Speak for yourself,” her mother protested. “I’m looking forward to some lazy days just reading in the library.” She slipped her hand into Agnarr’s and gave him a knowing smile.
paras.zh: 你开玩笑吧？”安格瑞大笑，“我们计划了各种各样的冒险！”“别替我说话，”母亲抗议，“我盼着能懒洋洋地待在图书馆里读读书。”她把手滑进安格瑞的手里，给了他一个心照不宣的微笑。

paras.en: He grinned back at her impishly.
paras.zh: 他也调皮地咧嘴回笑。

paras.en: Elsa giggled. “Okay, you two,” she teased. “Enough already!
paras.zh: 艾莎咯咯笑。“好啦，你们两个，”她打趣道，“够了！

paras.en: Let’s get you some chocolate.” “Mmm.
paras.zh: 快去吃点巧克力吧。”“嗯。

paras.en: Chocolate,” they said in unison.
paras.zh: 巧克力，”他们异口同声。

paras.en: Elsa smiled.
paras.zh: 艾莎笑了。

paras.en: She turned to walk down the aisle.
paras.zh: 她转身沿通道走去。

paras.en: But as she took her first step, the hem of her dress caught on her heel.
paras.zh: 可她刚迈出第一步，裙摆就勾住了脚后跟。

paras.en: She started to teeter forward, losing her balance.
paras.zh: 她开始向前摇晃，失去了平衡。

paras.en: And suddenly everything went black. “Any sign of her?” Anna startled as Mattias placed a hand on her back.
paras.zh: 突然，眼前一片漆黑。“有她的踪迹吗？”马蒂亚斯把手搭在安娜背上，把她吓了一跳。

paras.en: She turned to face him, her shoulders slumping. “Nothing,” she confessed. “You?” “Not a sign.” He sighed deeply as he looked around the Enchanted Forest, which stretched out in all directions, seeming to mock them with its emptiness.
paras.zh: 她转过身面对他，肩膀耷拉下来。“什么都没有，”她坦白，“你呢？”“一点踪迹也没有。”他深深叹了口气，环顾四周延展开来的魔法森林，那空旷的样子仿佛在嘲笑他们。

paras.en: They’d arrived an hour before and had been looking ever since, to no avail. “I gotta admit,” the general mused, “it’s strange to be back here.
paras.zh: 他们一小时前就到了，此后一直在找，却毫无结果。“我得承认，”将军若有所思地说，“回到这儿真怪。

paras.en: I know it should feel like home—I spent thirty-four years here, after all.
paras.zh: 我知道这里本该像家——毕竟我在这儿待了三十四年。

paras.en: But to be honest, it still makes me uneasy.” “It feels strange to me, too,” Anna agreed, frowning. “I usually love it here.
paras.zh: 但说实话，它还是让我不安。”“我也觉得怪，”安娜皱着眉同意，“平时我可喜欢这儿了。

paras.en: But it feels… empty right now.” “Well, the Northuldra are off with their reindeer.
paras.zh: 但此刻它觉得……空荡荡的。”“嗯，北地人带着驯鹿出去了。

paras.en: And it doesn’t seem like anyone else has been here for a while.
paras.zh: 而且看来这段时间没别人来过。

paras.en: No fresh trails…” “Not even any sign of Samantha!” Olaf declared brightly, bouncing over to the two of them, with Kristoff and Sven close behind. “Which is probably for the best,” he added as an aside to the reindeer.
paras.zh: 没有新脚印……”“连萨曼莎的影子都没有！”雪宝快活地宣布，蹦跳着来到两人身边，克里斯托夫和斯文紧随其后。“这大概是最好的，”他凑近驯鹿轻声补了一句。

paras.en: Anna shrugged. “Maybe Elsa went to Ahtohallan,” she mused. “If she did, that’s a good thing, right?” Kristoff replied. “She’d be safe there.” “Would she, though?” Anna asked worriedly. “I mean, Ahtohallan did almost kill her once.
paras.zh: 安娜耸耸肩。“也许艾莎去了阿托哈兰，”她思忖道，“如果真去了，那是好事，对吧？”克里斯托夫答道，“她在那里会安全的。”“真的会吗？”安娜担忧地问，“我是说，阿托哈兰确实差点要了她的命一次。

paras.en: When she went too deep.
paras.zh: 就是她走得太深那次。

paras.en: What if that happened again?” She closed her eyes, remembering that horrible day.
paras.zh: 万一又那样呢？”她闭上眼，回想起那可怕的一天。

paras.en: She’d been trapped in a cave with no way to help her sister.
paras.zh: 那时她被困在洞里，没法去救妹妹。

paras.en: She was beginning to feel that same frustration again. “Anna!” Kristoff placed his hands on her shoulders. “Stop assuming the worst.
paras.zh: 她又开始感到同样的无力。“安娜！”克里斯托夫双手搭上她的肩膀，“别总往最坏处想。

paras.en: Your sister is strong and powerful.
paras.zh: 你妹妹又强又有力量。

paras.en: A lot more powerful than she was back then.
paras.zh: 比那时候强多了。

paras.en: She can take care of herself.” “Everyone says that, but it’s not always true!” Anna argued.
paras.zh: 她能照顾好自己。”“大家都这么说，可这不总是对的！”安娜争辩道。

paras.en: She could feel tears welling in her eyes but refused to let them fall. “Sometimes my sister does need help.
paras.zh: 她感到眼泪在眼眶里打转，却不让它落下。“有时候我妹妹确实需要帮助。

paras.en: My help.” “Well, what do you suggest we do?” Mattias asked. “Sven can’t exactly drive us across the Dark Sea.” “I know.” Anna raked a frustrated hand through her hair. “And I don’t know.” “Come on,” Kristoff urged. “Let’s go back to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 我的帮助。”“那你说我们该怎么办？”马蒂亚斯问，“斯文可没法驾车载我们横渡暗海。”“我知道。”安娜烦躁地用手耙了耙头发，“我也不知道。”“走吧，”克里斯托夫催促，“先回阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: For all we know, she’s finally arrived and is looking for us.” Anna sighed.
paras.zh: 说不定她已经到了，正在找我们呢。”安娜叹了口气。

paras.en: She knew they were only trying to help, but they didn’t understand Elsa.
paras.zh: 她知道他们只是想帮忙，可他们不了解艾莎。

paras.en: Not like Anna did. “I’ll hitch up Sven,” Kristoff added. “And when you’re ready, we’ll go, okay?” “Okay,” she said, though she didn’t really want to.
paras.zh: 不像安娜那么了解。“我去套好斯文，”克里斯托夫补充，“等你准备好了我们就走，好吗？”“好，”她说，尽管她并不真想走。

paras.en: But, at the same time, she knew they’d never let her stay here by herself.
paras.zh: 但同时，她知道他们绝不会让她独自留在这儿。

paras.en: She wandered down the forest path, away from the group, her eyes roving over the thick forest with desperation.
paras.zh: 她沿着林间小路徘徊，离开众人，绝望的目光扫过密林。

paras.en: Where could Elsa be?
paras.zh: 艾莎会在哪儿？

paras.en: Was she really in Ahtohallan?
paras.zh: 她真在阿托哈兰吗？

paras.en: Was she safe?
paras.zh: 她安全吗？

paras.en: Suddenly she felt an icy splash of water on her face.
paras.zh: 忽然，她感到脸上被冰冷的海水溅了一下。

paras.en: She looked up, shocked to see none other than the Water Nokk itself, standing tall in front of her and shaking its watery mane.
paras.zh: 她抬起头，震惊地发现竟是水马本尊，高高地站在她面前，甩动着水做的鬃毛。

paras.en: The Water Spirit stomped its foot excitedly and pranced around Anna in a circle. “What is it?” Anna asked curiously. “Do you know where Elsa is?” The Water Nokk seemed to nod, then trotted away.
paras.zh: 水灵兴奋地跺了跺脚，绕着安娜转了一圈。“怎么了？”安娜好奇地问，“你知道艾莎在哪儿吗？”水马像是点了点头，然后小跑着走开了。

paras.en: When it got some distance out, it turned and looked at Anna expectantly, as if wanting her to follow.
paras.zh: 它跑出一段距离后，转过身期待地看着安娜，仿佛想让她跟上。

paras.en: Anna glanced backward, to where her friends were waiting.
paras.zh: 安娜回头瞥了一眼朋友们等候的方向。

paras.en: If she went to tell them where she was going, she might lose the Water Nokk.
paras.zh: 如果她去告诉他们要去哪儿，也许就会跟丢水马。

paras.en: And any chance of finding her sister.
paras.zh: 也就失去找到妹妹的任何机会。

paras.en: Making up her mind, she started walking down the path, following the Water Nokk.
paras.zh: 下定决心后，她顺着小路走去，跟着水马。

paras.en: It took off again, galloping more quickly this time.
paras.zh: 水马又跑了起来，这次跑得更快。

paras.en: Anna started to run, but she was only human and couldn’t keep up with a magical water horse at full speed. “Slow down!” she begged.
paras.zh: 安娜开始跑，可她只是个普通人，跟不上全速奔跑的魔法水马。“慢点！”她恳求。

paras.en: But just as she thought she would lose the Water Nokk for good, she felt a gust of wind sweep in behind her, pulling her off her feet.
paras.zh: 可就在她以为要永远跟丢水马时，感到一阵风从身后卷来，把她从地上掀了起来。

paras.en: A moment later, she was being flown through the forest on the trail of the Water Nokk. “Thank you, Gale,” she said with relief. “Now take me to Elsa.” She just hoped they wouldn’t be too late. “Glad I caught you!” Elsa blinked, suddenly finding herself staring into the emerald-green eyes of a tall, lean man, dressed in the fashions of the Southern Isles.
paras.zh: 片刻后，她被风托着飞过森林，紧追水马。“谢谢你，盖尔，”她松了口气，“现在带我去艾莎。”她只希望还不算太晚。“还好我接住了你！”艾莎眨了眨眼，忽然发现自己正盯着一双翡翠绿的眼睛——那是一个高瘦男人，穿着南方诸岛的服饰。

paras.en: He was gripping her hand with long, delicate fingers and looked a little worried.
paras.zh: 他用修长的手指握着她的手，神情略显担忧。

paras.en: Feeling her face flush, she allowed him to pull her to her feet.
paras.zh: 她感到脸上发烫，任由他把她拉起来。

paras.en: Then she looked around the room, confused all over again.
paras.zh: 然后她环顾房间，再次陷入困惑。

paras.en: The last thing she remembered was tripping over the hem of her dress in the chapel.
paras.zh: 她最后记得的，是在教堂里被裙摆绊了一跤。

paras.en: But now she was in the Great Hall, the Coronation Ball in full swing.
paras.zh: 可现在她却在大礼堂里，加冕舞会正热闹进行。

paras.en: She squeezed her eyes shut, then opened them again.
paras.zh: 她紧紧闭上眼，又睁开。

paras.en: What was going on with her today?
paras.zh: 她今天到底怎么了？

paras.en: Why was she losing time like this?
paras.zh: 为什么会像这样丢失时间？

paras.en: It was almost like being in a dream of some sort.
paras.zh: 简直像身处某种梦境。

paras.en: But obviously she was wide awake.
paras.zh: 但她显然清醒得很。

paras.en: Right? “Forgive me for being so forward, Your Majesty,” the man said, interrupting her troubled thoughts. “It’s just I didn’t want you to fall.” He was handsome.
paras.zh: 对吧？“请恕我冒昧，陛下，”那男人打断她纷乱的思绪，“我只是不想让您摔倒。”他很英俊。

paras.en: She’d give him that.
paras.zh: 这点她承认。

paras.en: With thick auburn hair and sparkling green eyes.
paras.zh: 一头浓密的赤褐头发，一双闪亮的绿眼睛。

paras.en: And his smile was endearing.
paras.zh: 而且他的微笑惹人怜爱。

paras.en: But at the same time, something about him made her blood run cold, though she had no idea why. “I appreciate that,” she murmured. “I just… don’t—” “Like formal gatherings like this?” he finished for her.
paras.zh: 但同时，他身上有某种东西让她背脊发凉，尽管她不知为何。“我很感激，”她低语，“我只是……不——”“不喜欢这种正式聚会？”他替她说完。

paras.en: Then he smiled. “Me neither.
paras.zh: 然后他笑了。“我也不喜欢。

paras.en: I never know what one is supposed to do.
paras.zh: 我从来不知道这种场合该做点什么。

paras.en: Besides eat and dance, I suppose.” His gaze locked on her. “Do you dance, Your Majesty?” “Not usually,” Elsa confessed. “But—” “She’d love to!” Anna broke in, practically shoving Elsa in the man’s direction.
paras.zh: 除了吃吃喝喝跳舞，我想。”他的目光锁住她。“您会跳舞吗，陛下？”“不太会，”艾莎承认，“但是——”“她求之不得！”安娜插进来，几乎是把艾莎往那男人那边推。

paras.en: Elsa found herself caught in the man’s arms.
paras.zh: 艾莎发现自己落入了那男人的臂弯。

paras.en: She wanted to break away, but she knew it would be impolite.
paras.zh: 她想挣脱，但知道那样不礼貌。

paras.en: She was queen now—anything she did could spark an international incident.
paras.zh: 她现在是女王了——她做的任何事都可能引发国际纠纷。
