paras.en: And so she forced a smile to her face and allowed him to sweep her onto the dance floor.
paras.zh: 于是她挤出微笑，任由他带着自己滑上舞池。

paras.en: He was graceful, the perfect partner.
paras.zh: 他很优雅，是完美的舞伴。

paras.en: Easily chatting about his homeland and his brothers—it sounded like he had quite a few.
paras.zh: 轻松地聊着他的家乡和兄弟们——听起来他兄弟不少。

paras.en: But Elsa couldn’t keep her mind on the conversation.
paras.zh: 但艾莎没法把心思放在对话上。

paras.en: There was just something about him that seemed… off.
paras.zh: 只因他身上有某种东西，显得……不对劲。

paras.en: And her heart raced in her chest at every dip and turn.
paras.zh: 每一次旋转下腰，她的心都在胸口狂跳。

paras.en: When the song finally ended, she awkwardly excused herself, retreating to the dessert table and shoving a few pieces of chocolate in her mouth.
paras.zh: 曲终时，她尴尬地告退，退到甜点桌前，往嘴里塞了几块巧克力。

paras.en: A moment later, Anna was by her side again. “What do you think of him?
paras.zh: 片刻后，安娜又来到她身边。“你觉得他怎么样？

paras.en: He’s nice, right?
paras.zh: 他人不错，对吧？

paras.en: And gorgeous.
paras.zh: 而且超帅。

paras.en: Total marriage material, don’t you think?” Elsa sighed. “I don’t know.
paras.zh: 绝对是结婚的料，你不觉吗？”艾莎叹了口气。“我不知道。

paras.en: I just met him two minutes ago.” “Fun fact: You can actually marry a man you just met!” Anna assured her, refusing to be deterred. “I hear it’s done all the time.
paras.zh: 我才刚认识他两分钟。“趣闻：你确实可以嫁给刚认识的人！”安娜向她保证，不肯被打消，“听说这种事常有。

paras.en: If it’s true love.” Elsa watched as Anna gazed dreamily at one of the ice harvesters, who was currently refilling the punch bowl on the other side of the room.
paras.zh: 只要是真爱。”艾莎望着安娜出神地盯着其中一个采冰人——那人正在房间另一头添潘趣酒碗。

paras.en: He had a shock of blond hair and was dressed in a rough leather vest.
paras.zh: 他有一头蓬乱的金发，穿着粗糙的皮背心。

paras.en: And… was that a reindeer with him?
paras.zh: 而且……他身边那只是驯鹿吗？

paras.en: He’d brought a reindeer to her coronation party? “Who is that?” she asked curiously.
paras.zh: 他居然带了只驯鹿来她的加冕派对？“那是谁？”她好奇地问。

paras.en: She was sure she’d never seen him before.
paras.zh: 她确信自己从没见过他。

paras.en: And yet, he looked strangely familiar. “My future husband,” Anna declared. “Of course, he doesn’t know it.
paras.zh: 可他却莫名眼熟。“我未来的丈夫，”安娜宣告，“当然，他还不知道。

paras.en: Yet.” The ice harvester burped loudly, causing several people to stop and stare.
paras.zh: 目前还不知道。”采冰人响亮地打了个嗝，惹得好几人停下脚步盯着看。

paras.en: Elsa raised an eyebrow and Anna giggled. “So, he’s a bit of a fixer-upper,” she said with an impish shrug, then pranced over to Kristoff and his reindeer.
paras.zh: 艾莎挑了挑眉，安娜咯咯笑。“所以，他算是个待修的半成品，”她调皮地耸耸肩，然后蹦跳着走向克里斯托夫和他的驯鹿。

paras.en: Elsa frowned.
paras.zh: 艾莎皱起眉头。

paras.en: Kristoff .
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫。

paras.en: Wait, had Anna told her the guy’s name was Kristoff?
paras.zh: 等等，安娜刚才说那家伙叫克里斯托夫吗？

paras.en: She caught her mother walking by and grabbed her arm. “How did Anna meet that guy?” she asked, pointing to the ice harvester.
paras.zh: 她一把拉住路过的母亲。“安娜是怎么认识那家伙的？”她指着那采冰人问。

paras.en: Iduna glanced over at Anna, who was currently trying to impress Kristoff—if that really was his name—by standing on one foot and tapping her nose with her finger.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜瞥了眼安娜，后者此刻正单脚站立、用手指点着鼻子，想给克里斯托夫——如果那真是他名字的话——留下好印象。

paras.en: Her mother rolled her eyes. “Only Ahtohallan knows with that girl,” she replied with a laugh.
paras.zh: 母亲翻了个白眼。“那丫头的事，只有阿托哈兰知道，”她笑着回答。

paras.en: She started to walk away.
paras.zh: 她转身要走。

paras.en: Elsa grabbed her arm, her heart suddenly beating madly in her chest.
paras.zh: 艾莎抓住她的手臂，心忽然在胸口狂跳。

paras.en: She knew her mother had been making a joke.
paras.zh: 她知道母亲在开玩笑。

paras.en: But that phrase.
paras.zh: 但那个词。

paras.en: That word… “Ahtohallan?” she whispered.
paras.zh: 那个字……“阿托哈兰？”她低语。

paras.en: Her mother looked at her strangely. “You know.
paras.zh: 母亲奇怪地看着她。“你知道的。

paras.en: The river of memories?” Elsa swallowed hard.
paras.zh: 记忆之河？”艾莎用力咽了口唾沫。

paras.en: Something niggled at the back of her brain.
paras.zh: 有什么东西在她脑后轻轻撩动。

paras.en: River of memories… Cave of memories… The party seemed to slip away, a sudden vision taking over her senses.
paras.zh: 记忆之河……记忆之洞……派对仿佛退去，一段突来的幻象占据了她的感官。

paras.en: She saw herself in the cave, dressed in a shimmery white dress.
paras.zh: 她看见自己在洞中，身着一袭闪亮的白裙。

paras.en: She was making her way down a small, tight passage, stepping carefully so as not to slip on the ice.
paras.zh: 她正顺着一条狭窄的小通道往下走，小心翼翼地迈步，免得在冰上滑倒。

paras.en: She was searching for something—she could tell.
paras.zh: 她在寻找什么——她能感觉到。

paras.en: But what was it?
paras.zh: 可那是什么呢？

paras.en: The farther she went, the tighter the passage became.
paras.zh: 她越往前走，通道越狭窄。

paras.en: Until she could barely squeeze herself through. “Stop,” Elsa told herself, suddenly frightened.
paras.zh: 直到她几乎挤不过去。“停下，”艾莎对自己说，忽然害怕起来。

paras.en: But she didn’t stop.
paras.zh: 可她没有停。

paras.en: She kept going, deeper.
paras.zh: 她继续走，更深。

paras.en: And deeper… “Sweetheart, are you all right?” She jerked back to the present.
paras.zh: 更深……“亲爱的，你还好吗？”她猛地回到现实。

paras.en: Her mother was peering at her with worried eyes.
paras.zh: 母亲正用担忧的眼神端详她。

paras.en: She swallowed hard, trying to will the vision to fade.
paras.zh: 她用力咽口水，试图让幻象消散。

paras.en: The vision… or the memory?
paras.zh: 那幻象……还是记忆？

paras.en: Ahtohallan.
paras.zh: 阿托哈兰。

paras.en: The cave of memories.
paras.zh: 记忆之洞。

paras.en: What was it she had been searching for there?
paras.zh: 她在那儿寻找的到底是什么？

paras.en: And why couldn’t she remember? “Ow!” Anna grunted in pain as Gale dropped her unceremoniously onto the rocky beach at the edge of the Dark Sea.
paras.zh: 为什么她想不起来？“哎哟！”盖尔毫不客气地把安娜丢在暗海边缘的礁石滩上，她疼得哼了一声。

paras.en: The Water Nokk was standing there, neighing loudly.
paras.zh: 水马站在那儿，大声嘶鸣。

paras.en: Anna scrambled to her feet, looking out over the rough water, the waves churning angrily.
paras.zh: 安娜慌忙爬起，望向汹涌的海面，波浪愤怒地翻搅。

paras.en: It had grown dark on their journey, and she could barely see anything beyond the shore. “She’s out there, isn’t she?” she asked the Water Nokk, her voice trembling.
paras.zh: 旅途上天已黑，她几乎看不见岸外的任何东西。“她就在那外面，对吧？”她声音发颤地问水马。

paras.en: The Water Spirit nickered, throwing back its watery head toward the sea.
paras.zh: 水灵嘶鸣着，朝大海扬起水做的头。

paras.en: Gale swirled around her with anxious gusts.
paras.zh: 盖尔带着不安的气流在她身边打转。

paras.en: Bruni seemed to appear out of nowhere, climbing up the Water Nokk’s back and lighting up the night with a steady purple flame.
paras.zh: 布伦尼仿佛凭空出现，爬上水马的背，用稳定的紫色火焰照亮夜色。

paras.en: It was obvious what they wanted her to do.
paras.zh: 他们想让她做什么，再明显不过。

paras.en: But could she?
paras.zh: 可她能做到吗？

paras.en: Could she cross the Dark Sea and survive?
paras.zh: 她能横渡暗海并活下来吗？

paras.en: She drew in a shaky breath. “Whatever it takes to help Elsa,” she told them.
paras.zh: 她深吸一口颤抖的气。“不管怎样都要帮艾莎，”她对他们说。

paras.en: She stepped toward the water. “Anna, no!” She whirled around just in time to see Kristoff, on Sven’s back, burst out of the forest, galloping in her direction.
paras.zh: 她朝海水迈出脚步。“安娜，不要！”她猛地转身，正好看见克里斯托夫骑着斯文冲出森林，朝她飞奔而来。

paras.en: Her heart sank.
paras.zh: 她的心一沉。

paras.en: Oh no.
paras.zh: 哦不。

paras.en: They must have followed her. “What are you doing?” he cried, reaching her and sliding off the reindeer’s back. “This has gone too far!” “Not far enough, unfortunately,” Anna said, staring out into the Dark Sea.
paras.zh: 他们一定是跟上来了。“你在干什么？”他喊着，冲到她面前从鹿背上滑下，“这太过分了！”“可惜，还差得远呢，”安娜盯着暗海说。

paras.en: She knew Ahtohallan was out there, somewhere.
paras.zh: 她知道阿托哈兰就在那外面的某处。

paras.en: But all she could see was black rushing water. “You can’t go out there.
paras.zh: 可她能看见的只有黑色奔涌的海水。“你不能去那儿。

paras.en: You’re not some magical spirit like your sister.
paras.zh: 你又不是像你妹妹那样的魔法精灵。

paras.en: It’ll drown you like it drowned your parents.” “Maybe.” Anna swallowed hard. “But what choice do I have?” Kristoff bit his lower lip.
paras.zh: 它会像淹死你父母那样淹死你。”“也许吧。”安娜用力咽口水，“可我别无选择。”克里斯托夫咬着下唇。

paras.en: The anguish on his face was hard to see. “Please, Anna, I can’t lose you,” he whispered, taking her hands in his and squeezing them tight.
paras.zh: 他脸上的痛苦让人不忍看。“求你了，安娜，我不能失去你，”他低语，双手紧紧握住她的手。

paras.en: An ache rose in her chest. “Trust me, I don’t want to be lost,” she assured him with a tight laugh.
paras.zh: 她胸口升起一阵痛楚。“相信我，我也不想迷失，”她带着勉强的笑向他保证。

paras.en: She reached up, tracing his rough cheek with her fingers. “But Elsa is my sister.
paras.zh: 她抬手，用手指描过他粗糙的脸颊。“可艾莎是我妹妹。

paras.en: I can’t lose her, either.” Kristoff nodded, bowing his head. “I know,” he said.
paras.zh: 我也不能失去她。”克里斯托夫点点头，低下头。“我知道，”他说。

paras.en: He dropped her hands, and Anna felt a terrifying emptiness at the loss of his touch. “And I would never try to stop you from doing what you feel you need to do.
paras.zh: 他松开她的手，安娜因失去他的触碰而感到一阵恐怖的空虚。“而且我绝不会拦着你去做你认为必须做的事。

paras.en: Just… promise me you’ll be careful, okay?” His words sent fresh tears to Anna’s eyes.
paras.zh: 只是……答应我你会小心，好吗？”他的话让安娜的眼里又涌出泪。

paras.en: She loved him so much.
paras.zh: 她那么爱他。

paras.en: And she was so grateful that he was willing to trust her in this—and would not try to dissuade her from what she had to do.
paras.zh: 她如此感激，他愿意在这件事上信任她——也不试图劝阻她去做该做的事。

paras.en: She threw her arms around him, pulling him close.
paras.zh: 她张开双臂抱住他，把他拉近。

paras.en: For a moment, they just held each other, as if they were the only two people in the world.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，他们只是相拥，仿佛是世界上仅有的两个人。

paras.en: Then Anna forced herself to step away. “I’ll be back as soon as I can,” she promised.
paras.zh: 然后安娜强迫自己退开。“我会尽快回来，”她承诺。

paras.en: She turned to the spirits, drawing in a breath. “Let’s do this,” she declared.
paras.zh: 她转向精灵们，深吸一口气。“我们开始吧，”她宣告。

paras.en: The Water Nokk, with Bruni perched on its head, charged into the water, leaping over the waves.
paras.zh: 水马头顶蹲着布伦尼，冲进水中，跃过浪头。

paras.en: Gale swept Anna up into its windy embrace and followed close behind.
paras.zh: 盖尔把安娜卷进风一般的怀抱，紧跟在后。

paras.en: Anna gave one last look to the shore.
paras.zh: 安娜最后看了一眼岸上。

paras.en: At Kristoff standing forlornly on the sand.
paras.zh: 看克里斯托夫孤零零地站在沙地上。

paras.en: Emotions rolled over her like another wave.
paras.zh: 情绪如另一重浪头般向她涌来。

paras.en: But she forced herself to turn back to the sea. “Hang on, Elsa!” she cried. “I’m coming!” “Elsa… I’m coming.…” Elsa startled awake at the sound of the voice.
paras.zh: 可她强迫自己转回海面。“撑住，艾莎！”她喊，“我来了！”“艾莎……我来了……”艾莎被这声音惊醒。

paras.en: She looked around, at first unsure where she was again.
paras.zh: 她环顾四周，起初又不确定自己在哪儿。

paras.en: Last she remembered she had been at her Coronation Ball.
paras.zh: 她最后记得自己还在加冕舞会上。

paras.en: But now she seemed to be in her nightclothes, curled up on the couch in the castle library, her sister by her side.
paras.zh: 可现在她似乎穿着睡衣，蜷缩在城堡图书馆的沙发上，妹妹就在身边。

paras.en: Across from her, her mother sat sleepily in a cushioned chair, and her father appeared in the doorway, carrying a plate of leftover kransekake. “I don’t know about you, but I’m exhausted,” he declared, setting the cake down on the table in front of the couch. “Who’s up for closing the gates for the next thirteen years so we can get some rest?” “Don’t even joke about that!” Anna protested, reaching over to grab some cake.
paras.zh: 对面，母亲睡意朦胧地坐在软垫椅上，父亲出现在门口，端着一盘剩下的克兰斯卡克糕。“我不知道你们怎样，反正我累坏了，”他宣告，把糕放到沙发前的桌上，“谁赞成把城门关上十三年，好让咱们歇口气？”“这种玩笑别开！”安娜抗议，伸手抓了块糕。

paras.en: She grinned at her father. “Besides, you’re not king anymore.
paras.zh: 她朝父亲咧嘴一笑。“再说了，你也不再是国王了。

paras.en: You don’t get to make the rules.” She turned to Elsa. “Which reminds me, Your Majesty, what will be your first act as queen?” Her green eyes twinkled. “Will it be putting an ice-skating rink in the town square?” Elsa opened her mouth to answer but was cut off by the voice again. “ELSSSA!
paras.zh: 你没权定规矩了。”她转向艾莎。“这倒提醒我了，陛下，您作为女王的第一件事要做什么？”她的绿眼睛闪着光，“是在广场上建个溜冰场吗？”艾莎张嘴要答，却被那声音再次打断。“艾莎！

paras.en: Where are you?” She frowned. “Did you hear that?” she asked.
paras.zh: 你在哪儿？”她皱起眉。“你听见了吗？”她问。

paras.en: It was soft, muted, sounding far away.
paras.zh: 那声音轻柔、含糊，听着很遥远。

paras.en: But also familiar at the same time.
paras.zh: 但同时又是熟悉的。

paras.en: In fact, if she hadn’t known any better, she’d have said it sounded like Anna herself.
paras.zh: 事实上，若非她更清楚，她简直要说那声音像安娜本人。

paras.en: But Anna was right here, shoving a slice of cake in her mouth. “Hear what?” her sister asked, licking her sugary fingers. “Hey, anyone up for charades?” “Elsssssa.
paras.zh: 可安娜就在这儿，正把一块糕塞进嘴里。“听见什么？”妹妹舔着沾糖的手指问，“嘿，谁来玩比手画脚？”“艾莎。

paras.en: Can you hear me?” Elsa rubbed her head with her hand.
paras.zh: 你听得见我吗？”艾莎用手揉了揉头。

paras.en: Her mother frowned. “Sweetheart, what’s wrong?” “You don’t hear it?” Elsa asked. “None of you do?” “Hear what, honey?” her father queried.
paras.zh: 母亲皱起眉。“亲爱的，怎么了？”“你们听不见吗？”艾莎问，“你们谁都听不见？”“听见什么，宝贝？”父亲问。

paras.en: Suddenly the pungent scent of the sea rose to Elsa’s nose again, as it had earlier that day when she was hugging her mother.
paras.zh: 忽然，那天早些时候她拥抱母亲时闻到的那股浓烈海味，又钻进艾莎的鼻子。

paras.en: She wrinkled her brow, feeling goose bumps appear on her arm.
paras.zh: 她皱起眉，感到手臂上起了鸡皮疙瘩。

paras.en: She felt cold.
paras.zh: 她觉得冷。

paras.en: The kind of cold you feel when you’re soaking wet. “ Elsa, please!
paras.zh: 那种浑身湿透时感到的冷。“艾莎，求你了！

paras.en: Listen to me!” The voice was louder now, more desperate.
paras.zh: 听我说！”声音现在更大了，更绝望。

paras.en: Elsa could hear the fear in the words.
paras.zh: 艾莎听出了话里的恐惧。

paras.en: She rose to her feet. “Maybe I’m just tired…” she started to say, then trailed off as her gaze fell on her sister. “Anna!” she cried. “Your hair!” “I know, it’s probably a mess.
paras.zh: 她站起身。“也许我只是累了……”她刚开口，目光落在妹妹身上便没了下文。“安娜！”她叫道，“你的头发！”“我知道，可能乱糟糟的。

paras.en: But whatever.
paras.zh: 但没关系。

paras.en: You’ve seen worse,” Anna joked. “At least there’s no drool in it, like when I first wake up.” “But it’s…” Elsa bit her lower lip.
paras.zh: 你见过更糟的，”安娜开玩笑，“至少没有像我刚睡醒时那样滴口水。”“可它是……”艾莎咬住下唇。

paras.en: She was going to say white .
paras.zh: 她本想说“白”。

paras.en: Her sister’s hair had turned completely white.
paras.zh: 妹妹的头发已经全白了。

paras.en: But had it, really?
paras.zh: 可真的是吗？

paras.en: Or were her eyes playing tricks on her again, as they had earlier?
paras.zh: 还是说她的眼睛又像之前那样骗了她？

paras.en: Her heart beat fast in her chest.
paras.zh: 她的心在胸口狂跳。

paras.en: The smell of seaweed was growing more intense by the minute, and she fought the urge to block her nose.
paras.zh: 海藻的气味一分钟比一分钟浓，她强忍住想捂鼻子的冲动。

paras.en: She glanced at her parents and sister, who were laughing and joking with one another as if nothing was wrong.
paras.zh: 她瞥了眼父母和妹妹，他们正说说笑笑，仿佛一切正常。

paras.en: But something was wrong.
paras.zh: 可有什么不对劲。

paras.en: Their skin was growing paler.
paras.zh: 他们的皮肤越来越苍白。

paras.en: Her mother’s hair, which she was positive had been dry a moment before, now looked soaking wet.
paras.zh: 母亲的头发，她确信片刻前还是干的，现在却像湿透了。

paras.en: I dreamed you died in a shipwreck.… Elsa’s knees wobbled, threatening to collapse out from her under her. “What’s going on?” she murmured.
paras.zh: 我梦到你们死于船难……艾莎的膝盖发软，几乎要瘫倒。“怎么回事？”她喃喃道。

paras.en: Anna rushed to her side, grabbing her before she collapsed. “Why don’t you go to bed?” she suggested worriedly. “You have a big day tomorrow.
paras.zh: 安娜冲到她身边，在她倒下前扶住。“你为什么不去睡？”她担忧地建议，“你明天还有大事。

paras.en: You need your rest.” Elsa squinted at her in horror.
paras.zh: 你需要休息。”艾莎惊恐地眯眼盯着她。

paras.en: Spiderwebs of ice seemed to be crawling down her sister’s face. “What’s tomorrow?” she managed to ask in a hoarse voice.
paras.zh: 蛛网般的冰似乎正爬下妹妹的脸。“明天是什么？”她用沙哑的声音勉强问道。

paras.en: Anna grinned.
paras.zh: 安娜咧嘴一笑。

paras.en: The ice crackled on her cheek. “It’s coronation day, obviously.” “But… today was coronation day.” “And so is tomorrow,” Anna explained. “And the next day.” She shrugged. “It’s always coronation day here.” “ELSA!
paras.zh: 冰在她脸颊上咯吱作响。“当然是加冕日啊。”“可……今天就是加冕日啊。”“明天也是，”安娜解释，“后天也是。”她耸耸肩，“在这儿天天都是加冕日。”“艾莎！

paras.en: Please!
paras.zh: 求你了！

paras.en: I think you’re in trouble!” In trouble.
paras.zh: 我觉得你有危险了！”有危险。

paras.en: Elsa struggled to free herself from her sister’s grasp.
paras.zh: 艾莎挣扎着想挣脱妹妹的手。

paras.en: Or the girl who looked like her sister, anyway.
paras.zh: 或者说，挣脱那个长得像妹妹的女孩。

paras.en: But this wasn’t Anna.
paras.zh: 可这不是安娜。

paras.en: The real Anna was older.
paras.zh: 真正的安娜更成熟。

paras.en: The real Anna was… queen.
paras.zh: 真正的安娜是……女王。

paras.en: Like in her dream.
paras.zh: 就像她梦里的那样。

paras.en: Had it been a dream at all?
paras.zh: 那到底是不是梦？

paras.en: Or was this the dream?
paras.zh: 还是说这才是梦？

paras.en: Everything around her.
paras.zh: 她周围的一切。

paras.en: Right here.
paras.zh: 就在此地。

paras.en: Right now. “Elsa, please!
paras.zh: 就在此刻。“艾莎，求你了！

paras.en: Listen to my voice.” Her mind flashed back to the cave again.
paras.zh: 听我的声音。”她的思绪又闪回洞中。

paras.en: She was deep now.
paras.zh: 她现在已经很深了。

paras.en: Deeper than she’d ever gone before.
paras.zh: 比以往去过的都深。

paras.en: She’d been reaching for something.
paras.zh: 她一直在够某样东西。

paras.en: Just out of her grasp.
paras.zh: 就差一点够到。

paras.en: And then… “No,” Elsa whispered. “Oh no.” Suddenly it all came rushing back to her.
paras.zh: 然后……“不，”艾莎低语，“哦不。”忽然，一切涌回她的脑海。

paras.en: Her trip to Ahtohallan.
paras.zh: 她去阿托哈兰的那趟。

paras.en: Her desire to find a special memory to share with Arendelle at her parents’ memorial.
paras.zh: 她渴望找到一段特别的记忆，在父母的纪念仪式上与阿伦黛尔分享。

paras.en: She’d searched through so many memories, but none had seemed good enough for such an important occasion.
paras.zh: 她翻看了那么多记忆，却没有一段配得上这么重要的场合。

paras.en: So she’d gone deeper.
paras.zh: 于是她走得更深。

paras.en: And deeper… …and found something else instead.
paras.zh: 更深……却找到了别的东西。

paras.en: Not a memory… but a dream.
paras.zh: 不是记忆……而是一个梦。

paras.en: A perfect dream of a perfect day, dreamed, once upon a time, by a sad little princess trapped in her bedroom.
paras.zh: 一个完美日子、完美无缺的梦，曾几何时，由一个困在卧室里的悲伤小公主所梦到。

paras.en: A princess who desperately wanted a better life.
paras.zh: 一位极度渴望更好生活的公主。

paras.en: A life where she hadn’t almost killed her sister.
paras.zh: 一种没有差点害死妹妹的生活。

paras.en: A life where no one feared her magic.
paras.zh: 一种没人害怕她魔法的生活。

paras.en: A life where she could be accepted for who she was.
paras.zh: 一种她能因真实的自己而被接纳的生活。

paras.en: A life filled with laughter and love and always feeling safe.
paras.zh: 一种充满欢笑与爱、永远感到安全的生活。

paras.en: Dreams can become memories , too, she realized.
paras.zh: 她意识到，梦也能变成记忆。

paras.en: If you held them close to your heart.
paras.zh: 只要你把它们珍藏在心底。

paras.en: She forced herself to look back at her parents and her sister now.
paras.zh: 她强迫自己再看一眼父母和妹妹。

paras.en: Iduna and Agnarr, cuddling together on the chair, feeding each other cake.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜和安格瑞在椅子上相拥，你喂我一口糕，我喂你一口糕。

paras.en: Anna dancing over to the bookcase to get the fishbowl they used to play charades.
paras.zh: 安娜蹦跳着走向书架，去拿他们玩比手画脚用的鱼缸。

paras.en: She caught Elsa watching her and waved. “Did you want to go first?” she asked with an easy grin.
paras.zh: 她察觉艾莎在看她，挥了挥手。“你想先来吗？”她轻松地咧嘴问。

paras.en: Elsa found herself unable to speak.
paras.zh: 艾莎发现自己说不出话。

paras.en: Her thoughts were whirling through her head too hard and fast to catalog.
paras.zh: 思绪在她脑中翻腾得太快太猛，理不清。

paras.en: I could stay here, she thought wildly.
paras.zh: 我可以在这儿留下来，她疯狂地想。

paras.en: In this perfect dream.
paras.zh: 留在这完美的梦里。

paras.en: I could stay here forever.
paras.zh: 我可以永远留在这儿。

paras.en: For a moment it actually seemed like a good idea.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，这似乎真是个好主意。

paras.en: The best idea, really.
paras.zh: 说真的，是最好的主意。

paras.en: To have everything she ever wanted and so much more.
paras.zh: 拥有她曾渴望的一切，甚至更多。

paras.en: To have her family back.
paras.zh: 让家人回到身边。

paras.en: Her father.
paras.zh: 她的父亲。

paras.en: Her mother.
paras.zh: 她的母亲。

paras.en: Her sister.
paras.zh: 她的妹妹。

paras.en: Her sister… The voice came again.
paras.zh: 她的妹妹……那声音又来了。

paras.en: Desperate.
paras.zh: 绝望。

paras.en: Pleading. “ELSSSSSA, CAN YOU HEAR ME?
paras.zh: 恳求。“艾——莎，你听得见我吗？

paras.en: I NEED YOU.” “Anna…” she whispered. “That’s my name!
paras.zh: 我需要你。”“安娜……”她低语。“那是我的名字！

paras.en: Don’t wear it out!” joked the auburn-haired girl in front of her.
paras.zh: 别叫坏了！”面前那赤褐头发的女孩开玩笑。

paras.en: Anna .
paras.zh: 安娜。

paras.en: But, at the same time, not Anna. “I’m sorry, but I have to go,” Elsa found herself saying.
paras.zh: 但同时，又不是安娜。“抱歉，但我得走了，”艾莎发现自己这样说。

paras.en: Her family looked up at her in surprise. “Do you?” Iduna asked worriedly, her blue eyes locking on her daughter. “Do you really?” She sounded sad.
paras.zh: 家人惊讶地抬头看她。“你要走吗？”伊杜娜担忧地问，蓝眼睛锁定女儿，“你真要走吗？”她听起来很伤心。

paras.en: So sad.
paras.zh: 那么伤心。

paras.en: And for a moment, Elsa felt as if her heart would shatter into a million pieces if her mother spoke another word.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，艾莎觉得母亲再多说一个字，她的心就要碎成千万片。

paras.en: But then she heard her sister again.
paras.zh: 可接着她又听见妹妹的声音。

paras.en: Her real sister.
paras.zh: 她真正的妹妹。

paras.en: She swallowed hard, taking one last look at her mother.
paras.zh: 她用力咽口水，最后看了一眼母亲。

paras.en: Her father. “Yes,” she said, nodding her head. “I’m sorry, but I do.” She paused, then added, “But thank you.
paras.zh: 她的父亲。“是的，”她点点头，“抱歉，但我得走。”她顿了顿，又补充，“但谢谢你。

paras.en: Thank you for giving me this day.
paras.zh: 谢谢你给了我这一天。

paras.en: I… won’t forget it.
paras.zh: 我……不会忘记它。

paras.en: Ever.” Suddenly she didn’t know if she was talking to her parents anymore—or to Ahtohallan itself.
paras.zh: 永远不会。”忽然，她不知道自己是在对父母说话——还是对阿托哈兰本身说话。

paras.en: Maybe it was all one and the same.
paras.zh: 也许两者本就是同一回事。

paras.en: She’d wanted a special memory.
paras.zh: 她曾想要一段特别的记忆。

paras.en: And she’d been given one.
paras.zh: 而她得到了一段。

paras.en: But now it was time to say— “Goodbye,” she murmured.
paras.zh: 但现在该说——“再见，”她喃喃道。

paras.en: Her vision blurred.
paras.zh: 她的视线模糊。

paras.en: The world seemed to shift before her eyes.
paras.zh: 世界仿佛在她眼前变换。

paras.en: Her family, once warm and alive, began to crystallize, freezing into place.
paras.zh: 她的家人，曾那样温暖鲜活，开始结晶，冻结在原地。

paras.en: A moment later, they were nothing more than ice sculptures, crafted by a master hand.
paras.zh: 片刻后，他们不过成了高手雕出的冰雕。

paras.en: And Elsa found herself alone, no longer in a familiar firelit library but in the middle of an icy cave.
paras.zh: 艾莎发现自己孤身一人，不再在熟悉的炉边图书馆，而是在冰洞中央。

paras.en: An icy cave of memories… and dreams.
paras.zh: 一个冰冷的、记忆与梦之洞。

paras.en: A tear slipped down her cheek.
paras.zh: 一滴泪滑下她的脸颊。

paras.en: For a moment she just stood there, as if she, too, had frozen in place.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻她只是站在那儿，仿佛自己也冻住了。

paras.en: A wave of exhaustion weighed her down, and a frosty coldness crawled up her spine.
paras.zh: 一阵疲惫压垮了她，冰冷的寒意顺着脊背爬上。

paras.en: But then she heard the voice again. “Elsa!
paras.zh: 可接着她又听见那声音。“艾莎！

paras.en: Please help me!” And she began to run. “I’m coming, Anna!” she called. “Hang on.” “Elsa!” Anna croaked her sister’s name, her mouth filled with seawater.
paras.zh: 救救我！”于是她开始奔跑。“我来了，安娜！”她喊，“撑住。”“艾莎！”安娜沙哑地叫着妹妹的名字，嘴里灌满了海水。

paras.en: The salt was making her throat burn and yelling was making her voice hoarse.
paras.zh: 咸味灼烧着她的喉咙，喊叫让她的声音嘶哑。

paras.en: Still, she kept at it, best she could, as she and Gale worked to follow the Water Nokk across the Dark Sea.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，她和盖尔努力跟着水马横渡暗海，仍竭力喊着。

paras.en: Her eyes scanned the horizon for some sign of land—some hint of the mythical glacier Ahtohallan.
paras.zh: 她的眼睛扫过地平线，搜寻陆地的迹象——那神话般的冰川阿托哈兰的踪影。

paras.en: But everything remained dark.
paras.zh: 可一切都仍是漆黑。

paras.en: And she was beginning to despair.
paras.zh: 她开始绝望。

paras.en: What if she couldn’t get to Ahtohallan herself?
paras.zh: 万一她自己到不了阿托哈兰怎么办？

paras.en: What if it only revealed itself to her sister?
paras.zh: 万一它只对她妹妹显现呢？

paras.en: What if she was doomed to meet the same fate as their parents? “Elsa!” A huge wave rose in front of them.
paras.zh: 万一她注定要落得和父母同样的下场呢？“艾莎！”一道巨浪在他们面前升起。

paras.en: Gale tried to lift her over it but misjudged its height, and the wave crashed over Anna’s head instead, soaking her to the bone.
paras.zh: 盖尔想把她托过浪头，却估错了高度，浪反而拍在安娜头上，把她淋得透湿。

paras.en: The water was freezing.
paras.zh: 海水冰冷刺骨。

paras.en: Her whole body was racked with shivers. “Please,” Anna begged, croaking out the words. “We need to stop for a second.” But there was no place to stop.
paras.zh: 她的全身剧烈发抖。“求你了，”安娜沙哑地恳求，“我们得停一下。”可无处可停。

paras.en: The Water Nokk and Bruni were far ahead now—only visible by a small purple dot on the horizon.
paras.zh: 水马和布伦尼已经远远在前——只能凭地平线上一个紫色小点辨认。

paras.en: And Gale was clearly getting tired, fighting the waves.
paras.zh: 而盖尔显然也累了，正与海浪搏斗。

paras.en: What was Anna going to do if the Wind Spirit dropped her into the water?
paras.zh: 万一风灵把她掉进海里，安娜该怎么办？

paras.en: There was no way she could last even a second in the rough sea.
paras.zh: 在汹涌的海里，她连一秒都撑不住。

paras.en: And Elsa… what would happen to Elsa if she failed to reach in her time?
paras.zh: 而艾莎……要是她不能及时赶到，艾莎会怎样？

paras.en: And so she did the only thing she could.
paras.zh: 于是她做了唯一能做的事。

paras.en: She kept struggling to stay above water, calling her sister’s name.
paras.zh: 她继续挣扎着浮在水面，呼喊妹妹的名字。

paras.en: Not only with her voice, but with everything she had inside of her.
paras.zh: 不止用声音，更用她内在的一切。

paras.en: Her soul.
paras.zh: 她的灵魂。

paras.en: Her heart.
paras.zh: 她的心。

paras.en: Pushing all her love for Elsa out into the unknown, praying it would be enough. “Elsa!” she pleaded. “I need you!” “ Elssssa.
paras.zh: 把她全部对艾莎的爱推向未知，祈祷这已足够。“艾莎！”她恳求，“我需要你！”“艾莎。

paras.en: I neeeed you.…” Elsa collapsed onto the icy ground just outside of the mouth of Ahtohallan, heaving in huge breaths.
paras.zh: 我需要你……”艾莎瘫倒在阿托哈兰洞口外的冰地上，大口喘着气。

paras.en: She raised her head, looking out into the Dark Sea, her eyes bleary and her body aching.
paras.zh: 她抬起头，望向暗海，两眼昏花，浑身酸痛。

paras.en: But her exhaustion was mixed with relief.
paras.zh: 但疲惫中夹杂着宽慰。

paras.en: She was back in the real world again. “Elsa…” Her head snapped to attention at the sound of the voice. “Anna!” she cried. “Where are you?” She heard a nicker and looked up.
paras.zh: 她又回到真实世界了。“艾莎……”一听见那声音，她猛地警觉。“安娜！”她叫道，“你在哪儿？”她听见一声嘶鸣，抬起头。

paras.en: The Water Nokk had appeared out of nowhere—Bruni perched on its head—and was now standing on the shore, as if waiting for her.
paras.zh: 水马凭空出现——布伦尼蹲在它头顶——此刻正站在岸边，仿佛在等她。

paras.en: Elsa’s heart fluttered in her chest. “Is Anna all right?” she asked.
paras.zh: 艾莎的心在胸口怦然一跳。“安娜还好吗？”她问。

paras.en: Not waiting for an answer, she scrambled to her feet, throwing herself onto the spirit’s back.
paras.zh: 不等回答，她慌忙起身，扑到精灵背上。

paras.en: The water horse took off running, galloping straight into the Dark Sea.
paras.zh: 水马起跑，径直冲进暗海。

paras.en: Elsa held on to its neck as tightly as she could, her mind racing with worry. “Anna!” she cried out. “Where are you?” Suddenly she caught a glimpse of a dark shape, struggling in the sea.
paras.zh: 艾莎拼死搂住它的脖子，满心忧虑。“安娜！”她喊，“你在哪儿？”忽然，她瞥见一个黑影在海中挣扎。

paras.en: Heart in her throat, she urged the Water Nokk forward.
paras.zh: 她心提到嗓子眼，催促水马向前。

paras.en: As they drew closer, she realized Gale was trying to keep an unconscious Anna afloat, but the Wind Spirit was faltering.
paras.zh: 靠近后她看清，盖尔正试图让昏迷的安娜浮在水面，可风灵已力不从心。

paras.en: Horrified, Elsa reached down, grabbing Anna’s icy hand in her own, yanking her up onto the Water Nokk’s back. “Get us to shore,” she commanded the spirit.
paras.zh: 惊恐之下，艾莎俯身，用自己手抓住安娜冰冷的手，把她拽上水马背。“带我们上岸，”她命令精灵。

paras.en: The Water Nokk obeyed, setting off across the sea.
paras.zh: 水马听从，动身横渡海面。

paras.en: Elsa cradled Anna in her arms, tears streaming down her cheeks. “What were you thinking?” she demanded. “Why would you do this?” But in her heart, she knew exactly why Anna would do this.
paras.zh: 艾莎把安娜搂在怀里，泪流满面。“你在想什么？”她质问，“你为什么要这样？”但她心里清楚，安娜为何要这样。

paras.en: And without her, Elsa would have never broken free of her dream.
paras.zh: 没有她，艾莎永远也走不出那个梦。

paras.en: Eventually they reached the shore.
paras.zh: 最终他们到了岸边。

paras.en: There Elsa found a desperate Kristoff, standing on the beach.
paras.zh: 在那儿，艾莎看见绝望的克里斯托夫站在海滩上。

paras.en: When he saw them, he ran over and helped Elsa get Anna off the horse. “Oh no!” he cried. “She’s… not… ?” “She’s alive,” Elsa assured him. “But I think she’s swallowed a lot of water.” Kristoff dropped to his knees, putting his mouth over Anna’s, giving her his breath.
paras.zh: 他一看见他们，就跑过来帮艾莎把安娜从马上抱下。“哦不！”他叫，“她……不会……？”“她还活着，”艾莎向他保证，“但我想她呛了不少水。”克里斯托夫跪下来，嘴对嘴给安娜渡气。

paras.en: As he worked, Elsa paced the beach, feeling helpless.
paras.zh: 他施救时，艾莎在海滩上踱步，感到无助。

paras.en: Despite all her magic, she could not help her sister.
paras.zh: 尽管她有再多的魔法，却帮不了妹妹。

paras.en: Please be okay, she begged.
paras.zh: 求你没事，她祈求。

paras.en: Please… Suddenly Anna coughed violently.
paras.zh: 求你……忽然，安娜剧烈咳嗽起来。

paras.en: Kristoff turned her over, just in time for her to spit out what seemed to be half of the sea.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫把她翻过身，正好让她吐出仿佛半片海的水。

paras.en: Elsa ran to her sister, her heart racing in her chest. “Elsa!” Anna cried, looking up at her, her eyes growing wide. “You’re okay.” “Yes!” Elsa choked on the word. “Thanks to you, I am.” Anna’s mouth quirked in a small, weak smile.
paras.zh: 艾莎跑到妹妹身边，心在胸口狂跳。“艾莎！”安娜抬头望着她，眼睛睁大，“你没事。”“对！”艾莎被这个词哽住，“多亏了你，我才没事。”安娜的嘴角牵起一丝微弱而虚弱的笑。

paras.en: She turned to Kristoff. “See?
paras.zh: 她转向克里斯托夫。“看吧？

paras.en: Sometimes she does need me.” Kristoff rolled his eyes, but Elsa could see the sheer relief on his face. “Yeah, yeah,” he said.
paras.zh: 有时候她确实需要我。”克里斯托夫翻了个白眼，可艾莎看得出他脸上如释重负的神情。“是啦是啦，”他说。

paras.en: He kissed Anna on the top of her head, then hugged her close before rising to his feet.
paras.zh: 他亲了亲安娜的头顶，然后紧紧抱住她，才站起身。

paras.en: He turned to Elsa. “I’m going to get the wagon and the others.
paras.zh: 他转向艾莎。“我去把马车和其他人带来。

paras.en: There are blankets—they’ll help her keep warm.
paras.zh: 有毯子——能帮她保暖。

paras.en: At least until we get her back to Arendelle.” “Thank you, Kristoff,” Elsa said gratefully.
paras.zh: 至少撑到我们把她带回阿伦黛尔。”“谢谢你，克里斯托夫，”艾莎感激地说。

paras.en: Once he had left, she turned back to her sister, thankful to see the color was returning to her cheeks.
paras.zh: 他走后，她转回妹妹身边，欣慰地看到血色正回到安娜脸颊。

paras.en: She was going to be all right.
paras.zh: 她会好起来的。

paras.en: Anna sat up and rubbed her eyes. “I knew something had to be wrong when you didn’t show up for the memorial party,” she said. “What happened?” Elsa grimaced, then told the story.
paras.zh: 安娜坐起来揉揉眼。“你没来纪念派对，我就知道准出事了，”她说，“怎么回事？”艾莎做了个鬼脸，然后讲起经过。

paras.en: Anna listened carefully to every word.
paras.zh: 安娜仔细听着每一个字。

paras.en: When she had finished, her sister sighed. “It actually sounds kind of amazing,” Anna admitted. “The day, I mean.
paras.zh: 她说完后，妹妹叹了口气。“其实听起来还挺妙的，”安娜承认，“我是说那一天。

paras.en: I’m honestly surprised you didn’t want to stay.” “Once upon a time, I might have,” Elsa confessed. “Back then, all I had were dreams like this.
paras.zh: 说实话，我很意外你竟不想留下。”“曾几何时，我也许会想留，”艾莎承认，“那时我只有这样的梦。

paras.en: But now?
paras.zh: 可现在呢？

paras.en: I have so much more.” Anna nodded. “Right.
paras.zh: 我拥有的多得多。”安娜点头。“对。

paras.en: Like the Enchanted Forest, the spirits—” “And, most importantly, I have you ,” Elsa said, smiling down at her sister. “The real-life you.
paras.zh: 比如魔法森林、精灵——”“而最重要的是，我有你，”艾莎说着，微笑着低头看妹妹，“真实生活中的你。

paras.en: At the end of the day, that’s all I really need.” “I love you, Elsa,” Anna said, throwing her arms around her sister. “I love you, too,” Elsa said, squeezing her back.
paras.zh: 说到底，那才是我真正需要的。”“我爱你，艾莎，”安娜张开双臂抱住姐姐。“我也爱你，”艾莎回抱紧她。

paras.en: Then she sighed. “What is it?” Anna asked, looking up at her.
paras.zh: 然后她叹了口气。“怎么了？”安娜抬头问她。

paras.en: Elsa shrugged. “I’m just disappointed that I won’t have anything special to share for our parents’ memorial.” “Oh, please,” Anna scoffed. “Don’t you understand?
paras.zh: 艾莎耸耸肩。“我只是失望，没法为父母的纪念仪式准备什么特别的东西来分享。”“哦，拜托，”安娜嗤道，“你还不明白吗？

paras.en: Just you being there is special.
paras.zh: 光是你在那儿，就够特别了。

paras.en: Because you are special.
paras.zh: 因为你本就特别。

paras.en: To me.
paras.zh: 对我来说。

paras.en: And to all of Arendelle.” She reached out and placed a hand over her sister’s.
paras.zh: 对全体阿伦黛尔也是。”她伸出手，覆在妹妹的手上。

paras.en: Somehow it felt warm already. “Memories are great and all, Elsa.
paras.zh: 不知为何，那只手已经是暖的。“记忆固然好，艾莎。

paras.en: But us being together—in the here and now—well, I can’t think of anything better than that.” “Me neither,” Elsa agreed with a smile. “You make every day feel like coronation day.”
paras.zh: 但我们在一起——在此时此刻——我实在想不出有什么比这更好。”“我也想不出，”艾莎笑着同意，“你让每一天都像加冕日。”
